jobs.title: AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: **Overview** Join our dynamic team as an AWS Cloud Infrastructure Engineer and be at the forefront of designing, implementing, and managing cutting\-edge cloud solutions. In this role, you will leverage your expertise in cloud computing, virtualization, and distributed systems to build scalable, secure, and efficient cloud infrastructure. Your work will empower organizations to innovate rapidly while maintaining robust security and operational excellence. This is an exciting opportunity for passionate professionals eager to shape the future of cloud architecture and automation. **Duties** * Design, deploy, and optimize cloud infrastructure solutions using AWS services such as S3, VPCs (Virtual Private Clouds), IAM (Identity and Access Management), and other cloud management tools. * Automate deployment processes through Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform, Ansible, or CloudFormation to ensure repeatability and scalability. * Manage hybrid cloud environments integrating AWS with other platforms like Google Cloud Platform, Microsoft Azure, Rackspace, VMware, OpenStack, and Citrix to support diverse enterprise needs. * Develop and maintain scalable microservices architectures utilizing Docker containers, Kubernetes orchestration, and serverless technologies for SaaS applications. * Implement system hardening techniques and security best practices across Linux and Windows operating systems to safeguard cloud environments against threats. * Collaborate with development teams on DevOps automation initiatives using scripting languages such as Python, Bash, PowerShell, or Ruby to streamline CI/CD pipelines. * Monitor system performance and troubleshoot issues related to cloud infrastructure, ensuring high availability and scalability of critical services. **Requirements** * Proven experience managing IT infrastructure within public cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud Platform, or Azure. * Strong understanding of service\-oriented architecture (SOA), RESTful APIs, web services, and distributed systems design principles. * Hands\-on experience with virtualization technologies including VMware, OpenStack, Rackspace Cloud, or Citrix environments. * Proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash (Unix shell), PowerShell, or Ruby for automation tasks. * Familiarity with containerization tools such as Docker and orchestration platforms like Kubernetes for scalable deployment solutions. * Knowledge of IaaS (Infrastructure as a Service), PaaS (Platform as a Service), SaaS (Software as a Service), and hybrid cloud architectures. * Experience with database management systems including MySQL, PostgreSQL, Oracle, or NoSQL databases like DynamoDB or MongoDB. * Strong understanding of network security protocols including VPNs and Virtual Private Networks; experience with system hardening practices is a plus. * Background in computer science or related fields with a focus on cloud development, software engineering principles, or DevOps methodologies. Join us to lead innovative cloud initiatives that drive digital transformation! Your expertise will help organizations harness the power of cloud computing—delivering scalable solutions that meet today’s demanding IT challenges with agility and security. Pay: $110,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Distinguished Agent Engineer

jobs.description: **Distinguished Agent Engineer** ================================ Full\-time \| San Francisco or Remote **About Fastino** ----------------- * We're building specialized, efficient language models that beat big general models on the tasks that matter. Our team includes alumni from Google Research, Apple, Stanford, and Cambridge. * Our open source GLiNER models have been downloaded 50M\+ times and are used by teams at NVIDIA, Meta, and Airbnb. * We've raised $25M (covered in TechCrunch) from Microsoft, Khosla Ventures, Insight Partners, GitHub CEO Thomas Dohmke, Docker CEO Scott Johnston, and others. **The Role** ------------ This is one of our most senior IC engineering role. You'll set the technical direction for how agents get built on Fastino models, write a lot of the core code yourself, and raise the bar for everyone around you. You've built agentic systems that real users depend on, and you have strong opinions about what works. **What You'll Work On** ----------------------- * Design and own the architecture for agentic systems built on Fastino's small, fast models: planning, tool use, memory, and multi\-agent orchestration. * Figure out where specialized models beat frontier LLMs inside agent loops, and prove it with benchmarks and real customer workloads. * Build the evals, telemetry, and feedback loops that tell us when agents are getting better (or worse) and why. * Partner with research to turn new model architectures into agent capabilities, and shape what research works on next. * Make agents fast and reliable at scale: low latency inference, high concurrency serving, graceful failure handling. * Drive data and fine\-tuning strategy for agent specific tasks like tool calling, extraction, and routing. **What We're Looking For** -------------------------- * 5\+ years of software engineering experience, with 3\+ years building with LLMs or ML in production. * A track record of shipping agentic systems that real users rely on, and the scars to prove it. * Deep experience across the stack: prompt and context engineering, tool and API design, vector DBs, Kubernetes, and inference serving. * Strong understanding of model behavior: fine\-tuning, evals, failure modes, and latency/cost tradeoffs. * Experience setting technical direction across teams, not just within one project. * You write clearly and make complicated systems feel simple. * Bonus: experience building high concurrency microservices for agent workloads. * Bonus: familiarity with GLiNER or other information extraction architectures. * Bonus: open source contributions, papers, or talks on agents or LLM systems.

jobs.title: GTM Engineer
jobs.description: **About the company** Agentplace is building an AI\-native workspace where teams create and work with AI agents. Unlike competitors, we're focused on agents from day one, and we're building a full business suite, not just another no\-code tool. Based in San Francisco, featured in VentureBeat, USA Today, and Fast Company. **About the role** We're looking for a hands\-on GTM Engineer who turns market attention into distribution and users. This isn't generic marketing. We want someone who understands GTM better than the founder, has a feel for the audience, and brings new ideas instead of waiting for instructions. The role focuses on two distribution channels: * **Content** is the main focus. Content has an endless competitive surface: wherever you start, the right approach lets you stand out. * **Generative Search Optimization (GSO)** means getting Agentplace into answers from AI search and LLMs. Someone on the team already leads this; you'll help scale it. You'll work closely with the founder and product team, constantly testing positioning, messaging, and growth channels. There's no dedicated marketing team yet, so you'll own both strategy and execution. **What you'll do** *Content and distribution* * Spot emerging market narratives and turn them into content and clear use cases * Run daily distribution on LinkedIn, X, and other relevant channels * Publish posts, demos, threads, and short videos *Generative Search Optimization* * Help grow GSO as a channel together with the person leading it * Adapt content and narratives for AI search and LLM answers * Measure visibility and iterate *Growth experiments* * Constantly test messages, hooks, and narratives * Run growth experiments on landing pages, content, and channels * Measure results and iterate fast **What we're looking for** * Strong hands\-on approach and focus on results * Deep GTM expertise: you bring new ideas, not someone else's playbook * A feel for the audience and narratives that hook * Experience running content distribution for a startup or product * Understanding of GSO as a channel and willingness to grow it * Ability to turn product features into clear stories and content * Understanding of growth loops and an experiment\-driven approach * Comfort with fast iteration **Nice to have** * Experience in AI, developer tools, or SaaS * A track record of growing an audience on LinkedIn, X, or YouTube * Experience working with founders on early\-stage GTM * Ability to make simple product demos or short videos **What success looks like** * Consistent, high\-quality content and strong distribution * A stronger GSO channel and growing visibility in AI search * More inbound interest and new users * Clear product narratives grounded in experiments * Fast iteration on messaging and use cases **Details** * Format: remote * Type: contract * Compensation: From $3,500/month **How to apply** To apply, complete a test task. Plan on 3–4 hours. * **Product.** Sign up at agentplace.io, build an AI agent for any niche, and publish it as public. Use the Luna model, it's free. * **Content.** Create a mini launch for your agent: * a LinkedIn post * an X thread * a demo video up to 60 seconds (Loom or a screen recording) * three alternative hooks for the post * **GSO.** Ask ChatGPT, Perplexity, and Claude three questions where Agentplace should show up in the answer (for example, "best AI agent builder for small business"). Note who appears instead of us and suggest what content would get Agentplace into those answers. Send the link to your agent, your content, the video, and your GSO findings to nikita@agentplace.io. Bonus: if you actually publish your post, include the link. It's optional, but we'll see your distribution in action. **Applications are reviewed by email only.** Applications sent through the job board's Apply button, without the completed test task, will not be considered. We review applications quickly and will reach out to successful candidates with an offer. Pay: $36,000\.00 \- $40,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.description: Interconnection \& Transmission Regulatory Manager – Renewable Energy **Location:** Puerto Rico \- Candidates from the mainland can be considered **Contract:** Long\-term opportunity \- 2\.5 years **Pay:** Competitive / DOE About the Opportunity Viridan Group are delighted to be supporting our client, an established energy infrastructure investment and development business with a growing portfolio of utility\-scale renewable energy projects, on their search for an Interconnection \& Transmission Regulatory Manager. This position will play a critical role in advancing grid connection and transmission\-related activities across a portfolio of solar PV and battery energy storage projects. Working on behalf of the project owner, the successful candidate will oversee interconnection processes, coordinate with utility and regulatory stakeholders, manage technical studies and agreements, and ensure grid connection requirements are integrated into wider project development schedules. The role offers significant autonomy and the opportunity to influence technical, regulatory and commercial decisions throughout the project lifecycle. Key Responsibilities * Manage the full generation interconnection process, from initial feasibility assessments and applications through technical studies, agreement execution and commissioning. * Oversee interconnection schedules, queue positions, study milestones, network upgrade requirements and associated commercial obligations. * Coordinate with utility representatives, transmission planning teams, engineering consultants and project stakeholders to progress grid connection activities. * Review interconnection and transmission study results, including system impact and facilities studies, identifying technical issues, cost implications and potential project risks. * Support the negotiation and administration of interconnection agreements, including milestone obligations, security requirements and commercial operation timelines. * Coordinate technical interfaces relating to protection and control, metering, SCADA, telemetry and grid compliance requirements. * Evaluate transmission access arrangements, connection constraints and potential network upgrades affecting project viability. * Monitor changes in energy regulations, transmission tariffs, grid codes and utility requirements that could impact project development or operational compliance. * Work alongside legal and regulatory advisors on submissions, compliance matters, utility proceedings and associated documentation. * Provide early\-stage interconnection assessments to support site selection, project feasibility and development strategy. * Contribute technical and commercial input to project schedules, financial assumptions, connection budgets and risk assessments. * Maintain interconnection trackers, regulatory updates and reporting dashboards across multiple projects. * Collaborate with development, engineering, procurement and construction teams to ensure interconnection requirements are incorporated into project designs and delivery plans. What We're Looking For * Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems Engineering or a related technical discipline. * 7\+ years of experience in generation interconnection, transmission planning, power systems engineering or energy regulatory affairs. * Direct experience managing interconnection activities for utility\-scale generation projects, ideally solar PV and BESS. * Strong understanding of power system studies, including load flow, short\-circuit analysis, stability assessments and protection and control. * Experience reviewing interconnection study results and negotiating or administering grid connection agreements. * Familiarity with transmission tariffs, utility regulatory frameworks, grid codes and applicable reliability standards. * Experience working with utilities, independent power producers, renewable energy developers, engineering consultancies or regulatory organizations. * Ability to coordinate technical, legal, commercial and regulatory stakeholders across complex infrastructure projects. * Strong project management, analytical and communication skills. * Experience with Puerto Rico's electricity market and grid interconnection framework would be highly advantageous. * Professional Engineer (PE) license preferred but not essential. * Fluency in English and Spanish required. Why Consider This Opportunity? This is an opportunity to take ownership of a critical technical and regulatory function within a growing renewable energy development portfolio. You'll be involved in projects from early feasibility through grid connection and commissioning, working closely with senior project stakeholders and helping shape the interconnection strategy for major energy infrastructure investments. **Interested?** Apply directly or contact Viridan Group for a confidential discussion. Pay: $60\.00 \- $90\.00 per hour Expected hours: No less than 40\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Relocation assistance * Vision insurance Work Location: In person

jobs.description: **Job Overview** Meadow Health is a 50 state telehealth practice providing precision care for neurodevelopmental conditions. We run our own multitenant care platform and are extending it to support decentralized clinical trials, from remote recruitment and prescreening through eConsent, remote visits, ePRO, data capture and sponsor reporting. We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer to build these capabilities hands on, end to end, in Python, Django, Angular, PostgreSQL and AWS CDK. This role sits at the intersection of engineering and clinical research: you will build, validate and document software that will be inspected under FDA 21 CFR Part 11, ICH E6(R3\) Good Clinical Practice, IRB and HIPAA expectations. The screening tools you build flag, explain and document, while investigators and clinicians make the decisions. You will report to the CEO and have early ownership of the clinical research architecture of a platform used in real patient care. **Duties** * Design and ship features across the stack in Python, Django and Django REST Framework, Angular and TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, running on AWS with infrastructure defined in AWS CDK. * Build online prescreen questionnaires, consent to contact registries and a versioned, protocol driven inclusion and exclusion rules engine whose results ("likely met," "likely not met," "needs review") are explainable and linked to evidence. * Build eConsent and assent workflows with version control of IRB approved materials, identity verification, comprehension checks and Part 11 compliant electronic signatures. * Support remote and telehealth study visits, scheduling and reminders, and ePRO and eCOA questionnaires for participants and caregivers. * Build electronic case report forms with edit checks, query management, data review and locking, and complete audit trails. * Implement Part 11 controls, including time stamped audit trails, electronic signatures, role based access, record retention and human readable exports. * Produce risk based validation evidence (CSV and CSA, IQ/OQ/PQ, traceability, test scripts and release records) in line with GAMP 5, backed by automated tests across the stack (Django unit and API tests, Angular unit tests, Playwright end to end tests). * Build secure, reliable integrations with sponsor, CRO and site systems (EDC, CTMS, lab and rater data) and sponsor reporting such as enrollment funnels, screen fail reasons and data completeness. * Keep each study and the clinical care program strictly separate in the data model, authorization and queries. * Protect PHI under HIPAA with encryption in transit and at rest, managed secrets, least privilege access and access logging, and contribute to controls aligned with NIST CSF and SOC 2\. * Write and maintain data models, API and data flow documentation, and system descriptions for IRB submissions, sponsor audits and regulatory inspections. * Work closely with clinicians, research and operations staff to translate protocol requirements into clear specifications and working software. **Skills** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering with production ownership of a web application. * Strong Python, Django and Django REST Framework, including the Django ORM and versioned migrations. * PostgreSQL schema design, migrations, constraints and query performance. * Angular with TypeScript (components, services, routing, HTTP interceptors) and RxJS. * AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, IAM, Secrets Manager, CloudWatch), Docker, and infrastructure as code with AWS CDK in TypeScript. * REST API design, OAuth 2\.0 and JWT authentication, role based access control and multitenant SaaS patterns. * Automated testing across the stack, CI/CD, and Git with pull request based code review. * Experience building and running software that stores PHI under HIPAA. * Working knowledge of 21 CFR Part 11 and GCP, or equivalent experience building GxP or other FDA regulated software. * Experience building rules or decision logic whose outputs are explainable, versioned and auditable. * Clear technical writing for regulated documentation. **Preferred** * Software for clinical trials or DCTs (EDC, eConsent, eCOA/ePRO, CTMS, IRT or recruitment platforms). * Hands on validation work (IQ/OQ/PQ, CSV and CSA) and audit or inspection support. * CDISC standards (CDASH and SDTM; ODM and ADaM awareness). * HL7 FHIR R4 and US Core data mapping. * Telehealth or video visit experiences and WCAG 2\.1 AA accessibility. * LLM assisted extraction of criteria from protocols and records, with human review. * Familiarity with autism assessment instruments such as ADOS 2, ADI R and Vineland 3\. * SOC 2 Type II audit support, AWS Associate level certification, or GAMP/CSV training. Required within 30 days of start: ICH E6(R3\) GCP training (for example CITI GCP), Human Subjects Research training and Meadow HIPAA training. We offer a competitive salary and equity, and meaningful work that improves care and research access for autistic children and their families. Meadow Health is an equal opportunity employer. Pay: $125,000\.00 \- $160,000\.00 per year Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Technical Product Manager, Integrations
jobs.description: **Role** **Context** Altic is the rules\-based operational network that enables private markets to operate within managed accounts at scale. It is the infrastructure layer that did not exist before. Not a platform, not a portal, not a workflow tool. The right historical reference is what NSCC and Omgeo did for equities: common standards, rules and infrastructure that allowed an entire asset class to operate at volume. A network is only worth as much as it is connected. An alternatives trade touches a wealth platform, a trading or order management platform, a custodian, and a transfer agent or fund administrator. Today each of those connections is built bilaterally, differently, every time. That is why the industry runs at an 8 to 10 per cent not\-in\-good\-order rate. Altic is targeting less than 0\.01 per cent, and connectivity is where that is won or lost. The connectivity itself is unglamorous and genuinely hard. Some counterparties expose modern REST APIs. Many still exchange fixed\-width or delimited files over SFTP on a nightly cycle. Some sit behind decades\-old platforms with a batch window and no appetite to change it. The job is not to wish that away. It is to design flows that work across all of it and still deliver a trade end to end, in good order, at volume. **Purpose of the Role** You will own how data moves into, through and out of the Altic network. That means consuming the interfaces our network participants already have, exposing the interfaces Altic offers back to them, and designing the flows in between so that the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade completes without manual intervention. The counterparties in scope are wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms, custodians, and transfer agents and fund administrators. Each has a different technical reality and a different set of constraints. Your job is to build reusable connectivity rather than a series of one\-off builds, so that the tenth integration of a given type is materially faster than the first. You work against the network's rules and technical specification rather than inventing requirements from scratch. Where a rule cannot be implemented as written, you are the person who says so and works it back through. **Key Stakeholders** * Wealth platforms, trading and order management platforms * Custodians, transfer agents and fund administrators * GPs and asset managers participating in the network * Altic Engineering and Architecture * Altic Network Rules and Governance * Altic Operations, Business Development and Partnerships **Why This Role Is Different** This role offers: * The chance to connect network participant types that have never been connected for this asset class. There is no existing integration pattern for alternatives inside a managed account, because the flow did not exist. * Ownership of an integration product, not an integration project. Success is a reusable interface that shortens every subsequent onboarding, rather than a delivered connection. * Real technical heterogeneity to solve for. Modern APIs on one side, nightly flat files on the other, and a trade that has to complete across all of it. * A specification that already exists. The rules and technical specification are being written alongside you, so you are building against something rather than guessing. * A measurable target. Less than 0\.01 per cent not\-in\-good\-order is not a slogan, and connectivity design is most of how it gets hit. The network is real to a network participant at exactly the point their systems connect to it. That point is yours. **How you will provide meaningful contributions:** **What You'll Actually Be Doing** This role is technical, external and detail\-heavy. On any given week, you might be: * Sitting with a custodian's technology team working out which of their existing feeds can carry an alternatives position, and what has to be built if none of them can. * Mapping a transfer agent's file layout to the network data model and finding the three fields nobody actually populates. * Deciding whether a new counterparty gets an API integration or a file\-based one, and being honest with them about the trade\-off. * Working out why a subscription order completed at the platform and then failed downstream at the fund administrator. * Designing the standard interface for wealth platforms so the next one onboards in weeks rather than quarters. * Prototyping a transformation or a validation yourself rather than raising a ticket and waiting to find out whether the idea works. **Key Responsibilities** **Integration Architecture and Data Flow** * Own how data flows between network participants and Altic across the full lifecycle of an alternatives trade, including orders, confirmations, positions, activity and cash. * Design the target\-state connectivity pattern for each network participant type rather than accumulating bilateral integrations. * Decide where each integration sits on the spectrum from real\-time API t can run a design session with another firm's engineers, hold your own on their architecture, and leave with a specification both sides agree on. **Hands\-on with AI:** actively excited about using the latest AI techniques to automate and prototype. Comfortable across AI, no\-code and low\-code tools, and inclined to build a working thing rather than write a requirements document about it. **Domain experience (beneficial, not required):** any of the following gives you a head start, and none of them on its own is the role: DTCC Fund/SERV, NSCC Networking or AIP; direct experience inside a custodian, transfer agent, fund administrator or wealth platform; alternatives operations or product experience from a firm such as iCapital or CAIS; order management or trading platform integration; knowledge of the wealth management channel and managed accounts, including model\-driven and portfolio\-driven trading. **Personal Attributes** * Reads the file before asking what is in it. * Comfortable with counterparties who cannot change, and designs around them without complaint. * Shows rather than tells. Defaults to a working prototype over a slide deck. * Treats a production failure as a design signal rather than an operational nuisance. * Precise about detail without losing sight of why the integration exists. **About InvestCloud** InvestCloud, a global leader in wealth technology, aspires to enable a smarter financial future. Driving the digital transformation of the wealth management industry, the company serves a broad array of clients globally, including Wealth and Asset Managers, Wirehouses, Banks, RIAs, and Insurers. In terms of scale, the company’s clients represent more than 40 percent of the $132 trillion of total assets globally. As a leader in delivering personalization and scale across advisory programs, including unified managed accounts (UMA) and separately managed accounts (SMA), the company is committed to the success of its clients. By equipping and enabling advisors and their clients with connected technology, enhanced intelligence, and inspired experiences, InvestCloud delivers leading digital wealth management and financial planning solutions, complemented by a dynamic data warehouse, which scale across the complete wealth continuum. In 2024, InvestCloud was named CNBC World’s Top Fintech Company, a proof point of the company’s commitment to innovation and client success. Headquartered in the United States, InvestCloud serves clients around the world. For more information, visit InvestCloud.com (https://nam10\.safelinks.protection.outlook.com/?url\=https%3A%2F%2Finvestcloud.com%2F\&data\=05%7C02%7Chjacobsen%40investcloud.com%7Ced84e5c3e8524e4d5c1e08dce318b0e3%7C134fa738eba84721a959151561c6c68e%7C0%7C0%7C638634942404266514%7CUnknown%7CTWFpbGZsb3d8eyJWIjoiMC4wLjAwMDAiLCJQIjoiV2luMzIiLCJBTiI6Ik1haWwiLCJXVCI6Mn0%3D%7C0%7C%7C%7C\&sdata\=MWVDvATUCh92zSkL%2F9PonMNS3hr8Zqp2xaVJmF4Vbx8%3D\&reserved\=0\). **Our Values** * Client Connected * Human Centered * Technology Forward * Respect \+ Integrity * Excellence The actual salary will vary based on applicant’s education, experience, skills, and abilities, as well as internal equity and alignment with market data. The salary may also be adjusted based on the applicant’s geographic location. Salary range: $200,000 \- $225,000\. Benefits include medical/Rx, dental, vision, disability, and life/AD\&D insurance plans, Flexible Savings Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA), Employee Assistance Plan (EAP), health advocacy, voluntary ancillary plans (accident, critical illness, hospital indemnity, legal, identity theft, auto/home, and pet insurance), 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match, and paid time off. \#LI\-BH1 Equal Opportunity Employer This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws. jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description: **About Abode Money** --------------------- Abode Money is the first financial manager for homeowners. We save homeowners money on property taxes, insurance, mortgage and more, every year. Our vision is to be the first to create an ongoing relationship with 80M\+ homeowners. Homeowners spend $2T\+ a year on their homes with almost no help. We're the first and only company that can lower property taxes in all 50 states, and there's no better way into the homeowner relationship than the bill everyone hates. Most consumer fintechs are building slightly better versions of products that already exist. We're using AI to turn work that has always been a service into software, and there has never been a better moment to do it. We've raised $25M from Permanent, Drive, Sequoia, Core VC and 81 Collection. **The Role** ------------ This is the most AI\-pilled role at Abode. You're just as much product and design as you are engineer, and you use AI in every part of the job to move faster than anyone thinks is possible. You'll build the first version of new products, features, and flows in days, push code every day, and work directly with the CEO and growth team to see the impact in the numbers. **What You’ll Do** ------------------ * **Launch New Products Fast:** Build MVPs of new products, features, and flows in days, from insurance and mortgage to whatever we bet on next. * **Ship Every Day:** Push code daily and turn funnel ideas into production tests fast. * **Own Product and Design:** Decide what to build, design the flow, and make the UX calls yourself. * **Build with AI:** Use AI across the whole stack to move faster, and show the rest of the team how. * **Measure Everything:** Instrument what you build and use the data to decide what's next. **Who You Are** --------------- * In Austin or willing to relocate. We work in person 5 days a week. * 5\+ years shipping consumer\-facing product * Strong with React, TypeScript, and a modern backend * Use AI for nearly everything you build and are always testing new tools * Have product and design taste, and care how the product feels to the customer * Are a former founder or early\-stage engineer who owns outcomes **Our Values** -------------- We hire people who want to own their work outright. * **Take ownership.** You get more autonomy here than almost anywhere else. Own the outcome, make the calls, and see it through. * **Move fast.** Speed is our only advantage, so we ship first and refine after. Sometimes that means fixing things in the open, and we're fine with that. * **Dive deep.** Go to the source. Pull the data, read the county code, call the assessor. The details are where we win. * **Be intellectually curious.** Learn new domains fast and keep asking why. Now is the time to work smarter, and AI is how we do it. * **Go all in.** We work hard and put in long hours because the window in front of us won't stay open forever. We're looking for people who want to do the same. **Compensation** ---------------- $170,000 – $220,000 base, plus equity Compensation Range: $170K \- $220K

jobs.title: Senior Embedded Linux Applications Engineer
jobs.description: Full\-time Hybrid (average of 2\-3 days in office per week) Mars Hill, NC $125,000 \- $160,000 \+ benefits About Us The Ammortal Chamber integrates five science\-backed modalities into one immersive 25\-minute session. Our clients include wellness clinics and spas, sports teams and athletic departments, hotels, and individuals who bring the Chamber into their homes. We are a small team with a startup culture. Hardware and software engineers, health professionals, and operators work side by side. Since shipping our first product we have grown steadily, and the software that drives the Chamber is now at the center of what comes next. This role offers hands\-on ownership, room to grow into technical leadership, and a direct hand in shaping how the Chamber works for the people who use it. What is this role and why does it exist? This role centers on Linux systems software for the Chamber: building and owning the application\-level software that runs on embedded Linux and interfaces with hardware over common serial and bus protocols — the software layer that sits above the firmware and drives the product. You help make the architectural calls, set the standard for code quality and testing, and serve as a go\-to person when a hardware\-software problem needs solving. You'll work closely with the hardware team, OT partners, and the rest of the software team, and you'll help level up teammates who are earlier in their careers. follows problems through to resolution * **Attention to Detail:** Organized and methodical in development, testing, and debugging * **Continuous Learning:** Stays current and curious across languages, tools, and patterns * **Customer Focus:** Understands how technical decisions affect the people using the product * **Communication:** Works well across disciplines and translates between hardware, software, and business needs * **Comfortable Multitasking:** Manages multiple priorities and shifts context without losing the thread * **Team Collaboration:** Works effectively in a small, cross\-disciplinary team; enjoys helping others grow and gives clear, constructive feedback **Requirements** What technical knowledge do you need to perform in your role?**Required** * Strong proficiency in Go, C, or C\+\+, and at least one high\-level language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) * Hands\-on experience interfacing software with hardware over serial or bus protocols (for example Modbus, I2C, SPI, RS\-485, or similar) * Deep familiarity with Linux environments, the command line, and system\-level debugging * Experience designing and shipping production software in a microservice or distributed architecture * Experience with Git and modern CI/CD practices * Understanding of software development lifecycle and testing practices **Preferred** * Experience with MQTT or other IoT communication protocols * Experience with Docker and containerized deployments on embedded or edge hardware * Familiarity with Debian\-based Linux systems * Experience with Next.js, React, and TypeScript * Familiarity with shell scripting (Bash) * Familiarity with a project tracking tool (Asana, Linear, Jira, or similar) * Familiarity with AI\-collaboration tools and agents Qualifications**Must haves** * 5\+ years of professional software engineering experience, with meaningful time spent on Linux\-based systems **Nice to haves** * Previous experience in an embedded Linux, IoT, robotics, industrial automation, or connected hardware role * Previous experience with real\-time or safety\-conscious systems * Contributions to open\-source or personal projects demonstrating depth in systems software **Benefits** Pay, Location, Hours* Pay range: $125,000 \- $160,000 * Benefits: 80% health, dental, and vision covered. * Flexible paid time off. * Location: Hybrid in the Asheville, NC area. Onsite at least 2 days per week, can be more some weeks depending on current assignments. * Relocation assistance available if you do not currently live in the Greater Asheville area or within commuting distance to Mars Hill, NC.

jobs.title: Senior GRC Engineer
jobs.description: At Anaplan, we are a team of innovators focused on optimizing business decision\-making through our leading AI\-infused scenario planning and analysis platform so our customers can outpace their competition and the market. What unites Anaplanners across teams and geographies is our collective commitment to our customers' success and to our Winning Culture. Our customers rank among the who's who in the Fortune 50\. Coca\-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400\+ global companies who rely on our best\-in\-class platform. Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebratingour wins – big and small. Supported by operating principles of being strategy\-led, values\-based and disciplined in execution, you'll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let's build what's next \- together! Security Trust \& Risk owns governance, risk, compliance, vendor \& customer assurance, and business continuity across Anaplan's ecosystem. This role is a genuine ground\-floor opportunity. You'll help build the technical backbone that lets GRC operate as an engineering discipline, moving away from point\-in\-time audits and risk scores to a continuously measured heartbeat that drives prioritization and high\-visibility, high\-impact decisions. **This role is based in our New York office and requires a hybrid schedule with in\-person attendance twice a week.** As an **Engineer III, Security and Compliance**, you're the technical bridge between GRC and the rest of the business. You're comfortable sitting in a room with engineering and talking architecture some days, and on other days, feeling confident on a customer call and translating security into practice to build trust. Your north star is compliance by design: instead of audits being a point\-in\-time scramble to assemble evidence, they should be a natural byproduct of controls, monitoring, and processes that run continuously, year\-round. A core part of that is thinking in terms of build once, apply to many: using our cross\-framework control crosswalk to identify where requirements across our certified standards — including ISO 27001, 27017, 27018, 27701, and 42001, SOC 1/2 Type 2, Cyber Essentials, ENS, and TX\-RAMP — genuinely overlap, so our partners build to a single common control instead of a different bespoke solution for every certification. As important as the automation itself is, it's also about making the reasoning behind it visible: helping partners across the business understand the why behind a given control, whether it traces back to a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat, not just the what. Over time, you'll develop genuine fluency in how the Anaplan product and platform work, how we manage our infrastructure and internal systems, and where our security controls live operationally. **Your Impact** --------------- * Act as a technical GRC partner to technical and non\-technical teams, translating compliance, governance, and risk requirements into implementation details, and engaging credibly in architecture/design discussions * Use the cross\-framework control crosswalk to identify synergies across regulatory requirements, so engineers build one common solution instead of duplicating effort per certification * Support customer\-facing security/compliance conversations requiring deeper technical context (platform architecture, control implementation, how obligations are met) * Build the processes, scripts, workflows, and tooling that embed controls into daily operations, and design automation that keeps compliance/risk data current continuously rather than refreshed only ahead of audits * Create knowledge\-sharing resources and clear documentation/diagrams that help partners understand the reasoning behind a control — whether it's a compliance obligation, a customer request, or an emerging threat — not just the mechanics of it * Partner with Risk Management to engineer risk identification, scoring, and monitoring into day\-to\-day operations; support continuous monitoring (ConMon) across Compliance, Risk, and Governance; and build working knowledge of the Anaplan product/platform over time **Your Qualifications** ----------------------- * 6\+ years in security engineering, GRC, DevSecOps, or a closely related technical role, with hands\-on exposure to compliance/regulatory frameworks * Comfortable writing scripts or light code (Python, Bash, or similar) to automate evidence collection, reporting, or monitoring tasks * Working knowledge of at least two of: ISO 27001 and its extensions (27017, 27018, 27701, 42001\), SOC 1/2, Cyber Essentials, or similar, including experience using a cross\-framework control mapping/crosswalk to reduce duplicate implementation effort * Comfortable building and reading system/data\-flow diagrams, and proficient with a GRC/risk platform (e.g., Drata, Vanta, Hyperproof, Archer, OneTrust, ServiceNow GRC, or similar) * Experience translating compliance/risk requirements into implementation guidance engineering teams can act on * Comfort engaging directly with both engineering teams and customers on technical topics, and building process/tooling in a growing function ### **Nice\-to\-Have** * Hands\-on experience applying AI/LLM tooling to a real operational workflow — for example, automating a repetitive review step or summarizing evidence for a control * Familiarity with OSCAL or similar machine\-readable control languages * Experience with quantitative or semi\-quantitative risk scoring methodologies (e.g., FAIR or similar) * Experience with FedRAMP and/or HIPAA/HITRUST is a plus — especially if you have experience across more than one of these * Experience supporting external audits or assessments as a technical point of contact * Certifications such as CISA, CISSP, or ISO 27001 Lead Implementer \#LI\-SP1 **Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)** We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. DEIB improves our workforce, enhances trust with our partners and customers, and drives business success. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren't just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it's how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. We believe in a hiring and working environment where all people are respected and valued, regardless of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion, ethnicity, age, neurodiversity, disability status, citizenship, or any other aspect which makes people unique. We hire you for who you are, and we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day! We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, perform essential job functions, and receive equitable benefits and all privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation. **Fraud Recruitment Disclaimer** It has come to our attention that fraudulent and fictitious job opportunities are being circulated on the Internet. Prospective candidates are being contacted by certain individuals, mainly through telephone calls, emails and correspondence, claiming they are representatives of Anaplan. The main purpose of these correspondences and announcements is to obtain privileged information from individuals. Anaplan does not: * Extend offers to candidates without an extensive interview process with a member of our recruitment team and a hiring manager via video or in person. * Send job offers via email. All offers are first extended verbally by a member of our internal recruitment team whenever possible and then followed up via written communication. All emails from Anaplan would come from an @anaplan.com email address. Should you have any doubts about the authenticity of an email, letter or telephone communication purportedly from, for, or on behalf of Anaplan, please send an email to people@anaplan.com before taking any further action in relation to the correspondence. **Privacy \& AI** **Notice** Candidate data processed during our recruitment activities is handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Notice. This may include the use of artificial intelligence or automated tools to assist our team in evaluating qualifications.

jobs.title: Principal Engineer Capacity/Compute
jobs.description: **About Anthropic** ------------------- Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems. **About the Role** ------------------ Anthropic manages one of the largest and fastest\-growing infrastructure fleets in the industry — spanning multiple accelerator families, cpu families and clouds. The Capacity Engineering team is responsible for making sure all our infrastructure resources are accounted for, well\-utilized, and efficiently allocated. We own the data, tooling, and operational systems that let Anthropic plan, measure, and maximize utilization across first\-party and third\-party compute. As an engineer on Capacity Engineering, you will build the production systems that power this work: data pipelines that ingest and normalize telemetry from heterogeneous cloud environments, observability tooling that gives the org real\-time visibility into fleet health, and performance instrumentation that measures how efficiently every major workload uses the hardware it’s running on. You will be expected to write production\-quality code every day, operate alongside Kubernetes\-native infrastructure at meaningful scale, and directly influence decisions around one of Anthropic’s largest areas of spend. You’ll collaborate closely with research engineering, infrastructure, inference, and finance teams. The work requires someone who can move between data engineering, systems engineering, and observability with comfort — and who thrives in a high\-autonomy, high\-ambiguity environment. **This is a pipeline role feeding four areas.** **Depending on your background and business priority, you’ll focus primarily in one, but the boundaries are fluid and the problems overlap:** * **Data platform** Pipelines that ingest occupancy and utilization telemetry from Kubernetes clusters, normalize billing and usage across cloud providers, and serve the BigQuery tables the rest of the org queries against. Correctness, completeness, and latency are the job, not a footnote. Consumers range from research engineers to finance to leadership, so it's product work as much as engineering: defining schema contracts, making data discoverable, and figuring out what people actually need. * **Planning** Knowing what the fleet has, where it's going, and what's in the way. Making the state of the fleet legible and actionable in real time: cluster health tooling, capacity planning platforms, alerting on occupancy drops and allocation problems, and systemic fixes to scheduling and fragmentation. Kubernetes operations on one side, cross\-team coordination on the other. * **Efficiency** Measuring and improving how effectively every major workload uses the hardware it runs on. Instrumenting utilization across training, inference, and eval systems, building benchmarking infrastructure, establishing per\-config baselines, and working directly with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. The metric has to be good enough that the team on the hook for it agrees with the number. * **Attribution and forecasting** Connecting what the fleet costs to what the business is doing with it. Reconciling CSP billing exports against vendor telemetry and internal systems with mismatched schemas, attributing spend to the workloads and teams that generate it, and turning inference demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan. Efficiency metrics have to survive contact with finance: stripped of pure demand and unit\-price effects, reproducible month over month, and legible to a CFO. **Key responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build the planning and allocation stack — the tools leadership uses to allocate capacity, teams use to plan against their allocations, and the scheduler enforces. Cross\-region and cross\-provider placement, guardrails, queueing, occupancy KPIs. * Drive the efficiency programs: stranding and rightsizing, unused capacity recovery, and job\-level utilization across training, inference, and eval. Establish per\-config baselines and work with system\-owning teams to close the gaps. Utilization improvements are worth enormous sums at our scale. * Own attribution and forecasting — reconcile billing across ten\-plus providers against telemetry and internal systems, attribute spend to the workloads that generate it, and turn demand signals and research roadmaps into a defensible compute plan and supply pipeline. * Build the data platform underneath all of it: pipelines ingesting occupancy, utilization, and cost from a rapidly diversifying fleet into BigQuery, with real ownership of completeness, latency SLOs, and gap detection. Every new provider is a net\-new integration. * Operate Kubernetes\-native systems at scale — collection agents, workload labeling, and th ow the data gets consumed. * Storage efficiency, retention, and lifecycle program experience at exabyte scale. The annual compensation range for this role is listed below. For sales roles, the range provided is the role’s On Target Earnings ("OTE") range, meaning that the range includes both the sales commissions/sales bonuses target and annual base salary for the role. Annual Salary: $320,000 \- $485,000 USD **Logistics** ------------- **Minimum education:** Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience **Required field of study:** A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience **Minimum years of experience:** Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position **Location\-based hybrid policy:** Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices. **Visa sponsorship:** We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this. **We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification.** Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team. **Your safety matters to us.** To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings. **How we're different** ----------------------- We believe that the highest\-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large\-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long\-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest\-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills. The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT\-3, Circuit\-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI \& Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences. **Come work with us!** ---------------------- Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. **Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage:** Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

jobs.description: Imagine what you could do here at Apple? Together we could help craft the next generation of the world’s finest devices. jobs.title: Graphics Software Content Engineer
jobs.description: Do you love problem solving and creating elegant solutions to highly complex technical challenges? As part of our Silicon Engineering team, you’ll help develop and manufacture our next\-generation, high\-performance, power\-efficient graphics processors! You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining this team means you’ll be responsible for designing and building workloads that ensure Apple devices are best\-in\-class. Join us to help deliver the next groundbreaking product containing an Apple GPU! In this highly impactful role, you will be responsible for graphics workloads used by teams involved in all stages of the GPU development lifecycle, from early feature specification through silicon bring\-up and beyond. You will work with other teams at engineering sites around the globe towards the shared goal of ensuring that Apple GPUs meet the highest quality and efficiency standards. This job involves designing, developing, and maintaining workloads for GPU architectural validation and design verification. **Description** Join the team to play a central role in developing upcoming Apple GPUs. You will have the opportunity to help develop the tools and techniques used to ensure the GPU is functional, performant, and within the expected power envelope. In this role, you will work alongside many other teams involved in GPU development, including but not limited to Architecture, Modeling, Performance, Power, Design Verification, Silicon Validation, Software, and Manufacturing.","responsibilities":"Core responsibilities of this highly collaborative role are: Developing critical workloads for GPU validation (architecture, functionality, performance, power). Working with the GPU hardware teams from design bring\-up through post\-silicon, to identify and debug architectural, logic, and silicon issues. Working with the GPU software teams during production driver bring\-up to rapidly identify and resolve software issues. Create bit\-accurate C/C\+\+ models for hardware verification. **Preferred Qualifications** Knowledge of graphics rendering algorithms and the software graphics pipeline, applied to computer graphics and/or ML Experience with GPU APIs or shading languages (Metal, OpenGL, DirectX, Vulkan, CUDA) Knowledge of hardware architecture and/or graphics hardware Architectural validation and design verification experience Relevant coursework or projects in Computer Graphics or Computer Architecture Strong communication and teamwork skills **Minimum Qualifications** B.S. degree and 3 years of experience Experience with C/C\+\+ programming

jobs.title: ML Data & Eval Engineer, Siri Agent Modeling
jobs.description: The frontier of AI isn't in the cloud anymore. It's in your pocket. Every model that runs on a user's device depends on a lot of systems behind it: data pipelines that decide what it learns, infrastructure that trains and evaluates it at scale, and tooling that gets it efficiently onto Apple silicon. At Apple's Siri team, we're building the next generation of agents and deploying them at the largest customer scale in the world. We're looking for generalist engineers who like working across the whole ML lifecycle. You might build a data pipeline one quarter and a training platform the next, wherever the biggest bottleneck is. This role is for builders who want end\-to\-end ownership of the data and infrastructure behind frontier on\-device ML, from raw data to silicon. **Description** As an ML Data \& Eval Engineer, you'll work closely with Siri on\-device modeling, evaluation, and deployment teams, and with Apple's ML platform, compute, framework, and privacy partners. You'll design, build, and run the systems that turn data into trained, evaluated, and deployable on\-device models. You'll own your services and data products through every stage: conception, design, implementation, deployment, and maintenance.","responsibilities":"Your Playground: Data as a Product: Build scalable pipelines for curating, filtering, deduplicating, augmenting, and versioning the data behind our LLMs and agents. This includes fine\-tuning sets, preference data, tool\-use trajectories, evaluation sets, and synthetic data generated by models. Evaluation at Scale: Build the systems that run large evaluation suites for agentic models, including sandboxed environments for tool use and multi\-step tasks, so every checkpoint gets measured quickly and consistently. Path to Device: Build the pipelines that take models from training to Apple silicon, including conversion, compression and quantization workflows, on\-device benchmarking, and regression tracking, so every candidate model can be checked against real device constraints. Velocity at Scale: Find and remove bottlenecks across the ML lifecycle, including data loading, experiment tracking, and artifact management, so modelers spend their time on models and not on plumbing. Quality \& Privacy by Design: Build data quality checks, lineage, and governance tooling that keep our datasets and models trustworthy and consistent with Apple's privacy principles. We're a team that values velocity and pragmatism. We debate, we build, we measure, and we ship. You are an ideal candidate if you've ever been woken up by a failed pipeline or training job and fixed it so it never happens again. **Preferred Qualifications** Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related discipline, or equivalent industry experience. 4\+ years of industry experience building production data or ML infrastructure. Experience building data pipelines for LLMs, such synthetic data generation, LLM\-as\-judge filtering, or evaluation sets Experience with workflow orchestrators such as Airflow, Kubeflow, or Argo Experience with model conversion and optimization for on\-device or edge deployment (e.g. Core ML, quantization, pruning) Experience with data quality, lineage, and dataset versioning tools, and with privacy\-preserving data practices Experience building tools and services that optimize ML systems beyond model selection Collaborative, with experience driving large cross\-team projects **Minimum Qualifications** Strong computer science background in algorithms, data structures, and distributed systems design Strong proficiency in Python, plus hands\-on experience with Docker, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure Experience building large\-scale data processing pipelines (e.g. Spark, Ray) or distributed ML infrastructure Familiarity with the ML model lifecycle (training, evaluation, deployment) and frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX Experience building, deploying, and debugging production services and data products end to end Experience with agentic AI\-assisted coding **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $150,400 and $277,600, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. The ideal candidate is focused on product and experience, takes ownership of ambiguous problems, and has a strong foundation in machine learning and graphics. You survey the state of the art before committing to a direction, build working prototypes quickly, and reach out to partner teams to close technical gaps. Turn research prototypes into polished, robust, power\-efficient product features within tight production cycles. Optimize workloads across CPU, GPU, Apple Neural Engine, and Private Cloud Compute to meet strict thermal, latency, and memory budgets. Share progress, trade\-offs, and results with the team and leadership through regular demos and presentations. **Preferred Qualifications** MS in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computer Graphics, or related field. Experience with 3D reconstruction, neural rendering such as Gaussian splatting, or generative models for inpainting and outpainting. Experience with camera pose estimation, SLAM, or AR frameworks such as ARKit. Exposure to GPU programming with Metal, CUDA, or similar. Experience with Swift or Objective\-C on Apple platforms. Fluency with AI\-assisted and agentic coding tools. Track record of successful industry internships. **Minimum Qualifications** BS in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or related field. Strong programming skills in Python, with working knowledge of C or C\+\+. Hands\-on experience with modern deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or JAX. Solid foundation in machine learning, computer vision, 3D graphics, or related domains. Demonstrated interest in keeping up with state\-of\-the\-art research. jobs.title: Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) & Service Health Program Engineer, Infrastructure Services
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless.Do you love building solutions to handle global complexity and immense scale? Imagine what you could do here. Infrastructure Services is part of IS\&T and the foundation of Apple's global network operations \- managing data center equipment and systems to deliver compute, storage, and networking services for teams across Apple, including its internal developer community. From individual facilities to a worldwide network, Infrastructure Services ensures the technology underneath everything works without question **Description** Edge Production Engineering keeps Apple’s edge infrastructure operating reliably and resiliently at massive global scale. Our ecosystem encompasses CDN and high\-throughput reverse proxy services, authoritative and recursive DNS, Global Server Load Balancing (GSLB), and distributed Edge Cloud and compute platforms. Together, these systems deliver critical traffic routing, caching, and infrastructure services to hundreds of millions of users worldwide. When incidents occur across this multifaceted stack, our ability to coordinate effectively, learn quickly, adapt rigorously, and prevent repeat issues is essential. We are seeking a Post\-Incident Reviews (PIR) \& Service Health Program Engineer to help coordinate and drive our PIR lifecycle, remediation tracking, and service health governance across Edge Production Engineering. In this role, your background in incident response and management will be central to your success. You will guide PIR debriefs with structure and neutrality, ask insightful questions to uncover root causes, ensure remediation action items don’t fall through the cracks, and bring a forward\-thinking mindset to leverage Generative AI and modern automation to make our incident learning workflows faster, lighter, and more productive for engineers. ","responsibilities":"PIR Meeting Facilitation: Coordinate and facilitate PIRs for service degradations, outages, and near\-misses across Edge services. Documentation Quality: Review and refine incident summaries, timelines, and action items to ensure clarity, factual accuracy, and clear reasoning before sharing with broader teams and leadership. Action Item Ownership: Track and govern issue\-tracking boards containing corrective and preventative action items across Edge service teams. Regular Service Syncs: Run recurring check\-ins with service owners and technical leads across DNS, CDN/proxy, GSLB, and compute teams to review backlogs, update progress live, flag blockers, and keep action items moving forward. Accountability Through Partnership: Build collaborative relationships across engineering, operations, and infrastructure teams to ensure agreed\-upon fixes are completed. Tooling Alignment: Collaborate with central incident management teams to align on shared templates, standardized reporting, and automated incident bot tooling. Continuous Improvement: Look for practical ways to make the PIR process smoother, lighter, and more valuable for engineers. Support Domain Champions: Partner with and support embedded incident leads across individual Edge engineering domains. Promote Blameless Culture: Encourage psychological safety, open communication, and a constructive, learning\-first approach to incidents. **Preferred Qualifications** Strong meeting facilitation and communication skills, with the poise to lead structured, blameless debriefs with senior engineers and leadership. Familiarity with DNS, CDN, and basic networking principles. Technical curiosity and literacy: comfortable collaborating with engineering teams in complex infrastructure or cloud environments to translate technical discussions into clear root\- cause narratives. Interest or hands\-on experience leveraging Generative AI tools (e.g., LLM prompting, workflow automation, or scripting) to summarize incident data, draft timelines, and streamline program workflows. Experience defining, modernizing, or standardizing PIR templates, severity guidelines, or service health metrics. Experience partnering with central incident management organizations or working with automated incident response bots and tooling. **Minimum Qualifications** 3\+ years of experience in Incident Management, Major Incident Management (MIM), Incident Response, or Technical Support Operations. Demonstrated experience coordinating major incident response, facilitating incident bridge calls, or conducting post\-incident reviews/retrospectives. Hands\-on experience managing operational action items, incident remediation tracking, or process governance using ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, or equivalent platforms). jobs.title: SOC Design Verification Engineer
jobs.description: Apple’s wireless chip powers connectivity across every new iPhone \- and its successor is already taking shape. Would you like to join Apple’s growing wireless silicon development team? Our wireless SOC organization owns every aspect of wireless silicon development, with a particular emphasis on highly energy\-efficient design and new technologies that transform the user experience at the product level. It is driven by a world\-class, vertically integrated team spanning RF/Analog, Systems/PHY/MAC, VLSI/RTL design and integration, Emulation, Design Verification, Test and Validation, and FW/SW engineering. As a Wireless SOC Design Verification Engineer, you’ll be at the heart of the chip design effort \- owning a meaningful verification scope and growing it project to project. **Description** You’ll be responsible for pre\-silicon RTL verification at the block, subsystem, and top\-level SOC, taking your scope from test planning through coverage closure and signoff. Working closely with architects, designers, and firmware engineers, you’ll build reusable testbenches and verification environments using modern, metric\-driven methodology. Areas you may work on include the Power Management Unit, CPU subsystem, DMA, on\-chip debug infrastructure, PCIe, bus fabric, boot and secure\-boot sequencing, MAC\-PHY Verification, Radio integration, and peripherals such as SPI \- choosing simulation, formal, or whichever approach the design actually calls for. Low power is part of your scope wherever it shows up: you’ll verify power intent using UPF within your area. Over time, you can grow deeper into the IPs and subsystems you know best, or broader \- across IPs and up from block level to full SOC integration. The team is also pushing hard on AI\-assisted verification, and you’ll help figure out where it fits best: test generation, debug, coverage closure, or all the above.","responsibilities":"Partner with architects and designers early to build detailed verification plans from specifications \- before RTL lands, not after. Develop reusable block/IP and subsystem\-level UVM testbenches, and support IP integration into the SOC. Write directed and constrained\-random tests; create and analyze coverage models and drive coverage closure. Debug failures, including corner cases, and manage bug tracking through resolution. Verify low\-power design intent using UPF within your scope. Verify end\-to\-end WiFi and Bluetooth traffic flows from subsystem level up through top\-level SOC integration. Apply formal verification where it fits \- the team will help you ramp up. Build and improve automated regression flows and contribute to methodology in your area. Explore and apply AI\-assisted verification techniques to improve team productivity. Participate in verification reviews and uphold high coding\-quality standards. Support post\-silicon bring\-up as needed. **Preferred Qualifications** Experience taking at least one ASIC/SOC from concept through tape\-out. Verification experience with PCIe, bus fabric/NOC, or AHB/AXI\-based architectures in a UVM environment. Experience verifying IP or top\-level integration for a WiFi or Bluetooth SOC, or knowledge of wireless protocols. Experience with low\-power verification, UPF, boot\-up, power\-cycling, and HW/FW interaction. Experience with SystemVerilog Assertions (SVA) and/or formal tools (e.g., JasperGold). Experience defining coverage space and writing coverage models. Experience with embedded CPU verification; programming in C/C\+\+ or assembly. Scripting in Python or Perl; interest in applying AI/ML to verification workflows Great teammate with excellent communication skills and the desire to take on diverse challenges. **Minimum Qualifications** Minimum requirement of a bachelors degree. Hands\-on experience across the verification cycle: test planning, testbench implementation, test creation and debug, and coverage closure. Strong SystemVerilog and Verilog skills, with solid working knowledge of UVM. Solid problem\-solving and debugging skills with constrained\-random verification. Understanding of digital logic design, SOC architecture, and microarchitecture. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $122,700 and $214,300, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation.
