jobs.title: Senior Engineering Program Manager, Lead , Service Special Projects
jobs.description: We are looking for a highly seasoned Senior Engineering Program Manager to help get one of our most ambitious multi\-year engineering programs off the ground. This is a hands\-on, lead\-level role for a program manager who has stood up large, technically deep, multi\-team efforts from the earliest days \- and who thrives when the problem is broad, the org is scaling up around them, and the technical stakes are high. You will be the connective tissue across engineering, research, design, and business functions from day one, turning an ambitious vision into a coordinated, measurable plan of record \- and then driving it to landing. **Description** You will own the end\-to\-end program management of a large\-scale, cross\-functional engineering initiative spanning client software, backend services, large\-scale data systems, applied machine learning, evaluation, tooling, and platform engineering. You will be accountable for the plan of record \- roadmap, milestones, dependencies, risks, and the executive\-level narrative \- and for the operating cadence that keeps every team aligned on what is expected, by when, and why. You will need to be technical enough to hold your own in an architectural review and in a candid scoping conversation with a Principal engineer. You will not write production code, but you will read designs, ask sharp questions, and translate deeply technical discussions into crisp, faithful summaries for leadership. When the program drifts, you will identify it early, name it clearly, and drive the correction with calm authority. This is a lead role: alongside your own workstreams, you will shape the program\-management practice \- mentoring more junior EPMs, standardizing how progress is tracked, and raising the bar for how we plan and communicate. **Preferred Qualifications** Building and owning a credible plan of record \- roadmap, milestones, dependencies, critical path \- for programs with dozens of engineers and multiple partner teams. Landing AI/ML capabilities in production \- moving a system from research prototype through evaluation, hardening, and launch, with explicit quality bars and rollback criteria. Identifying risks early, developing mitigation strategies, and driving conflict resolution across senior technical stakeholders. Navigating ambiguity \- creating clarity when scope, requirements, and priorities are still forming. Tracking many parallel workstreams in real time without losing the thread on any of them. Influencing and aligning teams without direct authority \- including senior engineers, architects, applied researchers, and cross\-functional leaders. Establishing durable operating rhythms \- planning cycles, review cadences, escalation paths, post\-mortems \- that scale with the program. Presenting technical status, trade\-offs, and recommendations to executive audiences with precision and honesty. **Minimum Qualifications** 15\+ years of experience developing program plans and managing complex, cross\-functional engineering programs in a technical product environment, with at least 3\+ years in a lead or principal\-level capacity. 5\+ years leading AI\-first programs end to end \- programs where the core product value is delivered by machine\-learning or large\-language\-model systems, and where planning, scoping, and quality bars are inseparable from model behavior and evaluation. Demonstrated experience running programs that span multiple engineering disciplines \- client, services, data, applied ML, platform, and tooling \- end to end. Strong technical depth: able to read engineering design documents, follow architectural discussions across several disciplines, and independently reason about trade\-offs, dependencies, and risk. Working literacy with the modern AI stack \- model training and evaluation lifecycles, offline vs. online metrics, data pipelines feeding models, latency/cost trade\-offs, and the difference between a research result and a production\-ready capability. Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, including a track record of writing crisp executive updates and delivering technical narratives to senior leadership. BS in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent experience. Advanced degree preferred. **Pay \& Benefits** At Apple, base pay is one part of our total compensation package and is determined within a range. This provides the opportunity to progress as you grow and develop within a role. The base pay range for this role is between $175,500 and $311,700, and your base pay will depend on your skills, qualifications, experience, and location. Apple employees also have the opportunity to become an Apple shareholder through participation in Apple's discretionary employee stock programs. Apple employees are eligible for discretionary restricted stock unit awards, and can purchase Apple stock at a discount if voluntarily participating in Apple's Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You'll also receive benefits including: Comprehensive medical and dental coverage, retirement benefits, a range of discounted products and free services, and for formal education related to advancing your career at Apple, reimbursement for certain educational expenses \- including tuition. Additionally, this role might be eligible for discretionary bonuses or commission payments as well as relocation. jobs.title: Senior Security Software Engineer, Datacenter Infrastructure Security
jobs.description: We are the Foundational Security team in Apple Services Engineering (ASE). We secure the low\-level foundations of Apple's datacenter fleet: hardware\-backed trust, disk encryption, and the systems used to manage every server below the operating system. We're looking for a senior engineer to take technical ownership of the platform that manages our baseboard management controllers. You'll set its engineering and security bar, shape how access is granted and verified, and lead its move toward modern, standards\-based management. You'll work closely with datacenter operations, SRE, hardware, network and detection teams, and become the go\-to expert on managing Apple's fleet securely. **Description** This role owns the design, code and security of a privileged, availability\-critical service. You'll write and review production code. You'll find and remove risk in how the service authenticates users, authorizes them and handles credentials, and you'll make privileged activity visible to the teams who detect misuse. You'll also help modernize how the fleet is managed, bringing along the many internal teams and tools that depend on the platform. Over time, you'll help define what secure out\-of\-band management looks like at Apple. That includes how access is segmented across environments, how firmware is delivered and trusted, and what we require of management controllers in future hardware. It also includes how access should work when the requester is an automated system rather than a person. **Preferred Qualifications** Hands\-on experience with server management technologies such as IPMI, DMTF Redfish, OpenBMC, or vendor BMCs (e.g., HPE iLO, Dell iDRAC) Experience finding and fixing security flaws in networked services through code review, threat modeling or security testing A track record of technical leadership: driving architecture decisions and cross\-team migrations, mentoring engineers, and explaining security trade\-offs to engineers and leadership Experience with gRPC and Protocol Buffers, and with running PostgreSQL in production Experience managing the lifecycle of secrets and credentials at fleet scale, including rotation and emergency access Experience building and operating highly available, distributed services that other teams depend on Familiarity with network segmentation and zero\-trust access patterns, such as identity\-aware proxies Knowledge of firmware security, including secure boot, firmware signing and updates, TPMs and hardware roots of trust Hands\-on experience using AI coding assistants on a production codebase **Minimum Qualifications** 8\+ years of software engineering experience, including end\-to\-end ownership of a production system or platform Deep proficiency in Go, with 5\+ years writing production Go code. Experience building security telemetry for SIEM and detection pipelines (e.g., Splunk, OpenTelemetry) Hands\-on experience with authentication and authorization at scale, including PKI, mTLS, X.509 certificate identity and fine\-grained access control Experience with Swift, and Rust BS/MS in Computer Science or equivalent experience

typing where appropriate, and consistent error handling * Define and enforce testing practices for applied AI (unit tests, integration tests, golden/regression tests) * Implement instrumentation appropriate for debugging and iteration (basic logging/tracing/metrics for AI features) * Ensure reliability and security basics: rate limiting where needed, safe input handling, prompt\-injection awareness, and sensible defaults Experience in shipping data projects to real users * * **Collaboration \& Enablement** * Experience collaborating with software engineers * Work with AI Developers to productionize their experiments regarding improving user workflows * Define workflows: notebook/test repository PR staging production * Document AI infrastructure and best practices * Review code and taking the initiative and finding ways to improve **Nice\-to\-Have** * Experience fine\-tuning or training models * Familiarity with LangChain, Pydantic AI or similar frameworks * Knowledge of prompt engineering and evaluation techniques * Experience with real\-time inference and streaming responses * Background in data engineering or ML engineering * Understanding of RAG architectures * Contributions to open\-source AI/ML projects **What we offer:** * **Competitive compensation** * **Stock Options Plan:** Empowering you to share in our success and growth. * **Cutting\-Edge Tools:** Access to state\-of\-the\-art tools and collaborative opportunities with leading experts in artificial intelligence, physics, hardware and electronic design automation. * **Work\-Life Balance:** Flexible work arrangements in one of our offices with potential options for remote work. * **Professional Growth:** Opportunities to attend industry conferences, present research findings, and engage with the global AI research community. * **Impact\-Driven Culture:** Join a passionate team focused on solving some of the most challenging problems at the intersection of AI and hardware. **Work model \& location expectations:** *Hybrid from Boston office, 3x/week* **Why join us?** At Axiomatic\_AI, you will be working on technology that drives innovation in AI for scientific and engineering As a portfolio company of Brookfield Renewable, we own and operate approximately 2,200 MW of utility\-scale wind, solar, and battery energy storage facilities across 15 U.S. states and Ontario, Canada. Headquartered in New York City, TerraForm Power is committed to delivering reliable, innovative renewable energy solutions that help customers achieve their clean energy goals. Our experienced team manages every aspect of our operations – from power generation and asset management to commercial energy solutions – ensuring the safe, reliable, and efficient performance of our renewable energy facilities. At TerraForm Power, our people are at the heart of our success. We foster a culture built on safety, integrity, collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, while investing in the development of our employees and supporting the communities where we operate through environmental stewardship, charitable giving, and meaningful local partnerships. and fault models for interconnection requests * Interprets interconnection study results and negotiates with the utility to achieve economic interconnection solutions * Supports the Development Team interconnection risk * Reviews, comments, \& summarizes injection, feasibility, system impact, and facilities study reports * Maintains a strong understanding of the technical and procedural * Bachelor's Degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience * A minimum 3 years of experience supporting transmission generator design and interconnection processes * Familiarity with PJM, ISO NE, CAISO, SPP, MISO and SERC grids and interconnection processes a significant plus * Experience in Greenfield Development, Repowering, and/or adding BESS to projects * Broad technical understanding of transmission, including the ability to perform cost\-benefit analyses of design variants to optimize project outcomes * Software Experience in any of: PSCAD, PSSE, and ASPEN is jobs.title: Senior Mobile Developer (Contract)
jobs.description: **Ready to accelerate your career?** Cardata is where driven people make an outsized impact. We're a small but mighty team transforming how businesses manage vehicle reimbursement — replacing outdated programs with smart, automated solutions. Our vision is bold: to provide the most comprehensive, intelligent, and automated software and services for creating ideal vehicle programs. And we're building toward that vision every single day. Join us and you'll find challenge, growth, and the chance to deliver real impact — helping hundreds of companies and thousands of drivers across North America focus on the work that matters most to them. We're hiring a Senior Developer with deep mobile expertise for a small, self\-contained innovation group (Initial three\-month contract, with opportunity for extension or move to full\-time). Working alongside a Product Manager and a web\-focused developer, you will take an ambiguous business problem, turn it into a testable product bet, and build the smallest end\-to\-end experience that can generate meaningful evidence, often in roughly one to two weeks. You will bring early versions back to customers and the market validation group, gather feedback, and rapidly iterate through V1, V2, V3, and beyond. Once the concept is validated, the group will shift from proving the idea to determining what must change for it to become secure, reliable, scalable, and ready for handoff. The group operates like an entrepreneurial startup within the larger organization and owns the path from problem discovery through rapid prototyping, customer and market validation, iterative development, and a validated proof of concept. From there, it determines what is required to harden and scale the product before handing it to the core product and engineering team. The operating principle is simple: build to learn first, then build to scale. During validation, speed comes from controlling scope and making deliberate, reversible technical choices—not from designing the final production architecture before the opportunity is proven. Security, privacy, and responsible data handling remain non\-negotiable throughout. Once an idea demonstrates value, you will work with our Core team at key technical integration points to harden, refactor, or redesign what is needed for scale. jobs.title: Content Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** At CarGurus (NASDAQ: CARG), our mission is to give people the power to reach their destination. We started as a small team of developers determined to bring trust and transparency to car shopping. Since then, our history of innovation and go\-to\-market acceleration has driven industry\-leading growth. In fact, we're the largest and fastest\-growing automotive marketplace, and we've been profitable for over 15 years. **What we do** The market is evolving, and we are too, moving the entire automotive journey online and guiding our customers through every step. That includes everything from the sale of an old car to the financing, purchase, and delivery of a new one. Today, tens of millions of consumers visit CarGurus.com each month, and \~30,000 dealerships use our products. But they're not the only ones who love CarGurus—our employees do, too. We have a people\-first culture that fosters kindness, collaboration, and innovation, and empowers our Gurus with tools to fuel their career growth. Disrupting a trillion\-dollar industry requires fresh and diverse perspectives. Come join us for the ride! **Role overview** We are looking for a Content Engineer to help operate and improve the systems and workflows that power CarGurus content. This is a content\-operations role with strong technical fluency. You will manage structured content in our headless CMS and related databases, coordinate multiple workflows for producing and updating content, and help ensure that every workflow produces accurate, useful, on\-brand, and search\-friendly work. You will work closely with editors, SEO partners, engineers, analysts, and other stakeholders to turn content requirements into repeatable processes. You do not need to be a traditional software engineer. You should be comfortable learning technical systems, working with structured data, troubleshooting workflow issues, and using tools such as AirOps and LLM\-based content workflows to improve the speed and quality of production. **What you'll do** * Manage and maintain a structured database of content, including records, fields, statuses, metadata, templates, relationships, and update schedules. * Operate day\-to\-day publishing and refresh workflows across multiple content types, markets, and production queues. * Coordinate work from intake through review, revision, approval, publishing, and post\-publication quality checks. * Configure and maintain Contentful models, entries, templates, and workflow states within established standards. * Use AirOps, LLM tools, and related AI\-assisted workflows to support content creation, enrichment, updating, and quality control. * Review generated or data\-informed content for accuracy, completeness, clarity, consistency, brand voice, and usefulness to car shoppers. * Monitor workflow output and investigate issues such as missing data, incorrect formatting, duplicate records, broken links, stale content, or failed production steps. * Track answer\-engine optimization (AEO) performance and citation visibility across AI and LLM search experiences; monitor where and how CarGurus content is cited, and use citation data to improve briefs, content structure, internal linking, prompts, and workflow outputs. * Partner with editors and SEO stakeholders to translate briefs, content standards, and search intent into clear workflow requirements. * Maintain production trackers, documentation, QA checklists, and process guides so that work is visible, repeatable, and easy for others to follow. * Identify recurring friction or quality issues and recommend practical improvements to templates, prompts, validations, queue design, and operating procedures. * Support testing of new content formats, data sources, and workflow changes; document results and help determine whether successful approaches should be expanded. **What success looks like** In your first year, you will: * Keep assigned content databases accurate, organized, and up to date. * Run multiple content\-production and refresh workflows reliably against agreed timelines. * Catch and resolve quality issues before they reach customers, or escalate them with clear context when they require another team's support. * Improve the consistency, efficiency, or scalability of at least several recurring content processes. * Build trust with editorial, SEO, engineering, analytics, and other partners by communicating clearly and following work through to completion. * Help the team increase content output without compromising accuracy, usefulness, differentiation, or brand standards. **What you'll bring** * Experience in editorial operations, content operations, content management, publishing, SEO content, digital production, or a related field. * Strong technical fluency and the ability to learn unfamiliar systems quickly. * Experience managing structured content, databases, spreadsheets, CMS platforms, workflow tools, or production queues. * A careful, methodical approach to data quality, content QA, and troubleshooting. * Experience coordinating multiple projects or workflows with competing deadlines and dependencies. * Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain technical or process issues to nontechnical partners. * Good editorial judgment and a clear understanding of what makes content accurate, useful, readable, and consistent. * Comfort working with AI\-assisted content tools while applying human review, fact checking, and quality standards. * The ability to work independently on varied, routine\-to\-moderately complex problems and to ask for help or escalate issues when appropriate. **Helpful experience** * Contentful or another structured content management system. * AirOps, LLM tools, prompt\-based workflows, or other AI\-assisted content\-production systems. * Content modeling, metadata management, taxonomy, templating, or database cleanup. * SEO fundamentals, search intent, internal linking, structured data, or content performance reporting. * Light scripting, spreadsheet automation, API\-based workflows, or no\-code/low\-code tools. * Experience working with automotive content, ecommerce content, marketplace data, or other high\-volume structured content. * Genuine interest in cars, automotive technology, or helping people make informed car\-buying decisions. **Working at CarGurus** We reward our Gurus' curiosity and passion with best\-in\-class benefits and compensation, including equity for all employees, both when they start and as they continue to grow with us. Our career development and corporate giving programs, as well as our employee resource groups (ERGs) and communities, help people build connections while making an impact in personally meaningful ways. A flexible hybrid model and robust time off policies encourage work\-life balance and individual well\-being. Thoughtful perks like daily free lunch, a new car discount, meditation and fitness apps, commuting cost coverage, and more help our people create space for what matters most in their personal and professional lives. CarGurus may require in\-person interviews as part of our hiring process, particularly for positions based in our Boston and Dublin offices. Candidates selected for an in\-person interview will be notified in advance. Please be aware that travel expenses are the responsibility of the candidate. **We welcome all** CarGurus strives to be a place to which people can bring the ultimate expression of themselves and their potential—starting with our hiring process. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, national origin, age, sex, marital status, ancestry, physical or mental disability, veteran status, gender identity, or sexual orientation. We foster an inclusive environment that values people for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. That's why we hope you'll apply even if you don't check every box listed in the job description. We also encourage you to tell your recruiter if you require accommodations to participate in our hiring process due to a disability so we can provide the appropriate support. We want to know what only you can bring to CarGurus. \#LI\-Hybrid

jobs.description: **Field Network Engineer \- ITS Infrastructure \| Hybrid, Washington, DC 20003 \| Government Contract through September 2027** **Job Type:** Contract (W2 only, no 1099, no Corp\-to\-Corp) **Pay:** $69\.74 per hour **Location:** Hybrid, DDOT, 250 M Street SE, Washington, DC 20003, with field work across the District **About the Opportunity** Changing Technologies, Inc. manage VPN certificates, key rotation, and trust domains * Apply IoT security and segmentation best practices and support security audits, vulnerability assessments, and remediation **Required Skills and Experience** * Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Network Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience * Active CCNA certification * 6\+ years with Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), including traffic signal controllers, CCTV/video surveillance transport, and traffic management * 6\+ years with LTE/5G failover solutions * 6\+ years automating networks with Ansible or Python scripting * 6\+ years with fiber optic networks, including single\-mode fiber design and SFP/SFP\+ transceivers * 6\+ years working with a state or municipal Department of Transportation * 8\+ years with high\-availability network design, redundant architectures, and disaster recovery planning * 5\+ years with IoT security and segmentation best practices * 6\+ years preparing complex technical documentation and explaining technical concepts * Valid driver's license * Able to lift and rack network equipment up to 50 lbs **Preferred Certifications** * CCIE Enterprise Infrastructure * Certified Fiber Optic Technician (CFOT) or equivalent * CompTIA Network\+ or Security\+ * ITIL v4 Foundation **Work Location and Schedule** * Hybrid: DDOT, 250 M Street SE, Washington, DC 20003, plus field work at street\-level cabinets and utility corridors across the District, data center work, and remote support * Full\-time, 8 hours per day, 5 days per week * Scheduled maintenance windows and on\-call availability for after\-hours emergencies * Start date: November 16, 2026; contract through September 30, 2027 * Interview: webcam and in person **Work Authorization** * Must be authorized to work in the United States for the duration of the assignment * CTI participates in E\-Verify; employment eligibility for all hires is verified in compliance with applicable state and federal requirements * This is a W2 engagement only. We do not work with 1099 or Corp\-to\-Corp (C2C) arrangements, and third\-party or agency submissions will not be considered **Why This Role** * Two openings on a District contract of almost a full year * Hands\-on mix of field, data center, and network engineering work * Keep DC's traffic signals, cameras, and IoT devices connected **How to Apply** Submit your resume through Indeed. This requirement has an immediate submission deadline, so apply today. Shortlisted candidates will be contacted promptly. Changing Technologies, Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status. Pay: $69\.74 per hour Benefits: * Health insurance Application Question(s): * This is a W2 only role. We do not do Corp\-to\-Corp or 1099\. Do you accept this requirement? * This role requires an active CCNA certification. Do you hold an active CCNA? * This role includes field work across DC, a valid driver's license, and lifting network equipment up to 50 lbs. Can you meet these requirements with or without reasonable accommodation? Experience: * Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS): 6 years (Required) * High\-availability network design: 8 years (Required) * State or municipal DOT: 6 years (Required) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20003

jobs.title: UI Desktop Engineer Hybird, North Carolina Hybrid
jobs.description: **The application window is expected to close on:** 11/22/2026Meet the Team Our team is part of the Cisco AI and Automation portfolio, responsible for the"Circui" platform—the central AI engine that powers productivity and process automation for all of Cisco. We are a rapidly expanding, high\-impact group dedicated to building the vehicle for AI\-driven business transformation. We operate at the intersection of applied research and production, ensuring our technology is not only cutting\-edge but also optimized for performance, reliability, and functional quality for our 80,000\+ monthly users. As a Desktop UI Developer, you will lead the greenfield effort to bring Circuit to the desktop—building a persistent, ambient, native\-grade experience for macOS and Windows that lives where our users work. Your Impact As a Desktop UI Developer, you will design and build the Circuit Desktop application—a native\-grade, cross\-platform experience for macOS and Windows that brings AI\-driven productivity to the desktop. You bring the full skill set of a modern web UI developer (Angular, Node.js, GCP, Figma\-driven UX, REST APIs) and extend it to the desktop, bridging the gap between our web application and the operating system. **You will own the desktop shell end\-to\-end:** application lifecycle, OS\-level integrations (system tray, notifications, deep linking, always\-on presence), installers, and safe auto\-updates. This is a high\-visibility, high\-ownership role where you will define how tens of thousands of Cisco employees experience Circuit as a first\-class desktop citizen. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain the Circuit Desktop application for macOS and Windows using Electron (or Tauri) with an Angular/TypeScript UI, ensuring a consistent, performant, native\-grade experience across both platforms. Implement desktop\-specific functionality—system tray, native notifications, file system access, deep linking, global shortcuts, and always\-on ambient presence—architecting clean IPC communication between the UI (renderer) and main processes with context isolation and sandboxing. Build responsive AI\-driven interfaces (chat, agents, streaming responses) from Figma designs and UX frameworks, integrating with REST APIs and Node.js services, and reusing Circuit's web design system on the desktop surface. **Packaging, Signing\& Distribution:** Own cross\-platform build pipelines and installers (DMG/PKG for macOS, MSI/NSIS for Windows), including code signing and macOS notarization, hardened runtime, and reliable differential auto\-updates. **Native\& Performance Engineering:** Integrate native modules where needed (Swift/Objective\-C on macOS, C\+\+/C\# on Windows), and profile and optimize startup time, memory, and CPU usage; debug native crashes and manage large local state (SQLite/IndexedDB). Deploy supporting services on Google Cloud Platform, contribute to a multi\-platform CI/CD matrix, and collaborate within an Agile team of designers, backend, platform, and quality engineers. Work with UX and UI designers throughout the product lifecycle, from early feasibility conversations through build and release. Participate in design reviews, give honest input on what is feasible in code, and help scope work so designs can ship without last\-minute compromises. Build interfaces using a shared component library and design tokens, extending existing patterns instead of writing one\-off styles. Keep UI consistent, theme\-aware, and maintainable as the product grows. Implement WCAG 2\.2 AA patterns for dynamic AI interfaces, including ARIA live regions for streaming responses, semantic structure for conversation UIs, focus management across modals and context switches, full keyboard support, and color contrast in light and dark modes. **Research\-informed implementation:** Apply findings from usability testing and end\-user feedback during development. AI\-powered tools, automation, and advanced analytics to streamline financial processes, enhance modeling capabilities, and develop scalable reporting solutions. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Business, or a related field; MBA preferred. * 5–8 years of experience in Strategic Finance, FP\&A, Marketing Finance, or a related analytical function, preferably within a high\-growth consumer technology, marketplace, or eCommerce business. * Demonstrated experience developing LTV/CAC models, evaluating customer acquisition strategies, and influencing pricing, marketing investment, or growth decisions. * Strong understanding of buyer unit economics, cohort analysis, marketing\-channel ROI, customer retention, and payback analysis; SAP, or similar systems preferred. * Proficiency with SQL, Tableau, Looker, Power BI, or comparable analytics and visualization tools is a plus. * Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, or Gemini to improve financial analysis, modeling, reporting, and workflow efficiency. * Strong business acumen and analytical problem\-solving skills, with the ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business recommendations. * Exceptional communication, presentation, and stakeholder management skills, with a proven ability to influence senior leaders and collaborate effectively across Growth Marketing, Product, and Finance. * Experience in sports, collectibles, consumer marketplaces, eCommerce, or other high\-growth, marketing\-driven businesses jobs.title: Integration Support Engineer
jobs.description: **About Flexport:** ------------------- At Flexport, we believe global trade can move the human race forward. That's why it's our mission to make global commerce so easy there will be more of it. We're shaping the future of a $10T industry with solutions powered by innovative technology and exceptional people. Today, companies of all sizes—from emerging brands to Fortune 500s—use Flexport technology to move more than $19B of merchandise across 112 countries a year. The recent global supply chain crisis has put Flexport center stage as we continue to play a pivotal role in how goods move around the world. We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us. **Build the solutions to help Flexport grow** ============================================= The Ecosystem team's mission is to make information exchange in global trade easy for everyone by efficiently, securely and reliably connecting the Flexport Platform with the external Global Trade Ecosystem. **The opportunity** ------------------- We are looking for a talented Integration Support Engineer to join our team! In this role you will be supporting the integrations built to help exchange data between Flexport and our customers and partners.. You will serve as an SME for customers utilizing our self\-service API's, providing technical team members with business knowledge to help us solve our customers API issues.. Integrating our best in class platform seamlessly with our logistics partners is a critical component of our strategy. Our integrated solutions bring end to end automation in the information exchange that is required between us and our partners, eliminating slow and error prone manual workflows. This requires the Flexport platform to be fully integrated with customers and any third party systems our customer uses. The success of our team is measured by the extent to which information exchange between Flexport and our customers is reliably and effectively automated, reducing cost to serve for our operations teams. We're looking for an organized and motivated person to ensure inbound requests are triaged quickly and efficiently, owning all communications with major stakeholders including customers, engineers and platform teams. In addition, you'll work closely with Solutions Engineers and Solutions Consultants to identify process improvements that will maximize the efficiency of the integration support team. You will serve as a technical anchor for our production environment. You will go beyond basic triage to lead deep\-dive technical investigations, implement code or configuration enhancements, and collaborate cross\-functionally to improve the scalability of our ecosystem. You are expected to manage complex stakeholder relationships and act as a subject matter expert (SME) for our integration suite. **You will** ------------ * Proactively support the integrations running in our production environment. This would include monitoring and triaging the inbound requests, providing support for integration issues, owning investigations end to end and contributing to the integration support knowledge base. Drive end\-to\-end resolution for high\-priority production incidents, perform root cause analysis (RCA) and implement permanent fixes or workarounds. * Partner with internal operations, business and technical teams to drive the success rate of these integrations to help bring maximum value to our customers. Lead meetings with customers/third parties by involving required internal team members to help resolve any issues. * Identify and execute improvement enhancements within the integrations or surface platform level improvements. * Work as a technical expert in the logistics space, EDI standards being used by our larger partners for logistics data, Boomi (our iPaaS), and Flexport public (and private) APIs and develop a deep understanding of new and existing integrations. * Partner closely with Product and Engineering teams to transition new integrations from "build" to "support." Act as the voice of the customer to influence the product roadmap based on recurring support trends. * Work efficiently to contribute to a high success rate across all support SLAs by identifying opportunities to optimize existing processes as well as product inefficiencies and also help educate our users on best practice guidelines and overall integration success guidelines * Lead technical calls with high\-value customers and third\-party vendors. You will translate complex technical EDI/API issues into actionable business insights for non\-technical stakeholders. * Create and maintain required charts, dashboards to monitor the health of integrations * Ensure the team meets or exceeds SLAs, taking ownership of the most challenging tickets while identifying systemic bottlenecks in the support workflow. * Share insights and lessons learned about the integration issues you come across with your Flexport Ecosystem peers to continuously improve our processes and efficiency **You should have** ------------------- * Bachelor's degree in a technical field and relevant work experience of minimum 3\-5 years of relevant experience in systems integration, technical support, or implementation engineering. * Good knowledge of APIs (REST/SOAP) and EDI standards. * You should be comfortable reading logs, querying databases, and understanding the flow of data through complex distributed systems. * Experience with data analytics, data manipulation and systems integration involving various data formats using different connectivity methods. * Experience with SQL and at least one scripting or programming language (e.g., JavaScript, Typescript, Python, or Groovy) or Integration platforms like Boomi, Mulesoft, Webmethods etc to assist in data manipulation or small code changes. * Experience using various tools to debug/monitor the transactions like postman, SQL clients, reporting tools like looker and experience working with AWS infrastructure including EC2, S3, SQS and others. * Experience working with AI/LLMs to debug/triage issues, generate reports etc. * Ability to effectively support integrations between Flexport and our customers to achieve a high success rate of these integrations. Work with various internal teams and external partners. Should have passion for helping our users excel with our integrations, offering best practice guidance when opportunities arise * Ability to prioritize, focus, and adhere to support SLAs and should be able to manage multiple priorities and tickets with organizational and time\-management skills * Strong analytical and problem solving skills paired with a persistent, proactive, results\-oriented mindset, excellent verbal and written communication * Initiative and positive attitude with a desire to learn and seek answers independently and curiosity to explore the technical side of supply chain / logistics industry **Bonus points if you have** ---------------------------- * Deep understanding of logistics business logic (Shipments, Orders, Invoices) and specific EDI sets (e.g., 850, 856, 214, 315\). * iPaaS Expertise:Certified or highly experienced in Boomi (highly preferred), MuleSoft, or Workato. \#LI\-Onsite \#LI\-VA1 #### **Commitment to Equal Opportunity** At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law. #### **Global Data Privacy Notice for Job Candidates and Applicants** Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

Deliver for America’s health agency missions and enhance lives for hundreds of millions every day. **Job Description** ------------------- GDIT is looking for a **Senior AI Engineer (AWS)** to join our **NIAID** team, designing, building, and deploying AI solutions on AWS that serve the NIAID research community. We are seeking a highly experienced and customer\-focused engineer to architect, build, and evolve secure, scalable, and reliable AWS AI solutions supporting generative AI and scientific research. Our ideal candidate combines hands\-on expertise across the AWS AI stack (Amazon Bedrock, Bedrock AgentCore, Amazon SageMaker, Amazon Q) with a strong command of modern application architecture, AI/LLM technologies, infrastructure, networking, identity, security, automation, and DevOps practices. As a senior member of our Cloud Platform \& DevOps team, you will serve as an AI engineering expert. Your Potential** * **System Integration:** Architect and implement end\-to\-end AI pipelines (RAG, Agentic workflows) that integrate seamlessly with existing enterprise APIs, legacy databases, and microservices. * **Scalability \& Performance:** Optimize inference latency and manage token costs for large\-scale deployments serving thousands of internal and external users. * **Evaluation \& Governance:** Establish robust evaluation frameworks to measure model accuracy, mitigate hallucinations, and ensure compliance with enterprise security and privacy standards. * **Cross\-Functional Leadership:** Collaborate with tech leads, security leads, and software teams to identify high\-impact AI use cases and define technical roadmaps. * **Continuous Innovation:** Stay at the forefront of Generative AI, multimodal models, and autonomous agents, recommending strategic pivots as the technology evolves. * **Enterprise RAG Pipelines:** Build robust Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems using Java\-based ETL pipelines to ingest and index unstructured custodial data (e.g., legal agreements, market news) into vector databases. * **Performance \& Observability:** Leverage **Spring Boot Actuator** and **Micrometer** to monitor LLM latency, token usage, and model drift within our standard enterprise monitoring stack. * **Regulatory Compliance (Audit\-by\-Design):** Implement "Human\-in\-the\-Loop" (HITL) patterns and structured logging to ensure all AI\-driven lending decisions are explainable and compliant with 2026 SEC/FINRA standards. * **System Modernization:** Lead the transition of traditional batch\-oriented Java processes to real\-time, event\-driven AI architectures using **AWS MSK** and similar tools. **Required Technical Skills** * **Core Java:** Expert\-level proficiency in **Java 21\+** (utilizing Virtual Threads/Project Loom for high\-concurrency AI inference). * **AI Frameworks:** Hands\-on experience with **leading AI frameworks / tools**. * **Enterprise Stack:** Deep experience with **Spring Boot 3\.x**, **JPA, Sybase**, and **Maven/Gradle**. * **Data \& Search:** Proficiency in **SQL** and integration with enterprise vector stores (e.g., Milvus, Weaviate, or Pinecone) via Java clients. * **Messaging \& Integration:** Experience with **Apache Kafka** or **RabbitMQ** for orchestrating asynchronous AI agent tasks. * **Cloud Infrastructure:** Deployment experience on **AWS** usingSDKs. **Qualifications** * **Experience:** 6\+ years in Java software engineering, with at least 3 years focused on AI/ML integration in production. * **Domain Knowledge:** Understanding of RIA workflows, collateral eligibility, and the regulatory landscape of asset\-based lending. * **Education:** Degree in Computer Science, Financial Engineering, or a related field. Please note we will only respond to applications for which we have an interest. **Salary Range** The expected base salary for this New York, New York, United States\-based position is $150,000\-$300,000\. In addition, you may be eligible for a discretionary bonus if you are an active employee as of fiscal year\-end. **Benefits** Goldman Sachs is committed to providing our people with valuable and competitive benefits and wellness offerings, as it is a core part of providing a strong overall employee experience. A summary of these offerings, which are generally available to active, non\-temporary, full\-time and part\-time US employees who work at least 20 hours per week, can be found here. We Offer Best\-In\-Class Benefits Healthcare \& Medical Insurance We offer a wide range of health and welfare programs that vary depending on office location. These generally include medical, dental, short\-term disability, long\-term disability, life, accidental death, labor accident and business travel accident insurance. Holiday \& Vacation Policies We offer competitive vacation policies based on employee level and office location. We promote time off from work to recharge by providing generous vacation entitlements and a minimum of three weeks expected vacation usage each year. Financial Wellness \& Retirement We assist employees in saving and planning for retirement, offer financial support for higher education, and provide a number of benefits to help employees prepare for the unexpected. We offer live financial education and content on a variety of topics to address the spectrum of employees’ priorities. Health Services We offer a medical advocacy service for employees and family members facing critical health situations, and counseling and referral services through the Employee Assistance Program (EAP). We provide Global Medical, Security and Travel Assistance and a Workplace Ergonomics Program. We also offer state\-of\-the\-art on\-site health centers in certain offices. Fitness To encourage employees to live a healthy and active lifestyle, some of our offices feature on\-site fitness centers. For eligible employees we typically reimburse fees paid for a fitness club membership or activity (up to a pre\-approved amount). Child Care \& Family Care We offer on\-site child care centers that provide full\-time and emergency back\-up care, as well as mother and baby rooms and homework rooms. In every office, we provide advice and counseling services, expectant parent resources and transitional programs for parents returning from parental leave. Adoption, surrogacy, egg donation and egg retrieval stipends are also available. Benefits at Goldman Sachs Read more about the full suite of class\-leading benefits our firm has to offer. jobs.description: **JOB TITLE**: Data Analyst **REPORTS TO**: Director of Data Strategy \& Reporting **DEPARTMENT:** Data Strategy \& Reporting **HOURS**: 40 Hours Monday – Friday 9:00a – 5:00p **FLSA STATUS**: Exempt **JOB TYPE:** Full\-Time **RATE**: $90k – 125k **About Healthix** Healthix is the largest public health information exchange (HIE) in New York State, securely connecting thousands of healthcare providers, hospitals, health plans, and community organizations to improve the quality, safety, and efficiency of care. Through the secure exchange of health information, Healthix helps ensure that clinicians, care teams, and public health partners have access to the data they need to make informed decisions and deliver better outcomes for the communities they serve. As part of our ongoing **organizational transformation**, Healthix is expanding its focus beyond data exchange to making health information more actionable and impactful for healthcare providers, community partners, and public health initiatives. This transformation reflects our commitment to strengthening community partnerships, improving health equity, and supporting innovative approaches that connect healthcare with community\-based services. Through initiatives such as **Healthix Connects**, our internal volunteer and community engagement program, we are deepening our relationships with local organizations and creating opportunities for our team to actively support healthier, safer communities. Joining Healthix means becoming part of a mission\-driven organization that is shaping the future of health information sharing while building stronger connections between healthcare systems and the communities they serve. **THE ROLE:** The Data Analyst provides the foundation for analytics, namely the collection, quality assurance and availability of data. This IT role requires a significant set of technical skills, including a deep knowledge of SQL, SQL database design and multiple programming languages as well as communication skills to understand what data and analysis the healthcare analysts want to gain from Healthix data stores. They are responsible for the maintenance, improvement, cleansing and manipulation of data in the organization’s operational and analytics databases. The Data Analyst works with team members to define and build data pipelines to orchestrate the movement, transformation, validation, and loading of data from the source to the final destination – data stores defined and implemented based on system requirements and data consumer requirements. Typical tasks performed include working with the data architect on data warehouse design, ensuring data loads quickly, is easily accessible and rapidly comprehensible for analysts/users; extract, transform, and load (ETL) processing; performing thorough testing and validation in order to support the accuracy of data transformations and data verification to ensure correctness and that data is generally reliable for downstream consumption; data bounds checking and database tuning. The Data Analyst strives to ensure proper data governance and quality for the Data Strategy team and the entire organization. They analyze complex data elements and systems, data flow, dependencies, and relationships to contribute to conceptual physical and logical data models. They work collaboratively within the Data Strategy team, providing support for their data centric needs. The candidate has strong working and conceptual knowledge of database queries multidimensional query and index tuning, monitoring, disaster recovery, backup, automated testing, automated schema migration, and continuous deployment. **KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:** * Enhance and streamline data and pipeline architecture to improve data flow and collection. * Partner with software developers, database architects, and data analysts to support data initiatives and ensure reliable data delivery. * Independently address the data requirements of multiple teams, systems, and products. * Refine or redesign Healthix’s data architecture to enable next‑generation products and data capabilities. * Build and maintain scalable data pipelines and reporting solutions to support growing data volumes, performance and complex queries across Databricks, MS SQL Server, and InterSystems HealthShare. * Work with Data Strategy and Business teams to improve data models and increase data accessibility for business intelligence. * Implement monitoring processes to safeguard data quality, accuracy, and availability for key stakeholders. * Develop queries, support reporting needs, and tailor reporting solutions to enable data‑driven decision‑making. * Develop and execute unit and data validation tests while maintaining accurate documentation, perform data analysis to troubleshoot issues, support feasibility assessments, evaluate health outcomes, and resolve data‑related problems. * Provide general reporting and project support across the organization. * Ensure reporting meets standards for reliability, accuracy, completeness, and compliance. * Support the development, ETL processes, and maintenance of company data assets and data models, design data integrations and data quality frameworks. * Evaluate open‑source and vendor data‑lineage tools and contribute to long‑term data platform architecture planning across IT and Business teams. * Assist in developing an integrated data warehouse to provide a comprehensive healthcare dataset. **Requirements** **QUALIFICATIONS, SKILLS and COMPETENCIES:** * 5\+ years of experience in a Data Analyst role, with a graduate degree in Computer Science, Statistics, Healthcare Informatics, Informatics, Information Systems, or a related field. IBM Certified Data Engineer or Google Certified Professional is preferred. * Experience with healthcare data, including HL7, CCDAs, MS SQL Server, Databricks, Tableau, InterSystems HealthShare, and Cache databases. * Advanced SQL knowledge and experience with relational databases, query authoring, and familiarity with various databases. * Proficient in database design principles, including relationships, normalization, structures, indexes, views, and analyzing database requirements. * Experience in building and optimizing big data pipelines, architectures, and data sets. * Strong analytical skills and experience in performing root cause analysis on data and processes to answer business questions and identify improvement opportunities. * Experience in developing processes for data transformation, structures, metadata, dependency, and workload management. * Working knowledge of message queuing, stream processing, and scalable big data stores. * Proficient in big data tools such as Hadoop, Spark, and Kafka. * Experience with relational SQL and NoSQL databases. * Strong programming skills with languages like Python, Java, C\+\+, and Scala. * Ability to architect end\-to\-end ETL pipelines. * Experience with AWS services and BI tools like Tableau. * Strong quantitative, analytical, process development, facilitation, and organizational skills. * Excellent documentation and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly communicate technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.

applications. * Strong problem\-solving, communication, and collaboration skills. * Entrepreneurial mindset and willingness to work in an early\-stage startup environment. * Ability to work regularly on\-site in Cincinnati as part of a hybrid schedule. jobs.title: Applied AI Engineer
jobs.description: Government technology has failed citizens, veterans, public servants, and service members for decades. Kaizen powers America’s application layer. We replace the legacy systems federal agencies run on with modern software, built with craft. The ticketing platform a resident uses to visit a presidential library. The marketplace DoW uses to procure counter\-drone systems to protect lives and critical infrastructure. The system a Veteran uses to access benefits. We build systems of record, of national consequence. Our AI\-native modules and harness allow us to do so in weeks, not years. This year, our revenue has grown 35x. Next year, our software will serve over 100 million Americans across dozens of federal agencies. Founded in 2022 and based in New York City and DC, Kaizen has raised $35 million from NEA, a16z, Accel, 776, and Carpenter Capital. **The Role** ------------ We built an internal tool called Bidbuddy. Before it existed, someone on our team spent eight hours a week scraping procurement sites, pulling RFPs by hand, and reading them to figure out which ones were worth chasing. Now one system does the scraping and the first pass of analysis. Those eight hours went back to the people doing the actual work of winning. That's one tool. We need many more, and most of them don't exist yet. Kaizen is about 40 people supporting software that reaches 40 million residents across 50\+ agencies in 17 states, and the only way that math holds is if the company runs on tools instead of hours. This role owns that. You'll go department by department, find where the time goes, and build the thing that takes it back. Sometimes that's an internal app. Sometimes it's an automation nobody notices. Sometimes it's teaching a team to use AI properly, which is often the highest leverage thing available. Then you roll it out and stay on it until people actually use it. We already have the list, and it's long. **Location** ------------ This is a hybrid role based out of our New York. Candidates must reside in New York or be able to commute to New York City to work out of our office at least four times a week (Monday \- Thursday). **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Own internal tools end to end, from the hallway conversation that surfaces the problem through architecture, build, rollout, and the week two fixes. * Build AI powered internal systems in the mold of Bidbuddy: document parsing and analysis, agentic workflows, automated research and routing, and tooling that turns hours of manual work into minutes. * Work directly with leads across Proposals, Customer Ops, Sales, Design, and Engineering to find where the time is going, and translate half\-formed asks into something worth building. * Drive AI enablement across the company. Every person at Kaizen should know how to get the most out of these tools. * Support the external analytics layer inside Kaizen's platform, so customers have clear, actionable data at their fingertips * Back up the deployment team during an implementation **What You'll Bring** --------------------- * 2 to 5 years of engineering, data, or applied AI experience, or work that makes the years irrelevant. Slope matters more than seniority * Something you built end to end that a team still uses today: an internal application, an automation, a tool that changed how people work. Not a prototype, not a demo * Genuine fluency with AI tools. You've shipped with them, not just explored them, and you can name where they failed you and how you caught it * Strong SQL and enough data modeling to work in an existing warehouse and ship a model when the job calls for it * The ability to take a vague problem from a non\-technical stakeholder and come back with the right scope, not the requested one * Low ego, high output. You do the unglamorous rollout work because that's what makes the build matter **Strong Candidates May Also...** --------------------------------- * Have built internal tooling at a company where the hard part was getting hundreds of people to change how they work * Come out of forward deployed or solutions engineering at an AI or developer tools company, where the job was making software work inside someone else's mess * Know N8N, Zapier, or similar deeply enough to have a view on when not to reach for them * Have built in government, healthcare, or another environment where getting it wrong has consequences **What Kaizen Offers** ---------------------- **Health \& Insurance** * 100% coverage across the board: medical through Oxford/United (Gold and Platinum PPO plans), dental through Guardian PPO, and vision through Beam — all fully covered for employees, with 100% coverage for dependents. * $100,000 in fully paid life insurance. FSA and Dependent Care FSA. * One Medical membership, on us — same\-day primary care, 24/7 virtual visits, and offices all over the city. * Fertility and family\-building support through Carrot. * 401(k) through Guideline, with a 2% company match. **Family \& Time Off** * 16 weeks of fully paid parental leave for birthing parents. 10 weeks fully paid for non\-birthing parents. * Unlimited PTO, with a two\-week minimum (we mean it when we say take time off!) * Closed for all federal holidays. * Company\-wide winter break the week of Christmas. * Company offsites throughout the year. **Office \& Remote Setup** * Up to $750 one\-time home office or desk setup stipend for NYC\-based employees. $500 for remote employees. * $50/month commuter benefit (company contribution). * Expensed lunch while in the office. * Dinner and Uber rides home will be expensed if you choose to work in the office past 7pm. * Company\-provided laptop of your choice. **Wellness** * NYC employees: Fully covered gym membership at Grindhouse — right across the street from our office at 47 W 17th St (and in Williamsburg). A $225/month value, on us. * Non\-NYC employees: $100 per month, dedicated to gym / physical fitness reimbursement. **Stipends** * $100/month utility stipend. * $250/quarter home cleaning stipend * $500/year professional development. * $250/year recreation. * $300/quarter pet care stipend. Compensation Range: $150K \- $200K

jobs.title: Entry Level Engineer
jobs.description: **Join Our Team as an Engineer** We are a specialized engineering consulting firm focused on planning, designing, and managing communications and technology infrastructure. We're looking for a full\-time Entry\-Level Engineer to support a diverse range of projects across global locations and industries—including healthcare, commercial, science \& technology, retail, and education. **Position Summary** The Entry\-Level Engineer is responsible for the development of IT and technology infrastructure design documents and BIM (Building Information Modeling) models for new and renovation construction projects across a variety of industries under the supervision of a Project Engineer. This includes working on a multi\-disciplinary team consisting of other Lassen Associates employees, architects, engineering consultants, building owners, owner’s representatives, and contractors. Typically, the scope for each project will begin with design phases and conclude after building occupancy. The Engineer is responsible for ensuring the design models and construction documents are fully coordinated with the architectural, MEP, and structural elements in each trade’s respective BIM model. The Engineer will frequently be involved in multiple projects across different clients so communication, organization, and time management skills are critical. In addition to design and BIM duties, the Engineer may perform cost estimating, budgeting, scheduling, or building activation coordination tasks based on specific project scope and requirements. **Initial Job Duties** Under the direction of a Project Engineer: * Create and maintain technology BIM models through all project phases to support engineering design of technology systems to complete projects within budget and schedule constraints coordinated with the owner, design team, and construction manager. * Project cost estimating for IT infrastructure and technology systems and budget management through project duration. * Development of technology standards to meet specific client needs based on industry standards. * Integration of technology activation milestone schedules with overall project and construction schedules to support technology procurement, transition planning, building device loading, and phone/data service provider coordination. * Quality Assurance/Quality Control (QA/QC) on all project deliverables to ensure high quality standards and project deadlines are met. * Develop and maintain Lassen Associates document standards. * Provide additional engineering and/or BIM services depending on individual project scope. This is an entry level position and on a career track to Project Engineer and Project Management. **Qualifications** * B.S. in Engineering from an ABET\-accredited University program * Proficient in Microsoft Office * Experience in Autodesk AutoCAD and REVIT is a plus. **A Full Benefits Package is provided including:** * Health, dental, vision, disability \& life insurance * Paid Time Off – vacation, sick time and holidays * Retirement plan with matching contribution * A 40\-hour work week with Remote Fridays * Regular pay increases * Bonuses based on merit Job Type: Full\-time Pay: $65,000\.00 \- $80,000\.00 per year Benefits: * 401(k) * 401(k) matching * Dental insurance * Health insurance * Life insurance * Paid time off * Retirement plan * Vision insurance Work Location: Hybrid remote in Mount Horeb, WI 53572

jobs.title: Principal Network Engineer
jobs.description: **Your Impact at LILA** Lila's science factories run on a fast\-growing, multi\-site network that spans corporate offices, autonomous labs, and OT/robotics environments across Cambridge (Alewife), OCP, San Francisco, and London. As Principal Network Engineer, you will be the senior technical owner of that network: building the in\-house engineering capability to design, secure, and scale it, while increasing the value and effectiveness of our managed service provider relationships. You'll partner closely with Identity, Endpoints, Security, and OT/Controls engineering teams as we build the corporate engineering function. You'll have real influence over the network architecture decisions that determine how quickly and safely we can bring new labs and AI Science Factories online. This is a hands\-on, senior IC role for someone who can set technical direction, operate deeply in the details, and shape the network engineering function as it matures. **What You'll Be Building** * Own the architecture, design, and roadmap for Lila's global network, including SD\-WAN/SASE, enterprise firewalls, and secure remote access. * Lead VLAN, subnet, and segmentation design across corporate IT, lab, and OT environments. * Design IT/OT convergence patterns that keep production labs safe, segmented, observable, and reliable. * Drive network infrastructure migration and hardening, including firewall\-to\-SASE cutovers and maintenance windows. * Build network visibility, monitoring, and telemetry to detect issues before they affect scientists or lab operations. * Establish scalable standards for DNS, IP addressing, and naming conventions across labs, buildings, and geographies. * Serve as the senior escalation point for complex network incidents, and create runbooks that help the broader IT team self\-serve. * Manage network\-focused MSPs and vendors while insourcing the highest\-value engineering work over time. * Mentor other network engineers and represent network engineering in planning for lab buildouts and facility expansions. * Advise leadership on network architecture tradeoffs across security, cost, reliability, and delivery speed. **What You'll Need to Succeed** * Typically 10\+ years of progressive network engineering experience, or equivalent depth in designing and operating multi\-site networks. * Deep hands\-on expertise with SD\-WAN/SASE platforms such as Cato Networks or similar. * Strong experience with enterprise firewalls, routing platforms, switching, VLAN segmentation, and subnetting at scale. * Experience securing and connecting both corporate IT and OT, industrial, or lab\-instrumentation networks. * Practical experience implementing network segmentation, zero\-trust concepts, and secure remote access. * Proven ability to manage MSPs and vendors while improving technical outcomes and accountability. * Strong troubleshooting skills and comfort serving as the senior escalation point for production\-impacting network issues. * Excellent communication skills, including translating network architecture decisions for technical and non\-technical stakeholders. **Bonus Points For** * Experience in life sciences, biotech, pharma, or advanced manufacturing environments with lab automation or robotics on the network. * Industry certifications such as CCNP/CCIE, JNCIP/JNCIE, or equivalent. * Cloud networking experience with AWS VPC, Transit Gateway, Direct Connect, or similar. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code for network configuration, such as Terraform, Ansible, or similar. * Familiarity with identity and access patterns, such as SSO/IdP, Keycloak, or similar, as they intersect with network and remote access design. * Experience operating in SOC 2 or similarly regulated security environments. * Prior experience building an internal network engineering function that reduced reliance on outside vendors or MSPs. **About LILA** Lila Sciences is building Scientific Superintelligence™ to solve humankind's greatest challenges. We believe science is the most inspiring frontier for AI. Rather than hard\-coding expert knowledge into tools, LILA builds systems that can learn for themselves. LILA combines advanced AI models with proprietary AI Science Factory™ instruments into an operating system for science that executes the entire scientific method autonomously, accelerating discovery at unprecedented speed, scale, and impact across medicine, materials, and energy. Learn more at www.lila.ai. Guided by our core values of truth, trust, curiosity, grit, and velocity, we move with startup speed while tackling problems of historic importance. If this sounds like an environment you'd love to work in, even if you don't meet every qualification listed above, we encourage you to apply. **We're All In** Lila Sciences is committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. Information you provide during your application process will be handled in accordance with our Candidate Privacy Policy. **A Note to Agencies** *Lila Sciences does not accept unsolicited resumes from any source other than candidates. The submission of unsolicited resumes by recruitment or staffing agencies to Lila Sciences or its employees is strictly prohibited unless contacted directly by Lila Science's internal Talent Acquisition team. Any resume submitted by an agency in the absence of a signed agreement will automatically become the property of Lila Sciences, and Lila Sciences will not owe any referral or other fees with respect thereto.*

corrective and preventive actions with Quality. * · **Tooling and Equipment:** Define, develop, and qualify fixtures, tooling, test setups, and operator aids; coordinate equipment maintenance, calibration, and qualification requirements. * · **Continuous Improvement:** Improve labor efficiency, throughput, capacity, ergonomics, production flow, and process capability using standard work, status for manufacturing transfers, capacity expansion, cost reduction, NPI, and process\-improvement projects. * · **Operational Leadership Development:** Support daily Tier meetings, production priorities, staffing and training plans, schedule\-recovery actions, and escalation management; provide defined backup coverage after completing required training and demonstrating readiness. * · **Authority:** Stop work or place affected material on hold for an immediate safety, quality, or compliance concern; process manufacturing, design, or configuration changes through established approval requirements. * **ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES** * · Develop process\-training materials and skills matrices; train or coordinate training and verify qualification before independent work. * · Participate in technical reviews with operations, quality, customers, suppliers, and Lourdes or Spartan functions and close assigned actions on time. * · Support production planning, capacity analysis, FMEAs, control plans, make\-versus\-buy evaluations, and production\-readiness reviews. * · Participate in internal, customer, and AS9100 audits and maintain accurate engineering, project, and production records. * · Promote workplace safety, product integrity, FOD prevention, 5S, and individual responsibility for workmanship. * · Perform other related duties consistent with the position and business needs. * **KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS** * **Category** * **Representative Measures** * **Safety and Compliance** * Safety actions, audit support, process\-control compliance, QUALIFICATIONS** * **Required:** * · Three to five years of manufacturing\-engineering experience in aerospace, defense, electronics, or another high\-reliability regulated environment. * · Experience supporting wire\-harness, cable, electromechanical, or electronic assembly; two or more years is strongly preferred. * · Demonstrated ability to create work instructions, routers, BOMs, labor standards, and manufacturing\-process documentation. * · Experience supporting NPI, first articles, prototypes, engineering changes, and production\-readiness activities. * · Working knowledge of IPC/WHMA\-A\-620, J\-STD\-001, AS9100, and applicable customer requirements. * · Experience with structured root\-cause analysis, corrective action, Lean methods, PFMEA, and process control. * · Ability to interpret engineering drawings, wiring diagrams, specifications, and technical data packages. * · Demonstrated project leadership, technical writing, data analysis, and cross\-functional communication skills. * · Proficiency with ERP/MRP systems and Microsoft Office, particularly Excel. * · Ability to satisfy applicable export\-control requirements and obtain required customer facility access. * **Preferred:** * · IPC/WHMA\-A\-620 certification, or ability to obtain required certification within 12 months. * · CAD, schematic or wiring diagram, fixture\-design, test\-equipment, or electrical test experience. * · Prior team\-lead, project\-lead, or production\-leadership experience. * · Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent applied continuous\-improvement experience. * · Experience with manufacturing transfers, capacity expansion, or supplier industrialization. * **PERSONAL CHARACTERISTICS** * · Hands\-on and comfortable working directly with jobs.title: Sr. Scientist, Modelling & Simulation
jobs.description: **Job Description** ------------------- **Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?** **Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It With Pride.** Working as part of a cross\-functional team covering broad modelling disciplines, you are an internally recognized expert in computational physics, a technical area of critical importance to the R\&D function. You identify, define and solve complex modelling and simulation problems, tackling R\&D's highest priority ingredient, product, process, and packaging challenges. Applying your in\-depth knowledge of this technical specialty, you will drive rapid, high\-quality innovation capabilities across Mondelez's portfolio, spanning chocolate, biscuit, gum, and candy categories. **How you will contribute** You will bring computational physics modelling \& simulation capabilities to Mondelez R\&D's highest priority areas, developing solutions to move R\&D work away from large, factory\-scale trials towards small\-scale or in silico predictions. Specifically, you will: * Design and deliver rapid simulation capabilities to drive solutions to business challenges. * Plan, lead, and manage modelling and simulation projects, scoping and proposing opportunities for sustained business impact. * Work closely with engineers and scientists to define complex technical challenges and agree on problem scope. * Communicate complex problems simply to non\-technical audiences with relevant business context. * Define the data required to build models; collaborate with internal teams or external organizations to collect this information, which may include designing experimental tests. * Use software tools to design, build, test, and implement simulations — or select and manage delivery through an external partner. * Ensure simulations are validated against experimental data, including any required experiments or factory trials. * Deploy models via simple UIs using the Mondelez\-approved technology stack, in collaboration with IT and/or external partners. * Establish strategy and roadmap for integrating computational physics into R\&D business processes. * Quantify and communicate the value of computational physics to stakeholders, the associated plan, and embed learnings into business processes to accelerate innovation and optimization. * Author best\-practice documentation and knowledge\-base articles from project learnings. * Share knowledge and coach junior colleagues, building internal modelling \& simulation capability across R\&D. * Maintain data management practices — ensuring models, datasets, and simulation outputs are documented and stored in line with company data governance policies. * Research and keep pace with developments in relevant modelling, simulation, and virtual prototyping techniques. * Provide
