jobs.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test (SDET), QA - AI Systems
jobs.description: **About Nexxa** =============== Nexxa is building the best AI systems for heavy industries, enabling machines, systems and operations to think, decide and act autonomously across manufacturing, large\-scale infrastructure, logistics and legacy environments. Our mission is to translate deep technical breakthroughs into operational reality, solving some of the hardest systems\-level problems in industry. **Role Overview** ================= We’re looking for a Senior / Staff SDET to own quality for Nexxa’s AI agent systems, combining deep test automation with hands\-on manual and exploratory testing. Our agents plan, call tools, and take multi\-step actions autonomously in industrial environments. You’ll write production\-grade code to build evaluation harnesses, simulation environments, and CI/CD quality gates, and you’ll also get hands\-on with the agents yourself: probing behavior, reviewing traces, and validating releases where automation alone can’t judge whether the agent did the right thing. You’ll work closely with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed Engineers to define what “good” looks like for an agent operating in high\-stakes industrial settings, then build and run the systems and processes that measure it continuously. **Key Responsibilities** ======================== **Automation and Infrastructure** * Design, build, and maintain test frameworks, evaluation harnesses, and regression suites for LLM\-based agents, covering reasoning quality, tool\-call correctness, task completion, and multi\-turn coherence. * Build automated pipelines that run evals and test suites on every model, prompt, or tool\-integration change, and integrate them into CI/CD as enforceable quality gates. * Develop simulators, mocks, and sandbox environments for industrial systems and tool APIs so agents can be tested safely, repeatably, and at scale. * Implement API, contract, integration, and end\-to\-end tests for the services, tools, and orchestration layers that agents depend on. * Develop performance, load, and reliability tests for agent workflows, including failure injection and resilience testing. **Manual and Exploratory Testing** * Perform hands\-on exploratory testing of agent behavior, including new capabilities, ambiguous or underspecified requests, long multi\-turn sessions, and unusual operational scenarios that scripted tests don’t anticipate. * Manually review agent traces and outputs to judge reasoning quality, appropriateness of actions, and safety, and use those findings to improve automated checks. * Execute manual regression and release verification passes in staging and customer\-like environments before new agent capabilities ship. * Conduct manual red\-teaming sessions (prompt injection, jailbreaks, tool misuse, unsafe actions) in partnership with security teams, then convert successful attacks into automated test cases. * Support user acceptance testing and pilot rollouts with Forward Deployed Engineers, capturing real\-world failures and feeding them back into test suites. * Write clear test plans, test charters, and bug reports, and maintain manual test documentation where automation isn’t yet practical or cost\-effective. **Datasets, Metrics, and Quality Strategy** * Create and manage golden datasets and labeled test sets, including edge cases, ambiguous inputs, and adversarial prompts specific to industrial and operational contexts, with tooling for versioning and drift detection. * Design rubrics and run human\-in\-the\-loop evaluations where automated scoring isn’t reliable enough. * Define and instrument quality metrics beyond simple accuracy (groundedness, hallucination rate, task success rate, latency/cost tradeoffs, and safety violations) and build dashboards to track them over time. * Test agent behavior across the full action loop (planning, tool selection, tool execution, error recovery, and final output), not just the final response. * Investigate and triage failures where the root cause could be the model, the prompt, the tool/API, or the orchestration logic, and turn them into reproducible, actionable bug reports. * Establish quality bars, release criteria, and sign\-off processes for new agent capabilities, blending automated gates with manual verification. * Decide what to automate and what to keep manual, and continually shift repeatable manual work into automation. * Mentor engineers on testing strategies and test\-driven practices for probabilistic, LLM\-driven systems. * Advocate for testability, observability, and tracing in agent architecture from day one. **Qualifications** ================== * 5\+ years as an SDET, QA engineer, or software engineer with a strong testing focus, with demonstrated ownership of test strategy and automation for complex distributed systems. * Proven experience in both manual and automated testing, including exploratory testing, test planning, and writing high\-quality bug reports. * Strong programming skills (Python preferred) with a software engineering mindset: clean, maintainable, well\-reviewed code for frameworks, data pipelines, and tooling. * Experience building test frameworks and infrastructure from the ground up, not just writing test cases within an existing framework. * Hands\-on experience with CI/CD systems (e.g., GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins) and containerized test environments (Docker, Kubernetes). * Experience testing APIs and microservices, including contract, integration, and end\-to\-end testing. * Hands\-on experience testing LLM\-based products, chatbots, or AI agents, and an understanding of why traditional deterministic assertions break down for generative systems. * Practical experience with eval frameworks or tooling (e.g., promptfoo, DeepEval, RAGAS, LangSmith) or a track record of building your own. * Understanding of how LLM agents work: prompting, tool/function calling, context management, RAG, memory, and orchestration frameworks. * Experience designing test data and labeled datasets, including sourcing, sampling, and managing dataset drift over time. * Familiarity with LLM\-specific failure modes: hallucination, prompt injection, context poisoning, tool misuse, goal drift, and non\-determinism. * Comfort operating in ambiguity, defining what “correct” means for a task when there’s no single right answer. * Strong written communication skills for turning fuzzy quality signals into clear, actionable findings for engineering and product stakeholders. **Preferred** ============= * Experience with human\-in\-the\-loop evaluation workflows (labeling pipelines, inter\-rater reliability, rubric design). * Experience with performance and load testing tools (e.g., k6, Locust) and chaos or fault\-injection testing. * Background in ML/data science sufficient to read model evals and statistical significance. * Experience red\-teaming or doing adversarial/security testing on ML systems. * Familiarity with observability and tracing tools for LLM applications (e.g., LangSmith, Arize, Langfuse, Weights \& Biases) and general observability stacks (OpenTelemetry, Grafana, Datadog). * Experience testing systems in industrial, IoT, or operational technology (OT) environments, including industrial protocols (OPC UA, MQTT, Modbus) or simulation and hardware\-in\-the\-loop setups. * Experience supporting UAT, pilots, or customer\-facing validation of complex products. * Experience setting up test and eval infrastructure from scratch at a startup or fast\-moving team. **What We’re Looking For** ========================== * An engineer who is equally comfortable writing a test framework and sitting down to break an agent by hand. * Someone who can build rigorous evaluation systems for problems that don’t have a single right answer, and who knows when human judgment is the right tool. * A systems thinker who enjoys turning ambiguous agent behavior into measurable, trustworthy signals. * A strong collaborator who partners well with ML engineers, backend engineers, and Forward Deployed teams. **Why Join** **Nexxa.AI****?** ============================== * **Innovative Environment:** Play a critical role in transforming heavy industries through groundbreaking AI and automation technologies. * **Collaborative Culture:** Be part of a team that values innovation, discipline, and continuous improvement. * **Professional Growth:** Benefit from significant opportunities for career development and advancement. * **Competitive Compensation:** Enjoy a comprehensive salary and equity package reflective of your expertise and contributions. If you’re passionate about AI quality and eager to help define what trustworthy autonomous systems look like in heavy industry, we’d love to connect.

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer
jobs.description: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure, or OCI, is seeking a Principal Software Developer to design and build scalable software capabilities that support infrastructure demand and capacity planning. In this role, you will develop reliable, secure, and data\-intensive services used by engineering and planning teams. You will work closely with Software Developers, Machine Learning Engineers, Data Scientists, domain experts, and product stakeholders to translate complex planning requirements into production\-quality software. As a Principal Software Developer, you will provide technical leadership across architecture, design, implementation, testing, deployment, and operations. You will solve ambiguous problems, establish engineering standards, and help build systems that operate reliably at cloud scale. This is an individual\-contributor role with significant technical ownership and cross\-functional influence. **Basic qualifications** * Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience. * Eight or more years of professional software\-development experience. * Significant experience designing and delivering production software systems. * Strong programming skills in Java, Python, Go, C\+\+, or another modern programming language. * Strong understanding of data structures, algorithms, object\-oriented design, and software\-design principles. * Experience designing distributed systems, backend services, APIs, or data\-intensive applications. * Experience with relational or non\-relational databases and proficiency with SQL. * Experience developing, testing, deploying, and operating software in Linux and cloud environments. * Knowledge of software\-development practices including source control, automated testing, code reviews, continuous integration, and continuous delivery. * Experience troubleshooting complex systems and resolving production issues. * Ability to lead technical design and execution across multiple components or workstreams. * Strong written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrated ability to collaborate effectively with engineering, data, product, and business stakeholders. **Preferred qualifications** * Experience building software for cloud infrastructure, networking, capacity planning, resource planning, supply planning, or other large\-scale operational domains. * Experience with cloud\-native technologies, containers, Kubernetes, and service\-oriented or microservice architectures. * Experience with workflow orchestration, event\-driven systems, batch\-processing systems, or distributed data\-processing platforms. * Experience building applications that integrate machine\-learning models, forecasting services, optimization methods, or analytical workflows. * Familiarity with machine\-learning lifecycle concepts, including feature generation, model serving, evaluation, and monitoring. * Experience building internal enterprise applications or decision\-support systems. * Experience with infrastructure\-as\-code, automated deployment, and configuration\-management practices. * Experience with security, access control, auditability, and data\-governance requirements. * Experience with OCI, AWS, Azure, or another major cloud platform. * Ability to influence technical direction across teams without direct management authority. **Responsibilities** * Lead the architecture, design, and implementation of scalable services and applications supporting infrastructure planning. * Translate complex and ambiguous business and engineering requirements into well\-defined technical designs and implementation plans. * Build reliable backend services, APIs, data\-processing workflows, and integrations. * Develop software that incorporates analytical and machine\-learning outputs into production applications and planning workflows. * Define clear interfaces and data contracts across software, data, and machine\-learning components. * Design systems for scalability, availability, security, maintainability, and operational efficiency. * Establish appropriate observability through metrics, logs, traces, dashboards, and automated alerting. * Own software throughout its lifecycle, including design, development, testing, deployment, production support, and continuous improvement. * Diagnose complex production issues, perform root\-cause analysis, and implement durable corrective actions. * Improve system performance, reliability, and cost efficiency through measurement and engineering analysis. * Partner with Data Scientists and Machine Learning Engineers to integrate predictive and analytical capabilities into production systems. * Collaborate with infrastructure and domain experts to ensure that software behavior reflects real\-world operational requirements. * Participate in architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and operational\-readiness reviews. * Establish reusable engineering patterns, development standards, and best practices across the team. * Mentor engineers and raise the overall technical quality of the organization. * Communicate technical decisions, tradeoffs, risks, and recommendations to engineering leaders and cross\-functional stakeholders. \#LI\-SP1

jobs.title: Principal Core Infrastructure Engineer - AI Infrastructure
jobs.description: Designs, implements, and optimizes components in distributed systems with an emphasis on scalability, resiliency, and operability. Delivers features and load/performance tests; leverages data plane platforms and distributed state tools for high\-volume retrieval, storage, and processing; and reviews peers’ implementations for scalability compliance. Builds fault\-tolerant paths (redundancy, replication, automatic failover), applies recovery‑oriented principles, and implements retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. Proactively detects and mitigates issues via tests, alarms, dashboards, and telemetry; authors runbooks and participates in incident response and RCAs. Implements standard replication and synchronization, develops automation/IaC for troubleshooting and maintenance, and applies advanced security controls (encryption, access, remediation) while ensuring change, compliance, and documentation standards are met. **Must live near Nashville, TN in order to regularly go into the office, or be willing to relocate to the area for onsite work.** **Responsibilities** **What You'll Do*** Design, implement, test, and optimize components of large\-scale distributed systems and data\-plane services. * Build for horizontal and vertical scale, using distributed state, replication, synchronization, and high\-volume data\-processing patterns. * Strengthen service reliability through redundancy, automatic failover, recovery\-oriented design, retries, circuit breakers, and timeouts. * Develop and execute performance, load, and fault\-injection tests to validate scalability, correctness, availability, and operational readiness. * Create dashboards, alarms, telemetry, runbooks, and automation that proactively detect issues and accelerate recovery. * Diagnose production issues, participate in on\-call rotations and incident response, and contribute to root\-cause analyses and durable corrective actions. * Develop infrastructure automation and Infrastructure as Code (IaC) for safe maintenance, troubleshooting, patching, updates, and rollbacks. Apply strong security controls—including encryption, access controls, and vulnerability remediation—in multi\-tenant environments. * **What You'll Bring** * **Must live near Nashville, TN in order to regularly go into the office, or be willing to relocate to the area for onsite work.** * Bachelor's or master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. * 7\+ years of professional software\-development experience; advanced degree holders may have fewer years of experience. * Proficiency in at least one object\-oriented or systems programming language, such as Java, C\+\+, C\#, or Go. * Experience building or operating scalable, highly available distributed systems or cloud infrastructure. * Experience with system\-level testing and automation, including performance, load, reliability, or fault\-injection testing. * Understanding of distributed\-systems concepts, data structures, algorithms, operating systems, networking, and secure software\-development practices. Strong debugging, problem\-solving, communication, and cross\-functional collaboration skills. * **Preferred Qualifications** * Experience with cloud platforms, such as Oracle Cloud, AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud. * Experience with data\-plane platforms, distributed storage, microservices, state management, replication, or large\-scale data processing. * Experience with observability, incident management, Infrastructure as Code, and production service operations. Familiarity with compliance requirements and security controls for cloud infrastructure. * \#LI\-JO2

jobs.title: VP of Information Systems & Security
jobs.description: **About Overwatch Mission Critical** Overwatch is a service\-disabled Veteran\-owned small business (SDVOB) certified through the National Veterans Business Development Council (NVBDC), delivering construction professional services, talent acquisition, and general contractor solutions within the mission\-critical infrastructure industry. Our focus is the construction and management of state\-of\-the\-art data centers, executed with the precision and reliability this industry demands. From high\-end engineers to seasoned field professionals, we deploy the talent needed to bring complex infrastructure to life. At Overwatch, it's more than a job — it's purpose. **The Role** Overwatch Mission Critical is looking for a Vice President of Information Systems \& Security to strengthen how we protect, govern, and operate our enterprise technology environment. This is a security\-first technology leadership role with an immediate focus on cybersecurity, data privacy, governance, risk, and compliance. As Overwatch continues to scale across a distributed, field\-based workforce in the United States and Europe, we need a technology environment that is secure, resilient, well governed, and capable of scaling with the business. This role will build the security and privacy foundation while helping establish the operating standards and discipline required across enterprise technology. The VP will work across Technology, Business Platforms \& Intelligence, Legal, HR, Finance, and business leadership to translate risk and business requirements into practical controls, operating standards, and technology priorities. This role reports to the SVP, Technology and will serve as a senior technology partner to the executive team. **What You Will Own:** **Cybersecurity** The immediate mandate is building a practical, scalable security program that protects the enterprise without slowing the business. You will:* Own the enterprise cybersecurity strategy, roadmap, architecture, and security operating model * Establish identity as a primary security control plane across single sign\-on, conditional access, privileged access, joiner\-mover\-leaver processes, and access recertification * Drive endpoint security, vulnerability management, encryption, detection, response, and security monitoring across a distributed environment * Own incident response planning, exercises, escalation, and executive communication during material security events * Build security awareness and role\-based training focused on measurable behavior and risk reduction * Partner with technology and business leaders to embed security into systems, integrations, infrastructure, and enterprise AI use cases **Governance, Risk \& Compliance** This leader will establish a durable control and risk environment that can support client requirements, growth, and increasing enterprise complexity. You will:* Own the technology policy framework, risk register, control environment, testing calendar, exceptions, remediation, and executive reporting * Lead SOC 2 Type I and Type II readiness and examinations end to end, including scope, control design, evidence, examiner management, findings, and remediation * Maintain alignment to applicable frameworks such as NIST CSF, ISO 27001, NIST SP 800\-171, or CMMC as business and client requirements evolve * Build a tiered third\-party technology and security risk program and hold managed service providers and vendors accountable for control performance * Translate client contracts, insurance requirements, and applicable obligations into practical technology controls and ownership * Provide clear executive\-level reporting on technology risk, investment trade\-offs, control effectiveness, and remediation priorities **Data Privacy \& Information Governance** Security and privacy must extend to how Overwatch creates, accesses, shares, retains, and uses information across the enterprise. You will:* Own the enterprise data privacy program in partnership with Legal, HR, Business Platforms \& Intelligence, and business leadership * Establish practical standards for data classification, access, handling, retention, sharing, and deletion across enterprise platforms * Translate applicable U.S. and EMEA privacy requirements into technology controls and operating practices * Lead privacy\-by\-design reviews for new systems, integrations, AI use cases, and material changes in data processing * Establish processes for privacy incidents, third\-party data handling, data requests, and cross\-border considerations * Partner with data and platform leaders to strengthen governance across collaboration platforms, the data environment, analytics, and AI **Technology Operations \& Enterprise Resilience** This role will also help strengthen the operating discipline around enterprise technology so the environment remains reliable, scalable, and well controlled as the company grows. You will:* Partner with technology leadership to establish operating standards acr vendor oversight model operating consistently * Improved visibility into technology service health, incidents, operational risk, and vendor performance * Business continuity and technology resilience plans established and exercised * Clearer executive visibility into technology risk, investment needs, performance, and trade\-offs * A technology operating environment positioned to support continued growth without creating unnecessary complexity or risk **What We Are Looking For** We are looking for a security\-first technology operator who can build the capabilities we need today and has the breadth to lead across a growing enterprise technology environment. The right person will bring: * Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Information Systems, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent relevant experience * 12\+ years of progressive experience across enterprise technology, cybersecurity, infrastructure, IT operations, GRC, or comparable technology leadership roles * Significant leadership experience across at least two of the following: cybersecurity, enterprise IT operations, infrastructure, GRC/data privacy, or technology service delivery * Demonstrated ownership of a cybersecurity and compliance program, including hands\-on leadership of SOC 2 and/or ISO 27001 * Working knowledge of data privacy and information governance, ideally spanning U.S. and EMEA operations * Deep Microsoft 365 and Entra ID experience, including identity, conditional access, privileged access, endpoint, and data protection controls * Experience supporting a distributed workforce and managing enterprise technology environments at scale * Experience owning MSPs, technology vendors, and outsourced service delivery, including SLAs, performance management, escalation, and control oversight * Practical incident response leadership and the ability to communicate effectively with executives and outside parties during a live event * Ability to establish operational KPIs and use data to manage service reliability, risk, performance, and technology investment * Strong executive and board communication with the ability to explain technical risk and trade\-offs to non\-technical audiences * Experience scaling technology capabilities through significant organizational growth * Prior responsibility spanning both cybersecurity and enterprise IT operations, infrastructure, or end\-user technology strongly preferred * CISSP, CISM, CCISO, CRISC, CISA, or comparable certifications are valued but not required * Experience in construction, engineering, staffing, infrastructure, data centers, field services, or another distributed operating environment is a plus **The Profile** This person is a builder and an operator. They naturally ask: Where is the enterprise most exposed? What data are we protecting, who has access to it, and why? Are our controls actually operating, or do they only exist on paper? Can our technology environment scale securely as the business grows? Where are service, resilience, or vendor risks creating operational exposure? What should we own internally, and what should we expect from our partners? What does the business actually need, and what is the simplest secure way to enable it? What does leadership need to know, decide, or fund? This is not a role that simply manages compliance or reports on technology risk. It is a role that helps build and operate the technology foundation Overwatch needs to scale securely and reliably. **Benefits:** Overwatch offers a competitive salary and benefits package, including health insurance, dental insurance, vision insurance, life insurance, 401(k) retirement plan, paid time off, and relocation assistance available. OVERWATCH is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. OVERWATCH considers candidates regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status.

jobs.description: **About this role** You'll own evaluation of Honcho end to end, the instrument that tells a research\-driven team whether their identity representations are actually getting better. Plastic Labs builds the memory and identity layer for the agentic world, and the product works. It's a complex multi\-agent harness with real black\-box behavior, so the job is defining what "better" means for representations that change over time, without ground truth, and building the machinery that measures it. If you love constructing measurements from nothing, reading traces to find what's actually broken, and shipping the fix yourself, you'll feel at home here. **What You'll Do** Design the evals. Define the scores and decide what "better" means for an entity representation that changes over time, and keep that definition current as the product and methods move. Build the pipelines and harnesses. Data in, labels, versions, reruns, judges: the machinery that lets the team ask a new question this week and get an answer this week. Run them and harvest insights. Read the traces and results, find what's actually broken, not what's easy to measure, and propose fixes that produce higher\-fidelity representations. Build simulation agents at scale. The ceiling on iteration speed is how many entities can be modeled and measured at once. You raise it. Own the loop end to end. The question, the pipeline, the rerun, the writeup. Nothing gets scoped and handed off, and nothing waits on someone else's sprint. **Work experience** * **Must have**: Designed,​ built,​ and ran evals end to end (LLMS) **Education** * Degree in computer science,​ mathematics,​ statistics,​ or a related quantitative field **Skills** * **Must have:** Production\-​quality Python (tests,​ maintenance,​ release cadence) * 3\+ years of experience 3\+ years designing and owning LLM evaluation * PyTorch,​ Hugging Face,​ Weights \&​ Biases.​ Data pipeline tooling (Hydra,​ Kafka,​ SQL) a plus **Nice\-to\-have** * Work on memory,​ identity,​ personalization,​ agent evaluation,​ or agentic optimization.​ * Shipped research:​ first or co\-​author at NeurIPS,​ ICML,​ ICLR,​ or equivalent,​ OR self\-​published open\-​source work of comparable quality Join us to be at the forefront of AI innovation! jobs.description: **About the Role** ------------------ The Enterprise Agent Evals \& Efficiency team makes Perplexity's agents better at completing real work across enterprise connectors, tools, and data. This team owns the improvement loop: define what successful work looks like, build evaluations that measure it, understand where agents fail, and ship changes that improve outcomes. This is a hands\-on engineering role with end\-to\-end ownership, from building realistic enterprise evaluation environments to shipping improvements across the agent harness, tools, and skills. You'll create complex scenarios spanning connected systems, data, and permissions, use them to identify where agents struggle, and improve the tools agents call, the skills they follow, the context they receive, and the models they use. Working with AI Research, Connectors, and Platform teams, you'll turn experimental results into measurable gains in task success, latency, and cost per successful task. The goal is not just to measure agents, but to make more enterprise work reliable and practical to automate. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Build realistic enterprise evaluation environments spanning connected applications, representative datasets, user roles, and permissions, with complex, multi\-step workflows and reproducible system state. * Own evaluation infrastructure, task suites, and automated graders that measure how well agents complete enterprise work, calibrated against human judgment and grounded in end\-to\-end outcomes. * Analyze agent trajectories and production failures, identify root causes, and ship improvements across the agent harness, tools, and skills that measurably improve task success and reliability. * Develop reusable skills and improve tool descriptions, schemas, and result handling so agents can select the right tools, execute workflows correctly, and recover from errors with fewer unnecessary calls. * Build and evaluate model\-selection and routing strategies that match each task to the right model and effort level, balancing quality, latency, reliability, and cost. * Improve agent efficiency through context management, skill loading, caching, and execution strategies that reduce wasted tokens and cost per successful task without compromising quality or safety. * Build regression gates and launch\-readiness signals for model, connector, tool, skill, and harness changes, and validate that evaluation gains translate into better production outcomes. **Qualifications** ------------------ * 5\+ years of software engineering or machine learning engineering experience, with a track record of owning complex production systems from design through deployment and operation. * Strong system design skills, including building reliable, scalable infrastructure for experimentation, evaluation, or data\-intensive applications. * Strong proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Go, or Rust, and the ability to work effectively across a multi\-language production stack. * Hands\-on experience building, evaluating, or improving LLM\-based applications or agents, including tool use and multi\-step workflows. * Deep expertise in at least one of the following: + Evaluation infrastructure, benchmark design, and automated grading. + Agent harnesses, tool interfaces, and reusable skills for complex workflows. + Realistic test environments or simulations spanning multiple systems, datasets, permissions, and stateful workflows. + Model selection, routing, and inference efficiency, including context management and caching. * Strong experimental and statistical judgment, including choosing representative tasks, defining meaningful success criteria, diagnosing failures, and distinguishing real improvements from noise. * Sound technical judgment in balancing task quality, latency, reliability, and cost, with a track record of translating evaluation findings into shipped improvements. * A track record of leading ambiguous, cross\-team initiatives from architecture through production adoption, setting technical direction, and raising engineering quality through mentorship. jobs.title: Managing Director USA (f/m/d)
jobs.description: #### **Description** QuantumDiamonds is looking for an exceptional **Managing Director USA** to lead the next stage of our growth in the US semiconductor market. Our quantum sensing\-based inspection systems are already being deployed with leading semiconductor players across the US, Asia, and Europe. With a growing installed base and wafer\-level evaluations progressing with major semiconductor manufacturers, we are entering an exciting new phase: scaling commercial adoption of our QDm.1 systems while bringing our technology from the failure analysis lab closer to the semiconductor production line. As Managing Director USA, you will drive both ambitions. *On one side, you will turn existing customer deployments and technical evaluations into repeatable equipment sales, strategic accounts, and long\-term partnerships. On the other side, you will help advance our lab\-to\-fab development agreements*, working with Tier 1 semiconductor manufacturers to enable wafer\-level inspection. This is not a traditional country management role. You will be our senior commercial and strategic representative in the US, combining direct customer engagement, business development, and organizational leadership. You will work closely with our founders and engineering teams in Munich, with substantial ownership of how QuantumDiamonds grows in one of our most important markets. Based in the San Francisco Bay Area, where we already have customer deployments, you will build on existing relationships, open new opportunities, and develop the local organization needed to support our expanding business. We are looking for *someone with deep semiconductor industry expertise, strong commercial instincts, and a genuine builder mentality*. Someone who can navigate complex equipment sales, engage credibly with senior engineering leaders, and turn breakthrough technology into a scalable business. #### **Who we are** Founded in 2022 as a spin\-off of TU Munich, QD leverages quantum sensors to rapidly capture three\-dimensional current maps within multi\-layer chips. Our strong, international team of over 70, including physicists, engineers, data scientists, and other experts, works side by side with major semiconductor manufacturers, supporting chip debugging and accelerating yield analysis. Backed by top\-tier deep tech investors, semiconductor experts, and strategic public programs, we have ensured long\-term stability, shifting from breakthrough to scale \- and shaping the next chapter in chip testing. #### **Why join us?** **Picture this:** * Quantum sensors that see *inside* the most advanced chips on Earth, right where two frontier fields collide. * Nobel\-Prize physics aimed at real customers with real problems, in production now, not someday. * Physicists, data scientists, and engineers building side by side, turning deep science into tools the industry actually runs on. * An international team that runs at hard problems for fun, where knowledge moves fast and so do you. **Still unsure about why joining us?** * You'll get to build a company together with a brilliant and welcoming team on a product that has never been done before. * From Day 1, you'll own your own topics end to end and see the direct impact of your work on how the world sees QuantumDiamonds. * Our technology is the cutting edge of tomorrow, starting today and not in 10 years. * You’ll be part of a high\-growth company backed by top\-tier investors. **Let’s make the invisible visible!**#### **What will you do** ### **Own commercial growth of our lab systems** * Own the US commercial strategy for our lab systems, called QDm.1, turning existing installations, customer evaluations, and market interest into repeatable equipment sales. * Develop and expand strategic accounts across semiconductor manufacturers, advanced packaging companies, failure analysis labs, and other relevant customers. * Lead complex equipment sales cycles, from initial engagement and technical qualification through commercial negotiations, purchase orders, and follow\-on business. * Build strong relationships with technical decision\-makers, budget owners, and procurement teams, understanding what drives investment decisions and how to move opportunities forward. * Develop a reliable sales pipeline, clear account plans, and realistic forecasts, with accountability for commercial performance and revenue growth. * Identify opportunities to expand our installed base through additional systems, new customer sites, and broader adoption within existing accounts. * Work closely hand\-in\-hand with existing local distributors for cross\- and upselling opportunities ### **Own existing JDAs with Tier 1 US chipmakers moving from lab to fab** * Strengthen relationships with leading US semiconductor manufacturers to advance technical evaluations and identify commercially relevant use cases. * Work closely with Applications, Engineering, and Product Development to align customer requirements, evaluation milestones uctor industry**, ideally within semiconductor capital equipment, metrology, inspection, test, or failure analysis. * **Proven success selling complex semiconductor equipment**, including managing long sales cycles, strategic customer evaluations, technical qualifications, and multimillion\-dollar commercial opportunities. * Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing and advanced packaging technologies, including HBM, chiplets, 2\.5D/3D integration, or related electrical failure analysis and debug workflows. * Familiarity with semiconductor fabs, wafer\-level processes, or inline inspection and metrology, with the ability to understand how new technologies move from technical evaluation towards manufacturing adoption. * An established network within the US semiconductor ecosystem, with relationships among relevant technical leaders, engineering decision\-makers, and strategic accounts. * Demonstrated ability to grow strategic accounts, build commercial pipelines, and convert early customer interest into sustained business. * Experience building or scaling a business, commercial organization, or customer\-facing team, ideally within an international technology or semiconductor equipment company. * Sufficient technical depth to engage credibly with semiconductor engineers, applications specialists, and R\&D teams, while translating complex technology into compelling commercial value. * Entrepreneurial mindset and a hands\-on leadership style, with the ability to operate effectively in a fast\-growing company where structures and processes are still evolving. * Strong commercial judgment, negotiation skills, and the ability to navigate complex customer organizations and stakeholder environments. * Excellent communication and relationship\-building skills, with the confidence to represent QuantumDiamonds at senior executive level and collaborate closely with our Munich headquarters. * **Based in or willing to relocate to the San Francisco Bay Area**, with flexibility to travel frequently across the US and regularly to our headquarters in Munich. #### **Our benefits** * **Mission:** At QD, we’re driven by more than just building great products \- we aim to make a lasting difference. Joining us means contributing to meaningful work that goes beyond business as usual. * **Impact \& growth:** This is an exciting stage of our journey, and your voice matters. You’ll have the chance to shape our culture, influence key decisions, and grow alongside a company that’s scaling fast. * **Team \& culture:** We believe the best ideas come when we connect outside the office. From regular off\-sites to team events, you’ll be part of a collaborative and supportive environment. * **Well\-being \& balance:** Enjoy 30 days of paid vacation annually, in addition to US company\-observed public holidays. We also offer a flexible paid sick leave policy, because taking care of your health should never come at the expense of your vacation days. * **Learning \& development:** Your growth is our priority. We provide an annual budget dedicated to courses, conferences, or any resources that help you expand your skills. * **Ownership \& participation:** As part of our equity program, you’ll directly share in our success and the value we create together. #### **About us** QuantumDiamonds GmbH, headquartered in Munich, Germany, develops and manufactures semiconductor inspection systems based on quantum sensing. Spun out of the Technical University of Munich in 2022, the company uses nitrogen\-vacancy centers in diamond to map electrical current with micrometer precision inside advanced 2\.5D and 3D chip architectures. Nine of the world's ten largest semiconductor manufacturers are engaged with QuantumDiamonds, with systems deployed across Europe, the United States, and Asia. The company is investing €152 million to build the world's first production facility for quantum sensing\-based semiconductor inspection tools, supported under the European Chips Act.

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer
jobs.description: **Company Description** **Redica Systems** is the Intelligence Cloud for life sciences, transforming regulatory complexity into connected, proactive intelligence. Redica's platform helps the world's leading Pharmaceutical and MedTech companies stay inspection\-ready, manage supplier risk, and keep pace with evolving global regulations. Built on the Redica Catalyst Platform and powered by Redica ID, Redica unifies the industry's most complete regulatory and inspection datasets, sourced from hundreds of global health authorities, into trusted intelligence for quality and regulatory teams. The Redica Intelligence Cloud brings data together to anticipate risk, accelerate compliance, and enable smarter, faster decisions across the enterprise. More information is available at redica.com. **Job Description** We're looking for an experienced Senior Data Engineer to take a hands\-on role in designing, building, and optimizing our core data platform. You'll work on challenging technical problems, help shape architectural decisions, establish engineering best practices, and build scalable, high\-quality data pipelines. You'll also have opportunities to mentor fellow engineers, contribute to code reviews, and provide technical guidance as the team grows. **Core Responsibilities** * Data Pipeline Development: Design, build, optimize, and maintain scalable ETL/ELT pipelines, APIs, and microservices for high\-volume regulatory and health agency datasets. * Data Reliability \& Integrity: Troubleshoot data quality issues and implement automated testing, monitoring, and validation to ensure data accuracy and reliability. * Architecture \& Design: Contribute to technical design and architectural decisions, building scalable, maintainable solutions that support our evolving data platform. * System Integration: Integrate data pipelines with downstream NLP/ML services and search technologies, including the ELK stack. * Production Operations: Support production deployments, troubleshoot pipeline and database issues, and resolve complex technical incidents. * Cross\-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with Engineering and Product teams to translate requirements into practical, well\-designed technical solutions. **Qualifications** * **Tech Savvy:** You effectively anticipate and adopt innovations in business\-building technology solutions, staying up\-to\-date with data advancements and incorporating them into work processes. * **Manages Complexity:** You actively synthesize solutions from complex information by identifying patterns and developing effective problem\-solving strategies to solve data\-related problems effectively. * **Decision Quality:** You consistently make good and timely decisions that propel organizational progress and maintain data integrity. * **Collaborates:** You actively engage in collaborative problem\-solving by leveraging diverse perspectives and finding innovative solutions to achieve shared goals and data engineering initiatives. * **Optimizes Work Processes:** You actively seek opportunities to enhance and streamline current work processes for managing data pipelines, ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) processes, and data warehousing. * **Drives Results:** You strive to continuously improve performance and exceed expectations to contribute to overall success and meet data\-related deliverables. * **Strategic Mindset:** You consistently demonstrate a strategic mindset by envisioning future possibilities and successfully translating them into breakthrough data strategies, contributing to the organization's long\-term success. * **Engaged:** You not only share our values but also possess the essential competencies needed to thrive at Redica, as outlined here. **Additional Information** Top Pharmaceutical Companies, Food Manufacturers, MedTech Companies, and Service Firms from around the globe rely on Redica Systems to mine and process government inspection, enforcement, and registration data. This enables them to quantify risk signals from their suppliers, identify market opportunities, benchmark against peers, and prepare for the latest inspection trends. Our data and analytics have been cited by major media outlets, including MSNBC, *The Wall Street Journal*, and *The Boston Globe*.

jobs.title: Civil Engineer
jobs.description: Experience level: Mid\-senior Experience required: 6 Years Education level: Bachelor’s degree Job function: Engineering Industry: Real Estate Total position: 1 Relocation assistance: No Visa sponsorship eligibility: No **About the Role** The Civil Engineer oversees and expedites commercial, residential, and mixed\-use land development projects from conception to completion. Continually seeks to expedite projects and improve efficiency while maintaining established project standards. Prepares land development budgets, budget revisions, maintains compliance, and provides exception reporting. Develops and maintains project schedules and is responsible for achieving company objectives. **Key Responsibilities** Leads and supports the design and execution of land development projects from concept through completion. Develops, monitors, and manages detailed project schedules and reports, from project inception through design, entitlement, permitting, construction and bond release. Develops, monitors, and manages detailed cost projections, budgets, resource management plans, change orders, and plan changes with contractors and consultants, ensuring projects stay on schedule, within budget, and meet quality expectations. Evaluates the cost, schedule, and constructability impacts of design revisions and scope changes; coordinates with contractors to develop and negotiate change orders; updates project budgets and forecasts; and communicates approved revisions to external engineers, architects, surveyors, and other third\-party consultants to ensure all project teams are working from the latest approved plans and project requirements. Coordinates with internal teams, consultants, contractors, and public agencies to ensure projects remain on schedule, within budget, and in compliance with all regulatory requirements. Review and approve invoices, change orders, and payment applications. Oversees site plan development, grading, stormwater management systems, utility and infrastructure designs in coordination with the Construction Engineer. Prepares Requests for Proposals (RFPs) and manages the competitive bidding process for consultants, contractors, and vendors. Reviews and compares proposals for completeness, technical qualifications, project approach, pricing, and schedule; identifies scope gaps and cost variances; negotiates where appropriate; and presents bid evaluations and award recommendations to the Executive Vice President for approval. Coordinates contract execution following award. Manages relationships with consultants, general contractors, subcontractors, inspectors, utilities, public agencies, and regulatory bodies to keep land development work progressing efficiently. Reviews and interprets construction drawings, specifications, and documents to confirm alignment with project goals. Amends plans as necessary to accommodate changes to expedite bond release. Partners with the Field Operations Project Manager to facilitate the transition from design to construction by coordinating project schedules, construction logistics, contractor activities, design clarifications, and field modifications. Ensures project changes are communicated effectively and incorporated into budgets, schedules, and contract documents. Manages the implementation and administration of development proffers throughout the project lifecycle. Coordinates with civil engineers, land use attorneys, consultants, and Loudoun County staff to ensure all applicable proffer obligations are accurately incorporated into site plans, construction documents, and project schedules. Develops and maintains comprehensive proffer tracking logs, monitors compliance milestones, coordinates the completion of required improvements and contributions, and prepares, assembles, and submits supporting documentation to the County to demonstrate satisfaction of proffer obligations and facilitate formal proffer release or acceptance. Regularly visit job sites, monitor progress, and in coordination with the Construction Engineer, quickly address any construction challenges that arise. In coordination with the Field Operations Project Manager, receives and facilitates timely responses to project concerns raised by owners, residents, tenants, builders, agencies, and association representatives. Establishes and upholds quality control standards across all projects. Ensures all work complies with local building codes, safety standards, and company guidelines. **What We Are Looking For** Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering and a Professional Engineer (PE) license in Virginia (or the ability to obtain reciprocity within 6 months). 7\+ years of experience overseeing land development for commercial, residential, and mixed\-use construction projects. Strong ability to read, interpret, and amend construction drawings, specifications, and contracts. Experience with construction management and scheduling tools such as Procore, Bluebeam, or Primavera. Exceptional communication, analytical problem\-solving, and leadership abilities, with a proven track record of keeping cross\-functional teams aligned and on target. **Preferred:** OSHA 30 certification. **Work Environment \& Physical Demands** This role features a dynamic mix of office work and active site visits. Regular field work requires walking uneven terrain, climbing stairs, and working outdoors in various weather conditions while wearing required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) such as hard hats, safety glasses, and steel\-toed boots. Ability to lift/carry light to moderate loads (up to 20–30 lbs) such as plans, laptops, and safety gear. Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $150,000\.00 per year Work Location: Hybrid remote in Brambleton, VA 20148

jobs.title: Staff Application Security Engineer
jobs.description: At Reltio®, an SAP Company, we believe data should fuel your success in the enterprise AI era. Our Context Intelligence Platform turns fragmented data into a trusted, connected context so AI agents and systems can act with expert\-level judgement at enterprise scale. Reltio's cloud\-native SaaS platform harmonizes, unifies, and governs data across sources and formats—including unstructured data—in real time, turning them into data assets that can be mobilized in milliseconds to any application, user, or AI agent. Trusted by more than 200 of the world's largest brands across industries such as life sciences, financial services, healthcare, and technology, we fuel frictionless operations and help enterprises accelerate innovation and reduce risk. At Reltio, our values guide everything we do. With an unyielding commitment to prioritizing our "Customer First", we strive to ensure their success. We embrace our differences and are "Better Together" as One Reltio. We are always looking to "Simplify and Share" our knowledge when we collaborate to remove obstacles for each other. We hold ourselves accountable for our actions and outcomes and strive for excellence. We "Own It". Every day, we innovate and evolve, so that today is "Always Better Than Yesterday". If you share and embody these values, we invite you to join our team at Reltio and contribute to our mission of excellence. Reltio has earned numerous awards and industry and analyst recognition for our technology, our culture and our people. Reltio was founded on a distributed workforce and offers flexible work arrangements to help our people manage their personal and professional lives. If you're ready to work on unrivaled technology where your desire to be part of a collaborative team is met with a laser\-focused mission to enable digital transformation with connected data, let's talk! **Job Summary:** As a senior individual contributor on the Application Security team, the Staff Application Security Engineer will help to define and drive Reltio's application and product security architecture across a distributed, cloud\-native SaaS platform. This role helps in the technical direction for securing how Reltio designs, builds, and ships software—helps to define the strategy and roadmap for secure SDLC, shift\-left automation, and the secure adoption of API\-driven and AI/agentic technologies. The Staff Application Security Engineer will partner with the Engineering, DevOps, Product, and Release Management teams to embed security as a foundational part of software design and delivery. The successful candidate will set standards, mentor and uplevel other security and engineering staff, lead complex threat modeling and architecture reviews, and develop novel techniques to identify and stop application\- and AI\-layer attacks—protecting Reltio's intellectual property and customer data globally. **Job Duties and Responsibilities:** **Security Architecture \& Technical Leadership** * Serve as the senior application security subject matter expert, providing guidance on industry best practices, secure design patterns, and defense\-in\-depth strategies for the product security architecture. * Helps to define and drive the overall application/product security architecture, vision, strategy, and roadmap across Reltio's platform and services. * Influence engineering architecture and roadmap decisions without direct authority, driving risk\-based consensus across teams. * Mentor and uplevel application security engineers and development teams, raising the secure\-coding maturity of the broader organization. **Secure Development Lifecycle \& Shift\-Left** * Embed security throughout the SDLC, from design through deployment, and define secure coding standards and best practices adopted across teams. * Drive shift\-left initiatives by providing guidance, tooling, paved\-road patterns, and remediation support that enable engineers to build securely from the outset. **CI/CD Pipeline Security** * Design and implement security controls within CI/CD pipelines, enabling automated security testing and vulnerability detection at scale. * Operationalize SAST, SCA, DAST, and secrets scanning as policy\-driven, low\-friction gates; partner with release management on secure deployment checks and policy compliance. **Threat Modeling \& Risk Assessment** * Lead threat modeling sessions for complex, high\-impact systems to identify and mitigate security risks early in design and architecture phases. * Perform technical risk assessments of new technology and ensure solutions meet secure architecture designs; jobs.description: **Job Title: Business Data Architect – Digital Project Delivery (Azure Databricks Lakehouse)** ============================================================================================== **Why this role** Southern Company is advancing Digital Project Delivery to improve how data is created, governed, integrated, and used across large capital projects, with a primary focus on generation. These projects generate and rely on complex data spanning engineering, design, construction, commissioning, asset handover, schedule, cost, contracts, and document controls. When structured well, this data improves project execution, decision\-making, risk management, reporting, and long\-term asset value. You will also serve as a key architecture partner to the technology organization, helping shape the target\-state Azure Databricks Lakehouse, integration approach, and platform capabilities needed to support project delivery data at enterprise scale. You will help establish the data foundations that enable consistency across major capital programs, improve interoperability between systems and delivery partners, and support better visibility into project performance and outcomes. This is a highly visible, cross\-functional role where your decisions will influence how Southern Company manages project information and digital delivery capabilities for years to come. **About the role** You will lead the business data architecture for Digital Project Delivery while partnering closely with enterprise architecture, platform engineering, integration teams, and cybersecurity to define how project data should be structured, governed, integrated, and delivered through the Azure Databricks Lakehouse and related enterprise platforms. This role is expected to provide technically credible leadership on lakehouse design principles, data movement patterns, integration architecture, environment strategy, and platform/tool selection decisions that affect scalability, operability, security, and long\-term supportability. jobs.title: Agentic AI Platform Engineer
jobs.description: Company Overview Spectrix Analytical Services is seeking an Agentic Platform Engineer. This role focuses on building and operating the AWS platform that hosts AI agents, MCP servers, and agent tooling for discovery research groups. This is a full\-time (40 hours/week) remote position open to candidates in the United States. Working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern time are preferred; West Coast candidates who can overlap with Eastern business hours will also be considered. The contractor will own the runtime, access control, and deployment path that agents run on. Agents and MCP servers built by the team call internal APIs, Snowflake, and scientific applications on behalf of individual scientists, so the platform has to authenticate users through Entra ID, scope what each agent can reach, keep credentials out of agent code, and record what each agent did. In addition to the platform, the contractor will build MCP servers, agent skills, and other integrations as needed, and we expect the work to move between platform and integration as priorities shift. Areas of work: * **Agent runtime.** Stand up and operate the runtime that hosts agents and MCP servers, using Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime, together with serverless (Lambda) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. Define how a new agent or MCP server is packaged, deployed, versioned, and retired. * **Infrastructure as code.** Write and maintain the Terraform modules for the runtime, networking, gateways, and supporting services, so that a new environment, AWS account, or region is created from configuration. * **Gateway and access control.** Run the API gateway layer in front of agents and tools. Integrate Entra ID for user authentication, map Entra groups to the agents and tools each user can call, and implement token exchange so an agent calls downstream services with the requesting user’s permissions. * **Identity and secrets.** Design IAM roles and workload identity for agents and MCP servers, manage credentials for Snowflake and internal APIs through AWS Secrets Manager or equivalent, and automate rotation. * **CI/CD and observability.** Build the pipelines that test and deploy agents, MCP servers, and platform components. Instrument agent and tool calls with tracing, logs, and metrics so that latency, error rate, model usage, and cost can be reported per agent and per user group. * **MCP servers and integrations.** Build MCP servers and agent skills that connect agents to Snowflake, internal APIs, and scientific applications. Provide templates, a local development path, and documentation so that other teams can ship their own MCP servers and skills onto the platform without platform changes for each one. Key Responsibilities: * Develop and maintain production Python services, MCP servers, platform tooling, and CLI utilities. * Write and review Terraform for all platform infrastructure as part of daily workflow. * Deploy and operate agent, serverless, and container workloads across AWS accounts and environments. * Maintain the access\-control model for agents and tools and review new integrations for how they handle identity, secrets, and data scope. * Work directly with scientists, application developers, and IT security to decide what to build, and support adoption through documentation and hands\-on help. Qualifications: * Bachelor’s degree with 7–10 years of relevant experience, or a Master’s degree with 5 or more years of relevant experience. * Experience having built and run a shared internal platform used by other engineering teams, including its deployment path, support, and upgrades. * Strong AWS experience with both serverless (Lambda, API Gateway, Step Functions or similar) and container (ECS or EKS) workloads. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore or a comparable agent runtime is strongly preferred. * Strong Terraform experience, including module design and multi\-account deployments. * Experience with API gateways and access control using Entra ID (Azure AD), including OAuth 2\.0 and OIDC flows. * Experience with cloud identity and secrets management: IAM, workload identity, Secrets Manager or Vault, and credential rotation. * Experience building CI/CD pipelines and observability for production services (tracing, structured logging, metrics, alerting). * Strong Python development skills with experience building production\-grade services or tooling. * Experience building LLM agents in production, including tool use, prompt and context design, and evaluation of agent behavior. * Experience building Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers or comparable tool integrations that let LLM agents call internal APIs and data sources. * Experience on a small team (roughly 3–10 engineers) where individuals own systems end to end, set their own priorities within a goal, and ship without a dedicated QA, SRE, or release function. * Routine use of agentic coding harnesses (Claude Code, OpenCode, Codex, or equivalent) as part of day\-to\-day development, with a view on where they help and where they do not. * Experience with Amazon Bedrock is a plus. * Experience with Snowflake or SQL\-based data access from services is a plus. * Experience in a life sciences, chemistry, or drug discovery environment is a plus. * Effective communicator who can work independently in a remote environment and collaborate with engineers, scientists, and IT security. Primary Location: United States (Remote — working hours within one to two hours of US Eastern preferred; West Coast considered) collaborate with both engineers and scientists. *Spectrix offers flexible schedules, competitive salaries, and a committed work environment to its employees; the company provides automatic benefits of life insurance and short and long term disability insurance. Optional benefits for full time employees include health, dental, and vision insurance, college loan assistance, and an employer matched retirement savings plan. Spectrix is not a placement agency.* *Spectrix is participating in the E\-Verify program of the U.S. Department of Homeland Security (phone number: 888\-897\-7781, and website: www.dhs.gov/E\-Verify).* Pay: $48\.00 \- $58\.00 per hour Experience: * Python: 7 years (Preferred) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer, Agentic Applications
jobs.description: Seattle Hybrid • San Francisco Hybrid Software Engineering Hybrid Full\-time **About Us** ============ Supio is a trusted AI platform purpose\-built for law firms, reshaping how data drives impactful outcomes. Our innovative approach blends technology with deep legal expertise, making us a leader in our field. We go beyond surface\-level AI to deeply understand our customers’ daily needs, empowering law firms with unparalleled data insights. Supio delivers human\-level, accurate analysis of complex data and legal records, quickly and efficiently bringing critical insights when they matter most. Trusted by top litigation lawyers, our platform has supported over $1 billion in settlements. Headquartered in Seattle with an office in San Francisco, we raised $60M Series B in April 2025 led by Sapphire Ventures with Mayfield and Thomson Reuters Ventures, bringing total funding to $91M. We're scaling rapidly and looking for exceptional talent to join us in this next phase of growth. We're looking for passionate team members who are motivated by our mission and ready to help us achieve it. ### **Who we're looking for** We're looking for **Senior and Staff Software Engineers** to join the Agentic Applications team at Supio. You'll build the software behind AI\-powered products that legal professionals rely on for high\-stakes work, so the code you ship has to be right. We hire full\-stack engineers who've gone deep. You're the person others turn to when a problem gets hard, with a strong backend foundation and the range to work across the rest of the stack. You work autonomously, partner well with product, design, and customers, and take a problem from fuzzy idea to shipped, operating software without waiting to be told what to build. You make good product calls and you leave the code, the system, and the team better than you found them. We're a small team and the impact is direct. You'll work next to engineers who've built this platform from the ground up, and you'll help shape what we build next. ### **What you'll build** You'll build and improve the software behind our AI\-powered products, wherever your skills are most needed. You'll: * **Own problems end to end.** Take ambiguous problems from idea to production: design, build, ship, and operate. You'll drive technical direction in your area and contribute to product decisions. * **Build systems that scale and hold up.** Design services, interfaces, and data pipelines that stay reliable at high volume and with large, complex datasets. * **Work across the stack where it matters.** Own work across frontend and backend, with the heaviest lift on the backend. * **Build with AI, and build AI\-powered features**. Use coding agents and AI tools to move faster, and help build, evaluate, and productionize LLM\- and agent\-driven capabilities with a focus on accuracy and reliability. * **Partner closely with product, design, and customer\-facing teams.** Understand what our users actually need and turn it into the right technical solution. * **Raise the bar.** Review code thoughtfully, mentor teammates, and build the shared tools and practices that help others move faster. At the Staff level, you'll do this across teams and set technical direction for a broader area. ### **Qualifications** * **8\+ years of professional software engineering experience** shipping and operating production systems. Staff candidates should show a track record of leading complex, cross\-team technical work. * **Full\-stack, with depth.** Strong software fundamentals and a track record across the stack, with your strongest experience on the backend (services, APIs, data, infrastructure, or systems). You're comfortable owning the frontend too. We don't screen on a specific language. * **Production AI experience.** You've built with LLMs or agentic systems (RAG, tool use, multi\-agent orchestration), you know how to evaluate whether they work, and you use AI coding tools every day. * **Ownership and product judgment.** You drive work end to end without hand\-holding, make good tradeoffs, and partner well with product, design, and customers. * **Clear communication,** written and in person. ### **Nice\-to\-haves** * Experience at both startups and larger companies * Experience mentoring engineers or leading teams * Experience with cloud platforms ### **Compensation** As an early\-stage startup, we offer a competitive compensation package that includes **base salary, meaningful equity, and benefits**. Equity grants are designed to ensure employees share in the long\-term success and upside of the company. **Base Salary by Level and Location** **Senior Software Engineer** * San Francisco: $190,000 – $240,000 annually * Seattle: $180,000 – $230,000 annually **Staff Software Engineer** * San Francisco: $230,000 – $270,000 annually * Seattle: $220,000 – $250,000 annually This role is open at both the Senior and Staff levels. Final level, and therefore final compensation, is determined during the interview process based on the scope, depth, and impact demonstrated by the candidate. Within each range, placement depends on factors such as qualifications, skills, and experience. **Compensation \& Benefits** * Competitive Salary \+ Meaningful Equity * 401(k) * + Health, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance * Flexible Time Off \+ Holidays ‍ * High\-autonomy work environment, every Tuesday is a Remote Work Day * DoorDash subsidies for breakfast and dinner; Daily lunch options * Boba Wednesdays * Monthly commuter subsidies and pre\-tax parking contribution * Team gatherings and offsites ### **E\-Verify Participation Notice** *Supio participates in E\-Verify, an employment authorization program through the U.S. Department of Homeland Security and the Social Security Administration.* ### **Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Statement** *Supio is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status.*

This individual will play a crucial role in building, maintaining, and enhancing our machine learning applications, specifically those deployed on AWS Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) and on\-premises machine learning cluster. The ideal candidate will have experience with application development, cloud infrastructure, containerization, and DevOps practices, as well as the ability to work on both on\-premises and cloud environments. Specific Duties and Responsibilities: * Develop, maintain, and optimize RESTful APIs using Python and FastAPI. * Deploy \& manage applications on AWS EKS, ensuring high availability, scalability, and performance. * Integrate with various data sources \& services (e.g., MongoDB, Postgres) for efficient data storage and retrieval. * Implement CI/CD pipelines to automate testing and deployment processes. * Collaborate across teams to ensure seamless integration of cloud\-native tools and practices. * Maintain on\-premises servers running Ceph, PostgreSQL, and NFS services. * Troubleshoot \& resolve issues across different environments (development, staging, production). * Participate in code reviews, pair programming, and knowledge sharing sessions. **Requirements** * Bachelor's Degree RDS, and VPCs. * Familiarity with CI/CD tools like GitLab CI/CD or Jenkins. * Strong understanding of database systems, including MongoDB, PostgreSQL, and NFS. * Experience with on\-premises storage solutions like Ceph. * Expertise in Linux system administration. * Ability to write clean, maintainable code and perform thorough testing. * Excellent problem\-solving skills and a strong attention to deta. * Experience with cloud\-native observability tools (Prometheus, Grafana) is a plus. * Familiarity with Kubernetes operators and Helm charts is a plus. * Knowledge of container orchestration on\-premises using K8s or similar technologies is a plus. * Experience with DevOps best practices and infrastructure as code (Terraform, Ansible) is a plus. **Benefits** * Medical: Several plan options including PPO and HSA\-compatible plans from Anthem Blue Cross, most of which are 100% paid by Syntiant Corp. for you and your family. * Dental: Company\-paid dental PPO coverage from MetLife, including coverage for Orthodontia. * Vision: Company\-paid vision PPO coverage from MetLife / VSP. * Life Insurance / AD\&D: Company\-paid basic Life / AD\&D coverage in the amount of 3x your salary (up to $1,000,000\). Additional supplemental life insurance with low group rates is available for yourself and your family. * Disability Coverage: Company\-paid Short Term and Long\-Term Disability coverage provides up to 60% income replacement protection. * Spending and Savings Accounts: Flexible Spending Account (FSA) benefits for Health Care and Dependent Care. Health Savings Accounts (HSA) for those enrolled in a qualified Medical plan. * 401K Retirement Plan: Administered by Empower, the 401(k) plan allows you to plan for your future by investing a portion of each paycheck. * Other Benefits: A company\-provided Employee Assistance Program (EAP), as well as access to additional voluntary benefits including Accident, Critical Illness, Hospital Indemnity, Legal Support, and Identity Fraud Protection. **About Syntiant:** Founded in 2017 and headquartered in Irvine, Calif., Syntiant Corp. is a leader in delivering hardware and software solutions for edge AI deployment.
