jobs.title: Engineering Technician 2
jobs.description: The Metropolitan District Commission (MDC) provides quality water supply, water pollution control, mapping, and household hazardous waste collection to eight member municipalities: Bloomfield, East Hartford, Hartford, Newington, Rocky Hill, West Hartford, Wethersfield and Windsor. Additionally, the MDC provides drinking water to portions of Farmington, Glastonbury, East Granby and South Windsor, known as the MDC's non\-member towns. **JOB SUMMARY** This is responsible engineering technical work involving the survey and inspection of utility construction plans and permits, investigation of sanitary sewer, storm drain and water service installations and the operation of applicable instruments/equipment. Work involves responsibility for safe operation of survey instruments and inspection of construction. Duties include inspecting water and sewer main construction, operating a survey transit and other survey instruments, and maintaining records. This position also has the responsibility for making survey transit operation and construction inspection decisions in accordance with established procedures. This work requires that the employee have good knowledge, skill in surveying, construction inspection, utility services, drafting, mapping and administration of standard water and sewer construction plans and permits. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS** **The following duties are normal for this position. The omission of specific statements of the duties does not exclude them from the classification if the work is similar, related, or a logical assignment for this classification. Other duties may be required and assigned.** * Inspect standard and highly complex utility pipeline and building mechanical systems construction and materials. Instruct contractors in construction practices and in correcting construction errors. Enforce inspection decisions. Oversee contractor pressure tests of water, sewer and force main pipelines. * Coordinate and track the progress of contracted construction programs. Carry out liaison between District engineers and contractors. Lead construction inspection teams in the largest projects or on\-going construction programs, as assigned. Demonstrate construction inspection practices and guides less experienced inspectors. * Compile outstanding deficiencies for substantially completed construction projects and resolves issues with contractors. Ensure the accuracy and completeness of associated documentation at the completion of a construction project. * Ensure that work zones comply with MDC and OSHA safety standards. * Respond to state Call Before You Dig Mark\-out Program requests. Interprets existing records using various equipment to accurately identify and mark utilities. Maintain accurate mark\-outs and document mark\-outs through video/photo and GPS data collection of infrastructure marked out. * Assist in collection of monies for delinquent water accounts and miscellaneous bills. Confer with customers, attorneys or District personnel regarding collection action. Appear as a court witness representing the District. Establish payment schedules. Determine abatement of penalties and occupancy/hardship status. * Respond to inquiries and complaints and assist in the follow\-up of claims. Assist in processing and scheduling termination and restoration of service for non\-payment. Assist Operations Function with service shut on/off during off\-hours. Demonstrate service termination procedures. * Monitor customer compliance with wastewater discharge limits against Federal/State/Local/District regulations * Calculate discharge fees related to specific customer discharges. * Inspect standard cross\-connections in all types of structures for backflow conditions. Conducts surveys of industries for possible hazardous waste discharge, determines corrective actions and assures their implementation. Perform surveys at residential and small/medium Industrial and Commercial facilities * Determine backflow prevention measures for standard problems and assures the implementation of those measures by the owner. Investigate standard water contamination problems, including meter readings, excessive water use, water leaks, and water quality, and determine corrective actions to be taken and assures their implementation. * + Perform and document private property surveys with regards to the District's sewer backup prevention program and the water and sewer service line inspection and replacement program, including monitoring and tracking of assessments, permitting, execution and completion. Coordinate required improvement with contractors + Conduct research and makes recommendations for inclusion of customers' property in the District's inflow, backwater device installation, rain water disconnect, and similar programs. Meet with property owners and others to explain program implications. Assists in development of strategy for effective program presentation, implementation and expansion. Educates customers through home vi flow conditions. Conducts surveys of industries for possible hazardous waste discharge, determines corrective actions and assures their implementation. Tests backflow prevention devices. * Determines backflow prevention measures for standard problems and assures the implementation of those measures by the owner. * Responds to emergency calls on off hours * Performs related work as required. **MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS** An Associate's degree plus four (4\) years construction, drafting, Utility, or related experience. Must be certified, or be able to be certified within one year, as a CT Backflow Prevention Tester and a Cross\-Connection Survey Inspector and a Connecticut Water Distribution System Operator Class I. Must have a valid driver's license **As part of the screening process, applicants will be required to take a written and practical exam. jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
jobs.description: **Job Requirements** Walt Disney Animation Studios’ world\-class filmmakers, artists, and technical collaborators create the magic of animation. The SRE team within the Platform \& Infrastructure department at Walt Disney Animation Studios (WDAS) focuses on optimizing service deployments and improving system availability, latency, performance, and observability. We build performant infrastructure that artists use daily to create our celebrated animated content. The Senior Site Reliability Engineer will drive the design, implementation, and operation of reliable, scalable infrastructure across the studio. This role partners closely with team members and stakeholders to evaluate emerging technologies, translate requirements into production\-ready solutions, and ensure operational excellence through automation, observability, and reliability engineering practices. Our studio thrives on a wide variety of technical backgrounds and experiences, so we encourage applicants to apply even if they have experiences not specified below. Bring your unique talents, passion and ideas to our team, and be a part of Disney’s creative legacy! **Responsibilities** -------------------- * Design, implement, and support robust on\-premises and cloud\-native deployments using infrastructure\-as\-code, security automation, and continuous improvement, while maintaining high reliability standards through comprehensive observability, SLIs/SLOs, and performance optimization * Securely deploy, operate, and support AI\-powered tools and ML infrastructure within a production environment * Collaborate with stakeholders throughout the studio to understand workflows and translate business requirements into end\-to\-end platform and infrastructure solutions * Contribute to the design, operation, and evolution of SRE managed technologies, including CI/CD platforms, Git source management, cloud hosting, containerization, and web technologies such as Apache HTTPd and NGINX * Develop meaningful telemetry, alerting, and operational runbooks to maximize service visibility and minimize mean time to repair (MTTR) * Evaluate emerging technologies and operationalize new functionality by creating documented standards and reusable patterns to encourage adoption * Build internal tooling to enable the SRE team to efficiently isolate, diagnose, and resolve platform, service, and application issues **Key Qualifications:** ----------------------- * BS in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or comparable field of study, and/or equivalent work experience * 5\+ years of experience in SRE, DevOps, technical operations, systems engineering, software engineering, and/or related disciplines * Expertise in distributed systems, networking, hardware architecture, and capacity planning * Proven ability to lead and collaborate on large\-scale cross\-team projects with strong verbal and written communication skills * Proficiency in UNIX/Linux administration, troubleshooting, performance tuning, and security * Experience with monitoring and observability tools such as Datadog, Prometheus, and Grafana, including AI\-specific metrics such as model benchmarking, inference latency, and token consumption * Proficient with containerization and orchestration systems in enterprise production environments (e.g., Docker, Podman, Kubernetes, Rancher, AWS ECS and EKS) * Experience with configuration management and infrastructure as code (e.g., Terraform, Helm, CloudFormation, Puppet, and Ansible) * Experience implementing enterprise MLOps infrastructure that enables validation, deployment, fallback, multi\-model routing, load balancing, quota management, inference metrics, and provider abstraction (leveraging technologies such as AWS Bedrock, JFrog Artifactory, and LiteLLM) * Experience with continuous integration tools (e.g., Jenkins, Gitlab CI/CD, AWS CodeBuild, CodeDeploy, Spinnaker) * Expertise in architecting, deploying, and maintaining scalable solutions within cloud environments (e.g., AWS, GCP, Azure) Experience with secrets management and data protection (e.g., HashiCorp Vault) Proficient in one or more languages such as Python, Java, Scala, Go, Rust, or Ruby **Bonus Qualifications:** ------------------------- * Experience within a Film Production environment * Experience in web server administration * Knowledge of securing MLOps deployments through implementing LLM and MCP gateways and security scanning (e.g., JFrog Xray) * Knowledge of with setting up and maintaining cloud/on\-prem runtime environments for AI agents (e.g., AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Google Vertex AI Agent Engine, Temporal) * Knowledge of provisioning, monitoring, and maintaining GPU infrastructure (e.g., NVIDIA GPUs, CUDA, cuDNN, NVML), including GPU virtualization and partitioning (e.g., NVIDIA MIG), and optimizing utilization for inference workloads * Knowledge of with model serving and inference frameworks (e.g., vLLM, SGLang, Ray Serve, Ollama / llama.cpp) with foundational knowledge of how LLMs are loaded and executed The Walt Disney Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. **Disclaimer** PAY TRANSPARENCY The hiring range for this position in California is $144,100 \- $193,200 per year based on a 40 hour work week. The amount of hours scheduled per week may vary based on business needs. The base pay actually offered will take into account internal equity and also may vary depending on the candidate's geographic region, job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience among other factors. A bonus and/or long\-term incentive units may be provided as part of the compensation package, in addition to the full range of medical, financial, and/or other benefits, dependent on the level and position offered. This position is with Walt Disney Pictures, which is part of a business we call Walt Disney Animation Studios. To learn more about Disney's guidelines on the use of AI for candidates, click here. Walt Disney Pictures is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Disney champions a business environment where ideas and decisions from all people help us grow, innovate, create the best stories and be relevant in a constantly evolving world. DISABILITY ACCOMMODATION FOR EMPLOYMENT APPLICATIONS The Walt Disney Company and its Affiliated Companies are Equal Employment Opportunity employers and welcome all job seekers including individuals with disabilities and veterans with disabilities. If you have a disability and believe you need a reasonable accommodation in order to search for a job opening or apply for a position, visit the Disney candidate disability accommodations FAQs. We will only respond to those requests that are related to the accessibility of the online application system due to a disability. Having technical issues? View the FAQs for help.

jobs.title: Data Engineer
jobs.description: ### **Description** We are looking for a **Data Engineer** with strong **Microsoft SQL Server and Snowflake** experience to join our Data \& Analytics engineering team. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys working with **large\-scale data, complex SQL, data pipelines, and production systems** and wants to play a key role in modernizing a large SQL Server\-based data platform to Snowflake and AWS. You will work across both our existing SQL Server environment and our modern cloud data platform, developing new capabilities while helping migrate and optimize existing data processing. **Tech Stack*** **Languages**: SQL, Python, C\#; scripting experience * **Databases**: Microsoft SQL Server, Snowflake * **Data Engineering**: ETL/ELT, Apache Airflow, data pipelines * **Cloud**: AWS, including S3 and other AWS data services * **Development**: Git, CI/CD, Liquibase, automated testing and deployment * **Data**: Market data, trade data, transaction cost analysis, and financial data ### **Key Responsibilities** * Develop, maintain, and optimize complex SQL Server queries, stored procedures, functions, views, and data processing workflows. * Design and develop scalable Snowflake data solutions, including data models, SQL transformations, loading processes, and analytical workloads. * Participate in the migration of large volumes of data and processing from SQL Server to Snowflake. * Analyze existing SQL Server logic and translate or redesign it for Snowflake where appropriate. * Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines using SQL, Python, and workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow. * Develop data ingestion and processing workflows using AWS, including S3\. * Perform SQL Server and Snowflake performance tuning, including query optimization, execution plans, indexing, statistics, warehouse sizing, and workload optimization. * Build data validation and reconciliation processes to ensure migrated and transformed data is accurate and complete. * Troubleshoot production data issues, identify root causes, and implement reliable long\-term solutions. * Implement monitoring, logging, alerting, and operational controls for critical data pipelines. * Collaborate with software engineers, service managers and implementation team, product teams, and DevOps. * Support and enhance existing Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) products and develop new functionality. * Work with large\-scale trade, market, benchmark, and financial data. ### **Skills, Knowledge and Expertise** **Essential Skills \& Experience** Educational Background:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, or a related field. Technical Skills:* Hands\-on experience with **Snowflake** and **AWS** **Cloud services** (particularly S3 and data services). * Strong hands\-on **SQL** development experience. * Python \& C\# scripting experience * Strong experience with **Microsoft SQL Server**, including complex queries, stored procedures, performance tuning, and troubleshooting. * Experience working with **large datasets and production data systems**. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. **Desirable Skills \& Experience*** Experience migrating SQL Server workloads to Snowflake or another cloud data platform. * Experience with Apache Airflow or similar orchestration technologies. * Experience with Git, CI/CD, Liquibase and automated deployment processes. * Experience with data quality, reconciliation, and data governance. * Knowledge of capital markets, trading, market data, or financial systems. * Experience with Transaction Cost Analysis (TCA) or other financial analytics. * Snowflake or AWS certification. AI\-Assisted Development:* We encourage engineers to use modern AI\-assisted development tools, such as Claude Code to accelerate development, debugging, testing, refactoring, and migration work. * Candidates should understand how to use AI effectively while independently validating generated code for correctness, security, performance, and maintainability. ### **Benefits** ***Competitive Benefits \& Perks*** *We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well\-being, growth, and work\-life balance.* * **Health \& Financial Security:** + Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance + Flexible Spending Accounts (FSA) \& Health Savings Accounts (HSA) + 401(k) retirement plan + Pre\-tax transit and parking benefits * **Time Off \& Flexibility:** + Enjoy the best of both worlds: the energy and collaboration of in\-person work, combined with the convenience and focus of remote days. This is a hybrid position requiring three days of in\-office collaboration per week, with the flexibility to work remotely for the remaining two days. Our hybrid model is designed to balance individual flexibility with the benefits of in\-person collaboration, enhanced team cohesion, spontaneous innovation, hands\-on mentorship opportunities and strengthens our company culture. + 22 days of Paid Time Off (PTO) per year, with the option to roll o w uninterrupted professional development. + An additional PTO day added during milestone anniversary years. + Robust paid holiday schedule with early dismissal. + Generous parental leave for all parents (including adoptive parents). * **Work\-Life Support \& Resources:** + Budget for tech accessories, including monitors, headphones, keyboards, and other office equipment. + Backup child and pet care, as well as tutoring services. + Milestone anniversary bonuses. * **Wellness \& Lifestyle Perks:** + Stipend and subsidy contributions toward personally\-owned cell phones + Contributions for gym memberships and health/wellness initiatives. + Discounted healthcare premiums. + Healthy meal delivery program subsidies. Trading Technologies (www.tradingtechnologies.com) is a global capital markets platform services company providing market\-leading technology for the end\-to\-end trading operations of Tier 1 banks, brokerages, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. With its roots in listed derivatives, the Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) company delivers “multi\-X” solutions, with “X” representing asset classes, functions, workflows, and geographies. This multi\-X approach features trade execution services across futures and options, fixed income, foreign exchange (FX), and cryptocurrencies, augmented by solutions for data and analytics, including transaction cost analysis (TCA); quantitative trading; compliance and trade surveillance; clearing and post\-trade allocation; and infrastructure services. The award\-winning TT platform ecosystem also helps exchanges deliver innovative solutions to their market participants and technology companies to distribute their complementary offerings to Trading Technologies’ clients. Trading Technologies is backed by leading global investment firms Thoma Bravo, one of the world’s largest and most experienced software investors, and 7Ridge, a global growth equity firm focused on technology\-enabled businesses. This investment supports Trading Technologies’ continued focus on product innovation, platform scalability, and long\-term growth for customers and partners worldwide. *Trading Technologies (TT) is an equal\-opportunity employer. Equal employment has been, and continues to be, a required practice at the Company. Trading Technologies’ practice of equal employment opportunity is to recruit, hire, train, promote, and base all employment decisions on ability rather than race, color, religion, national origin, sex/gender orientation, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, parental status, veteran, or any other protected status. Additionally, TT participates in the E\-Verify Program for US offices.* ### **About Trading Technologies** Trading Technologies is a Software\-as\-a\-Service (SaaS) technology platform provider to the global capital markets industry. The company’s award\-winning TT® platform connects to the world’s major international exchanges and liquidity venues in listed derivatives alongside a growing number of asset classes, including fixed income and cryptocurrencies. The TT platform delivers advanced tools for trade execution and order management, market data solutions, analytics, trade surveillance, risk management, and infrastructure services to the world’s leading sell\-side institutions, buy\-side firms, and exchanges. The company’s blue\-chip client base includes Tier 1 banks as well as brokers, money managers, hedge funds, proprietary traders, Commodity Trading Advisors (CTAs), commercial hedgers, and risk managers. These firms rely on the TT ecosystem to manage their end\-to\-end trading operations. In addition, exchanges utilize TT’s technology to deliver innovative solutions to their market participants. TT also strategically partners with technology companies to make their complementary offerings available to Trading Technologies’ global client base through the TT ecosystem.

jobs.title: Data Pipeline Engineer — Apache Airflow (Astronomer) & Python
jobs.description: **About the role** ------------------ Triade is a data and analytics consultancy working across the United States, Brazil and Mexico. We are adding two **data pipeline engineers** to a large pipeline build\-and\-migrate programme for a financial\-services client, delivered through our platform partner. This is a hands\-on build role. You will create data pipelines in **Python and PySpark**, author and operate Airflow DAGs, and take them all the way to production — not design slides about them. The volume is substantial, so we are looking for people who have run pipelines at scale and know what breaks. **A controlled banking environment — please read before applying** ------------------------------------------------------------------ All work is done inside the client's **highly controlled and monitored banking environment**. These rules are not negotiable: * **No AI\-assisted development.** AI coding assistants and generative AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT or similar) may not be used for any work on this engagement. You write the code yourself. * **No copy and paste** into or out of the environment. * **No file upload or download** — nothing leaves or enters the environment except through the client's approved channels. * **Activity is monitored.** Sessions and actions in the environment are logged and reviewed. A breach of these rules can end the engagement immediately, damage your professional reputation and Triade's, and expose the people involved to legal action. If you cannot work this way, this role is not for you. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Create ETL/ELT pipelines in Python and PySpark** — ingestion, transformation, orchestration, retries, idempotency, backfills. * **Author and operate Apache Airflow DAGs** — dependencies, sensors, dynamic task mapping, SLAs, alerting. Keep a daily chain running when one task fails. * **Deploy to production** — CI/CD, code review, environment promotion, release discipline in a controlled, audited environment. * **Migrate and implement at volume** — a large backlog of jobs to stand up; repeatability and patterns matter more than bespoke cleverness. * **Own operational quality** — monitoring, logging, cost and runtime, incident response on your own pipelines. * **Communicate in writing, in English** — pull requests, runbooks, status to the client. **What you need** ----------------- * **Expert\-level Apache Airflow in production.** Not coursework, not "exposure" — you have owned DAGs that other people depended on. * **Strong Python and PySpark for data engineering** — clean, tested, reviewed code, **written without AI assistance**. * **You have deployed to production yourself**, through CI/CD, in an environment with change control. * **SQL** and comfort with warehouse/lakehouse patterns. * **Comfort working under strict security controls** — no AI tools, no copy and paste, no file transfer, monitored sessions. * **English at a working professional level.** You will write for and speak to a financial services client. This one is not negotiable. * **Available to start in early November** and to work United States business hours. There is no extended ramp on this engagement. **Nice to have** ---------------- * **Astronomer / Astro** specifically — managed Airflow, Astro CLI, deployment workflows. * Astronomer or Apache Airflow certification. * **Starburst, Trino, Iceberg**, or similar federated query and lakehouse technology. * Financial services or another regulated environment — ideally inside a bank's controlled environment. * dbt, Kafka; AWS, Azure or GCP. * Experience on a large migration rather than greenfield only. **How we work** --------------- * Fully remote, United States business hours. * Written status over verbal — a decision that is not written down did not happen. * You work alongside data architects and platform engineers, and with partner delivery teams. **Details** ----------- Independent contractor through Triade LLC, paid in US dollars, 6 to 12 months, hourly, extendable. **Tell us your expected hourly rate and currency when you apply.** Triade is an equal opportunity company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Location Remote Type Remote Contract Contract Published 10/18/2026

jobs.title: ServiceNow Developer — ITSM & Scripting
jobs.description: **¿Hablas español?** Buscamos desarrolladores ServiceNow en Latinoamérica para un cliente cuyo equipo trabaja en español. Si tienes experiencia práctica en ServiceNow ITSM y scripting, postúlate: el español es una ventaja clara. También se requiere inglés profesional. **About the role** ------------------ Triade is a data and analytics consultancy working across the United States, Brazil and Mexico. We are looking for hands\-on **ServiceNow developers** in **Latin America** to work on an ITSM implementation and improvement programme for an established enterprise client. **Spanish\-speaking candidates are strongly preferred** — the client team works in Spanish. This is a build\-and\-fix role, not an advisory one. You will configure and script in ServiceNow, pick up incidents and requests, and resolve them without waiting to be told how. **What you will do** -------------------- * **Configure and develop in ServiceNow ITSM** — incident, request, change, problem and CMDB. * **Script** — Business Rules, Client Scripts, Script Includes, UI Actions and Policies, Flow Designer, and integrations over REST and SOAP. * **Build and maintain** catalog items, workflows and forms. * **Troubleshoot independently** — diagnose, reproduce, fix and verify, and say clearly what you did and why. * **Work with client stakeholders** directly, in Spanish and in English. **What you need** ----------------- * **Hands\-on ServiceNow development**, not administration only. * **Strong scripting** — JavaScript in the ServiceNow context, Glide APIs. * **Solid ITSM process knowledge** — you know what a change record is for, not just where the field lives. * **Demonstrated independent troubleshooting.** This role has limited hand\-holding. * **Spanish at a professional level — strongly preferred.** The client team works in Spanish. * **Working professional English.** * Available for **United States business hours**. **Nice to have** ---------------- * ServiceNow **Certified System Administrator (CSA)**; **CAD**; **CIS** in ITSM. * Integrations with monitoring, HR or ERP systems. * Experience on a manufacturing or industrial client. * ITIL foundation. **How we work** --------------- * Fully remote, United States business hours. * Written status over verbal — a decision that is not written down did not happen. * Independent contractor through Triade LLC, paid in US dollars. **Details** ----------- Tell us your expected hourly rate and currency when you apply. Triade is an equal opportunity company. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable law. Location Remote Type Remote Contract Contract Published 10/18/2026

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer (Atlanta, Georgia)
jobs.description: **Shape the Future with TribalScale** ===================================== TribalScale is a digital innovation firm that helps organizations adapt and thrive in a rapidly changing world. We partner with clients to build transformative digital products, modernize technology platforms, and apply emerging technologies—including artificial intelligence—to meaningful business challenges. Our teams work closely with clients from strategy through execution. We value curiosity, ownership, practical innovation, and people who are comfortable turning ambiguity into action. **Our Digital Expertise** * **Transformation Experts:** We transform traditional business models into agile, AI\-powered ecosystems. * **Strategic Visionaries:** We navigate the uncharted waters of technological evolution. * **Product Virtuosos:** We orchestrate the creation of world\-class digital solutions. * **Code Optimizers:** We leverage AI to refine and perfect digital systems. **Our Technological Toolkit** * **Mobile \& Web Development:** (iOS, Android, React Native, React, Node.js) * **Voice\-Activated Platforms:** (Amazon Alexa, Google Home) * **Connected Ecosystems:** (Cars and Homes) * **Streaming Platforms:** (Roku, Fire TV, Android TV, tvOS) **The TribalScale Professional** You thrive in challenging environments where innovation is key. Your passion for technology is matched only by your drive to redefine its limits. You seek more than a job; you seek a calling—a chance to make a lasting impact on the digital landscape. **The Opportunity** ------------------- TribalScale is looking for a Forward Deployed Engineer to work at the intersection of software engineering, artificial intelligence, product development, and client delivery. In this role, you will embed with client and internal teams to understand complex business problems, rapidly design solutions, and deploy production\-quality software in real\-world environments. You will operate as both a hands\-on engineer and a trusted technical partner—translating business needs into working products while helping clients make sound technology decisions. You will be expected to understand more than models and prompts. You will help design the systems around AI models: the harnesses, agent loops, state graphs, tools, context, evaluations, observability, permissions, and human controls required to make AI applications useful and reliable in production. This role is ideal for an adaptable engineer who enjoys direct customer interaction, can move comfortably between discovery and delivery, and wants to see their work create immediate, measurable impact. **What You'll Do** ------------------ * Partner directly with clients to understand their objectives, workflows, technical environments, data, and operational constraints. * Translate ambiguous business challenges into clear technical requirements, solution architectures, prototypes, and delivery plans. * Design and build AI\-enabled applications, agentic workflows, developer tools, APIs, data pipelines, and full\-stack products. * Engineer the harnesses around AI models, including prompts, tools, context, memory, permissions, runtime controls, observability, and feedback mechanisms. * Build and refine agent loops that support planning, tool selection, execution, observation, reflection, recovery, and termination. * Model complex workflows as graphs, state machines, or other orchestration patterns that coordinate models, tools, data, systems, and human approvals. * Create evaluation frameworks that measure task completion, accuracy, reliability, safety, latency, cost, and user value. * Develop rapid prototypes and proofs of concept, validate them with real users and representative evaluations, and evolve successful ideas into secure, scalable products. * Integrate solutions with client systems, enterprise data sources, cloud platforms, and third\-party services. * Work across the technology stack, contributing wherever needed—from user interfaces and backend services to AI infrastructure, data workflows, and deployment pipelines. * Implement appropriate safeguards, permission boundaries, approval steps, and fallbacks for autonomous and semi\-autonomous systems. * Instrument AI applications so teams can inspect traces, understand intermediate states, diagnose failures, and improve system performance. * Identify and address failure modes such as hallucinations, looping, brittle tool calls, context loss, prompt injection, non\-deterministic behavior, and unsafe actions. * Troubleshoot complex technical and operational issues in client environments. * Communicate technical decisions, risks, trade\-offs, and progress clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Collaborate with product managers, designers, engineers, data specialists, security teams, and client stakeholders throughout the delivery lifecycle. * Establish strong engineering practices, including automated testing, documentation, observability, security, and continuous d nt frameworks, or related open\-source projects. * Experience working in regulated or complex enterprise environments. * Experience in consulting, professional services, solutions engineering, sales engineering, or another customer\-facing technical role. * A history of taking products from initial discovery through production launch and ongoing adoption. * Claude Certified Architect \- Foundations or Professional certification (or equivalent), with practical experience designing and implementing Claude\-based AI solutions, agentic workflows, and enterprise integrations. * Experience with agentic AI and harness\-driven development, including designing, building, and optimizing autonomous AI agents, multi\-agent workflows, tool integrations, and agent harnesses that support reliable, scalable, and production\-ready AI applications. **What Success Looks Like** --------------------------- In your first few months, you will have built trusted relationships with client and TribalScale teams, developed a strong understanding of the client's operating environment, and contributed working software to a meaningful business challenge. As you grow in the role, you will: * Turn loosely defined client needs into clear, executable technical plans. * Deliver AI\-enabled products that perform reliably outside of controlled demonstrations. * Establish evaluation and observability practices that make quality measurable and regressions visible. * Improve agent behavior by refining harnesses, loops, tools, graphs, context, and safeguards—not only by changing prompts or models. * Help client teams understand what their AI systems can do, where they can fail, and how they should be operated responsibly. * Create reusable technical patterns that accelerate future TribalScale engagements. * Become a trusted partner who can navigate uncertainty, solve difficult technical problems, and help promising ideas reach production. **Why TribalScale** ------------------- * Work on high\-impact challenges across industries and technology domains. * Build real products and production systems—not just recommendations or presentations. * Work directly with clients and see the impact of your decisions. * Explore emerging approaches to AI, agentic systems, product development, and software delivery. * Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams that value experimentation and continuous learning. * Influence both client outcomes and TribalScale's evolving technical practices. * Join an environment where ownership, diverse perspectives, and thoughtful innovation are encouraged. **Why Choose TribalScale** At TribalScale, collaboration is at the heart of our innovative approach. We don't simply work for clients; we form partnerships, building transformative solutions that redefine what's possible. Our team, once at the forefront of the mobile revolution, now leads the charge in AI\-driven innovation. We empower each team member to be a catalyst for change, adhering to our principles of meritocracy, empowerment, and transparency. Diversity isn't just celebrated—it's fundamental to our strength. Our mission to "Right the Future" is a call to action to make a significant impact in the world of innovation. **Diversity: Our Collective Strength** TribalScale proudly stands as a beacon of equal opportunity in employment and workplace culture. We are steadfastly committed to equal employment opportunity, transcending the boundaries of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, able\-bodiedness, or gender identity. We not only welcome but actively encourage applications from individuals of all abilities, ages, citizenships, marital statuses, and gender identities. Your unique perspective is the key to our collective innovation. Should you require any accommodations, we implore you to inform us. Our commitment to inclusivity knows no bounds, and we stand ready to adapt our processes to ensure your comfort and success.

jobs.title: Senior Solution Engineer, AI Products - MCP Manager
jobs.description: Usercentrics is a global leader in consent management, and now we're bringing that same mission of trust and control into the AI era. MCP Manager (MCPM) is our newest product: a governance and management platform for Model Context Protocol (MCP), the emerging standard that connects AI agents to business systems like Salesforce, Confluence, Slack, and GitHub. As AI adoption accelerates, enterprises face a new and urgent challenge: how do you give teams the power of AI agents while maintaining visibility, security, and control over what those agents can access and do? MCP Manager is the answer, serving as the trust and control layer for AI agent connections. This is a category\-creation opportunity. MCP is being compared to the invention of the USB connector for AI: a universal standard that changes everything. We're looking for a Senior Sales Engineer who wants to be on the ground floor of defining that category and to become the technical voice customers trust when they put AI agents into production. As our Senior Solution Engineer, you will own the technical side of every MCP Manager evaluation, from the first discovery call through a successful proof of concept and into onboarding. After the sale, you will partner with our Customer Success Manager to provide post\-sales engineering support as customers expand their use of MCP Manager. You will partner with each of our Account Executives to win deals across a shared pipeline, lead security and architecture reviews with CISOs and IT teams, and build the demo environments, solution plans, and technical materials that help prospects see MCP Manager working against their own AI stack. When customers run into technical issues, you will investigate and resolve them yourself with modern AI coding tools, bringing in engineering only when needed. You will sit within the MCP Manager engineering team, which gives you direct access to the people building the gateway and a clear path for turning field feedback into product improvements. The role exists now because buyers are moving from AI experiments to production agent rollouts, and they need a trusted technical guide who can show them how to govern those connections with confidence. **Your Tasks:** Technical Discovery \& Demos* Lead technical discovery with AI leads, engineering managers, and IT teams to map each prospect's AI clients, MCP servers, identity provider, and governance requirements. * Deliver tailored product demonstrations that show MCP Manager governing the prospect's own tools and workflows. * Verify compatibility between a prospect's AI ecosystem and MCP Manager before demos and trials, and raise any gaps with product and engineering early. Proofs of Concept \& Trials* Support Account Executives as they scope each proof of concept with the prospect by identifying the technical blockers that need to be resolved before the PoC begins, such as compatibility of the MCP servers and clients in play, workspace access, and identity setup. * Support customers through each proof of concept as they configure gateways, identities, and configure policies themselves, answering their questions in real time over Slack or in\-product chat. * Drive each evaluation to a clear technical decision on an agreed timeline and document the outcome for the deal team. Security \& Compliance Reviews* Lead security questionnaires, architecture reviews, and vendor due diligence with CISOs, security teams, and compliance reviewers. * Explain how MCP Manager handles authentication, data flow, logging, and access control in terms that security and audit stakeholders can act on. * Maintain a library of reusable answers and security documentation, working with engineering and Legal to keep it accurate. Post\-Sales Support \& Enablement* Build and maintain demo environments, solution plans, reference architectures, and technical guides for the sales team and for prospects. * Partner with our Customer Success Manager to onboard new customers with a documented configuration, and provide ongoing post\-sales engineering support as they roll MCP Manager out more widely. * Investigate and resolve prospect \& customer technical issues as they arise, using Claude Code and other AI coding assistants to reproduce problems, inspect configurations and logs, and propose fixes before escalating to engineering. Product Feedback \& Documentation* Log feedback, feature ideas, technical objections, and competitive signals from every customer conversation so product and engineering can act on them. * Work closely with the Product Manager to prioritize customer needs, clarify requirements, and validate new features with the customers who asked for them. * Update product documentation, guides, and troubleshooting articles based on what you learn from customer evaluations and support cases. **Requirements** * 3 or more years of experience in sales engineering, solutions engineering, solutions architecture, or a similar customer\-facing technical role at a B2B software company. * A track record of running technical evaluations and proofs of concept that convert into closed business, in close partnership with Account Executives, and experience supporting customers after the sale alongside Customer Success. * Ability to support several Account Executives at once, running multiple evaluations in parallel and prioritizing your time across a shared pipeline. * Strong working knowledge of APIs, authentication and authorization (OAuth, SSO, and identity providers), and SaaS configuration. You should also be comfortable reading technical documentation and troubleshooting integrations. * Basic coding experience, and comfort using Claude Code and other AI coding assistants to investigate and resolve customer issues as they arise. You don't need to be a software engineer, but you should be able to read code, write simple scripts, and debug problems with modern tools. * Experience supporting security reviews and vendor due diligence, and comfort discussing frameworks such as SOC 2 and HIPAA with security and compliance teams. * Hands\-on experience using AI assistants and agents in your own work, and real curiosity about how enterprises are adopting them. * Ideally, experience with Model Context Protocol and AI gateways. Must have experience with AI agent tooling and a background in developer tools, security, or governance software. * Excellent verbal and written communication, with the ability to explain complex technical ideas to engineers and business stakeholders alike. * Comfort operating in an early\-stage, category\-creation environment where the playbook is still being written. * Willingness to travel occasionally for customer meetings and industry events. Don't meet every single requirement? Studies have shown that women and people of colour are less likely to apply to jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Usercentrics we are dedicated to building a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you're excited about this role but your past experience doesn't align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we encourage you to apply anyway. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles. **Benefits** * 401(k) plan contribution with employer match * 18 paid vacation days (PTO) * Health insurance * Personal development budget for every employee * Hybrid workplace * Online wellness sessions * Team events including team buildings, happy hours, company breakfasts/lunches, in\-person and virtual * Refreshments: snacks, fruit, coffee, and drinks in the office **Why join usercentrics?** * Joining Usercentrics means becoming part of a fast\-growing, diverse, and international team of tech enthusiasts and entrepreneurially\-minded people who build our success story together. * Company culture is important to us. We strive to continuously develop a positive, vibrant, and inspiring environment that enables everyone to thrive both personally and professionally. * Get involved! We have plenty of initiatives and love seeing people from all departments enthusiastically participating in cross\-department projects and shaping our future. * Your work\-life balance matters. We offer flexible working hours, hybrid working, and the possibility of workcations (in accordance with our company policy). * We always remember to have fun, both in our day\-to\-day work and at our regular team events in our offices across Munich, Prague, Lisbon, Copenhagen, Odense, Buenos Aires, and New York, or online. * You are our most valuable asset. We offer a personal development budget, job\-related language courses, and much more to support your wellbeing and growth.

jobs.title: Telecommunications Network Engineer – Broadband & Wireless Infrastructure
jobs.description: **About Watch Communications** Watch Communications provides telecommunications and broadband connectivity services to residential and business customers, with a focus on delivering reliable internet access to rural and underserved communities. Our operations depend on reliable network infrastructure, effective wireless communications, and well\-maintained broadband systems to support connectivity, service availability, and customer satisfaction. We are seeking a technically minded Telecommunications Network Engineer to support the maintenance, monitoring, troubleshooting, and optimization of broadband and wireless network infrastructure. This position is ideal for an organized and analytical professional with experience in networking, telecommunications systems, wireless connectivity, fiber\-optic infrastructure, or technical network support who wants to build a career in the telecommunications industry. **Job Summary** Watch Communications is seeking a Telecommunications Network Engineer – Broadband \& Wireless Infrastructure to assist with network performance, broadband connectivity, infrastructure maintenance, and technical troubleshooting across telecommunications systems. Working with network operations, field technicians, technical support, and other engineering personnel, the engineer will help maintain reliable connectivity, investigate network issues, support infrastructure deployments, and ensure that telecommunications equipment and network services operate efficiently. jobs.description: About Us WebHawkx provides Program Management Services, Construction Management, Construction Inspection Services, Asset Management, Condition Assessment, Project Controls Services, and Information Technology Services. We support public agencies and utilities by combining engineering expertise, project controls, and technology solutions to improve the delivery and management of complex infrastructure programs. Position Title: Engineering Geologist, PE Job Type: Full\-Time Position Summary: WebHawkx is seeking a Senior Engineering Geologist to support water, wastewater, utility, pipeline, transportation, tunneling, and infrastructure projects. The position will be responsible for planning and overseeing subsurface investigations, evaluating soil, rock, and groundwater conditions, preparing geotechnical recommendations, reviewing technical submittals and field data, and supporting design and construction activities. The ideal candidate will have strong experience in geotechnical engineering, underground utilities, pipeline systems, construction support, and multidisciplinary project coordination. Essential Functions: * Plan, coordinate, and oversee subsurface investigations, including soil borings, test pits, rock coring, groundwater observations, and field sampling. * Review and interpret soil, rock, stratigraphy, groundwater conditions, and geotechnical risks affecting design and construction. * Evaluate field and laboratory test results, including soil classification, moisture content, Atterberg limits, Standard Penetration Test (SPT) data, compaction, density, and other geotechnical testing. * Prepare and review geotechnical reports, boring logs, technical memoranda, calculations, and engineering recommendations. * Provide technical recommendations related to excavation, trench stability, bedding, backfill, settlement, slope stability, foundation support, groundwater control, and constructability. * Support design and rehabilitation of water mains, sewer pipelines, tunnels, pump stations, tanks, underground utilities, and related infrastructure. * Review geotechnical submittals, contractor documentation, laboratory reports, field inspection records, and construction\-related technical information. * Evaluate trench conditions, pipe support, utility conflicts, unsuitable materials, rock excavation, settlement concerns, and other subsurface construction issues. * Coordinate with civil, structural, pipeline, environmental, construction, and utility teams to resolve geotechnical and field related issues. * Provide technical support during construction and respond to unexpected subsurface or groundwater conditions. * Perform or support QA/QC reviews of geotechnical deliverables and technical documentation. * Sign and seal engineering reports, recommendations, calculations, or design documents when required. Other Functions: * Participate in project meetings, design reviews, constructability reviews, and field coordination meetings. * Support proposal development, scope preparation, level\-of\-effort estimates, and technical approach development. * Coordinate with drilling contractors, testing laboratories, consultants, and subcontractors. * Maintain and review geotechnical databases, boring logs, field records, and technical documentation. * Provide technical guidance and mentorship to junior engineers, field staff, and inspectors as needed. * Perform other related duties as assigned. Required Knowledge, Skills, \& Abilities:. * Strong knowledge of geotechnical engineering principles, soil mechanics, engineering geology, and subsurface investigation methods. * Knowledge of foundation engineering, excavation support, trenching, backfill, compaction, slope stability, settlement, and groundwater control. * Understanding of underground utility, water, wastewater, and pipeline design and construction practices. * Ability to interpret boring logs, laboratory data, geological profiles, construction drawings, specifications, and technical reports. * Knowledge of field and laboratory geotechnical testing methods. * Ability to identify geotechnical risks and develop practical engineering recommendations. * Strong technical writing, documentation, analytical, and problem solving skills. * Ability to coordinate effectively with clients, contractors, consultants, government agencies, and multidisciplinary project teams. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office and relevant engineering software. * Strong verbal and written communication skills. Minimum Education \& Experience Requirements: * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering, Geotechnical Engineering, Geological Engineering, or a closely related engineering discipline. * Active Professional Engineer (PE) license. * Minimum of 7 years of progressively responsible experience in geotechnical engineering, engineering geology, subsurface investigation, or related infrastructure work. * Demonstrated experience supporting design and construction of water, wastewater, utility, transportation, pipeline, or other civil infrastructure projects. * Experience preparing or reviewing geotechnical reports, boring logs, laboratory data, and construction recommendations. Additional Requirements: * Valid driver’s license and ability to travel to project sites as required. * Ability to perform field visits and work in active construction environments. * Ability to work independently and as part of a multidisciplinary team. * Ability to manage multiple assignments and meet project deadlines. * Must be able to communicate effectively with technical and non technical stakeholders. * Must be authorized to work in the United States. Preference(s): * Active PE license in Maryland, Virginia, or the District of Columbia. * Master’s degree in Geotechnical Engineering, Geological Engineering, Civil Engineering, or a related field. * Experience with public utilities, municipal agencies, or large infrastructure programs. * Experience with water and sewer pipeline design, rehabilitation, tunneling, or underground construction. * Familiarity with gINT, GIS, AutoCAD, Civil 3D, or similar engineering software. * Experience with construction inspection, QA/QC, and geotechnical field support. Preferred experience: * Water main and sewer pipeline projects. * Subsurface investigations for utility and infrastructure projects. * Soil boring, rock coring, test pit, and groundwater investigations. * Trench excavation, bedding, backfill, compaction, and settlement evaluation. * Pipeline rehabilitation and trenchless construction. * Tunneling and underground utility construction. * Foundation design and geotechnical recommendations. * Geotechnical report preparation and review. * Construction\-phase geotechnical support. * Coordination with drilling contractors and materials testing laboratories. * Review of boring logs, laboratory results, and geotechnical submittals. * Public\-sector or utility agency infrastructure experience.
